readme:
# Ledger [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Ledger-181717?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/XoifaiI/Ledger) [![Docs](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docs-Read-8B5CF6?style=for-the-badge)](https://xoifaii.github.io/LedgerDocs/)
## What is this? A datastore library for Roblox with no session locks. You never write state. You write down the change you want, a function you own decides whether it is valid, and Ledger saves each change exactly once. ```luau type PlayerData = { Gold: number, Items: { [string]: number }, } type PlayerOps = { SpendGold: { Amount: number }, } local PlayerStore = Ledger.New<>({ Name = "PlayerData", Keys = "Player", Default = { Gold = 100, Items = {} }, MustExist = false, Erasable = true, Reducer = function(Data, Op) if Op.Kind == "SpendGold" then if Op.Amount > Data.Gold then return nil -- refused, on every server end local New = table.clone(Data) New.Gold -= Op.Amount return New end return nil end, }) local Session = PlayerStore:Load(Player) if Session then local Ok, Why = Session:Commit({ Kind = "SpendGold", Amount = 25 }) if not Ok then warn("Couldn't spend gold:", Why) end end ``` Two servers spend the same 100 gold at once: the reducer accepts one and refuses the other. Every server agrees, every time, and every call says what happened. A session lock serializes writers. A validating fold makes the invalid state unreachable, which is a stronger guarantee that also costs nothing when a server crashes: no lease to wait out, no locked player join stall, no side channel to touch someone offline or on another server. Changes are ops with names, and a reducer validates them. ## Features - **Lock free** | every server, same result, no locks - **Cross server** | write to any player, even offline - **Entity stores** | clans, listings, world records - **Transactions** | up to 29 players or keys, all move or none do - **Balances** | gold keeps moving while a trade is in progress - **Limited items** | sold from every server, never oversold - **Global counters** | every server adds, reading is free - **Migrations** | old servers can't corrupt new data - **Idempotent** | a write retried applies one time - **Typed ops** | name them once, every write is checked - **Loud misuse** | bad code throws, immediately ## Installing **Wally** ```toml [dependencies] Ledger = "xoifaii/ledger@7.3.1" ``` **Model file**: insert the [Ledger](https://github.com/XoifaiI/Ledger/releases) module anywhere server side. **roblox-ts** ``` npm install @xoifail/ledger ``` The same types work for TypeScript: see [Types](https://xoifaii.github.io/LedgerDocs/docs/reference/types). ## License This project has the [MIT License](https://github.com/XoifaiI/Ledger/blob/main/LICENSE).
description: Lock free event sourced datastore for Roblox. State is a fold over validated ops, no session locks.

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	TypeFunctions: turns a game's op map into the types its ops are held against. OpUnion is the tagged union a reducer
	narrows on; OpOf names one kind; both take the naming fields, not a fixed Id. Overloads makes one call per OpUnion
	arm. Frozen leaves only array and map slots writable. OpenAsAny types an open op any. NoInfer blocks inference.

	Return type: An empty table. The types are OpOf, ReadOnly, Frozen, OpenAsAny, OpUnion, Overloads, NoInfer,
	NumberKeys and SameKeys.
	Example usage:
		local TypeFunctions = require("./TypeFunctions")
		type Ops = TypeFunctions.OpUnion<{ Buy: { Item: string } }, { read Id: string? }>
--]=]

export type function ReadOnly(Shape: type): type
	if not Shape:is("table") then
		return Shape
	end

	local Held = types.copy(Shape)
	for Name in Shape:properties() do
		Held:setwriteproperty(Name, nil)
	end
	return Held
end

export type function Frozen(Shape: type): type
	local function Deep(Held: type, Depth: number): type
		if Depth > 16 then
			return Held
		end
		if Held:is("union") or Held:is("intersection") then
			local Parts = {}
			for _, Part in Held:components() do
				table.insert(Parts, Deep(Part, Depth + 1))
			end
			return if Held:is("union")
				then types.unionof(table.unpack(Parts))
				else types.intersectionof(table.unpack(Parts))
		end
		if not Held:is("table") then
			return Held
		end

		local Out = types.newtable(nil, nil, Held:metatable())
		for Name, Field in Held:properties() do
			if Field.read ~= nil then
				Out:setreadproperty(Name, Deep(Field.read, Depth + 1))
			end
		end
		local Indexer = Held:readindexer()
		if Indexer ~= nil then
			Out:setindexer(Indexer.index, Deep(Indexer.result, Depth + 1))
		end
		return Out
	end

	return Deep(Shape, 0)
end

export type function OpenAsAny(Shape: type): type
	if not Shape:is("table") or Shape:readindexer() == nil then
		return Shape
	end
	for Name, Held in Shape:properties() do
		if Name:is("singleton") and Name:value() == "Kind" and Held.read == types.string then
			return types.any
		end
	end
	return Shape
end

export type OpOf<O, K, Naming> = Naming & { read Kind: K } & ReadOnly<index<O, K>>

export type function OpUnion(Map: type, Naming: type): type
	local function WithNaming(Arm: type): type
		for Field, Held in Naming:properties() do
			Arm:setreadproperty(Field, Held.read)
		end
		return Arm
	end

	if not Map:is("table") then
		local Open = types.newtable()
		Open:setproperty(types.singleton("Kind"), types.string)
		Open:setindexer(types.any, types.unknown)
		return WithNaming(Open)
	end

	local Arms = {}
	for Kind, Held in Map:properties() do
		local Fields = Held.read
		if Fields == nil then
			continue
		end
		if not Fields:is("table") then
			error(
				`op kind '{tostring(Kind)}' has to name the fields it carries, as a table, and it names {tostring(
					Fields
				)}`
			)
		end

		local Arm = types.copy(Fields)
		for Name in Fields:properties() do
			Arm:setwriteproperty(Name, nil)
		end
		Arm:setreadproperty(types.singleton("Kind"), Kind)
		table.insert(Arms, WithNaming(Arm))
	end

	if #Arms == 0 then
		return types.never
	end
	if #Arms == 1 then
		return Arms[1]
	end
	return types.unionof(table.unpack(Arms))
end

export type function Overloads(Union: type, Shape: type): type
	local Lead = Shape:parameters().head or {}
	local Gives = Shape:returns()
	local Arms = if Union:is("union") then Union:components() else { Union }

	local Calls = {}
	for _, Arm in Arms do
		local Takes = table.clone(Lead)
		table.insert(Takes, Arm)
		table.insert(Calls, types.newfunction({ head = Takes }, { head = Gives.head, tail = Gives.tail }))
	end

	if #Calls == 1 then
		return Calls[1]
	end
	return types.intersectionof(table.unpack(Calls))
end

export type function NoInfer(Given: type): type
	return Given
end

export type function NumberKeys(Shape: type): type
	if not Shape:is("table") then
		return types.string
	end

	local Named = {}
	for Field, Held in Shape:properties() do
		if Held.read == types.number then
			table.insert(Named, Field)
		end
	end

	if #Named == 0 then
		return types.never
	end
	if #Named == 1 then
		return Named[1]
	end
	return types.unionof(table.unpack(Named))
end

export type function SameKeys(Open: type, Named: type): type
	local function Names(Held: type): { [string]: boolean }
		local Into: { [string]: boolean } = {}
		if Held:is("singleton") then
			Into[tostring(Held:value())] = true
			return Into
		end
		if not Held:is("union") then
			error(`a set of method names has to be singletons, and this one is {tostring(Held)}`)
		end

		for _, Part in Held:components() do
			if Part:is("singleton") then
				Into[tostring(Part:value())] = true
			end
		end
		return Into
	end

	local Ours = Names(Open)
	local Theirs = Names(Named)

	local Apart: { string } = {}
	for Name in Ours do
		if not Theirs[Name] then
			table.insert(Apart, `the typed view has no '{Name}'`)
		end
	end
	for Name in Theirs do
		if not Ours[Name] then
			table.insert(Apart, `the open view has no '{Name}'`)
		end
	end

	if #Apart > 0 then
		table.sort(Apart)
		error(
			`the two views of a store have drifted apart: {table.concat(Apart, ", ")}. `
				.. "A method has to be on both or on neither"
		)
	end
	return types.boolean
end

return table.freeze({})

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Types: the public types. Typed views hold each op to the game's op map; annotating an op with
	Ledger.OpOf<Ops, "AddCoins"> names the field in errors. Ledger's own shapes are written out, not made by Frozen,
	keeping their lists read-only. A bare D outside Default and parameters breaks refining an inferred D.
	QuantityDeclaration.Closed guards this build only; older builds can Open.

	Return type: An empty table. The types are exported.
	Example usage:
		local Types = require("./Types")
		type Store = Types.TypedStore<{ Gold: number }, { AddGold: { Amount: number } }>
--]=]

local Amounts = require("./Keys/Encoding/Amounts")
local Book = require("./Keys/Format/Book")
local Fates = require("./Keys/Format/Items/Fates")
local Future = require("./Util/Future")
local Guards = require("./Keys/Ops/Guards")
local Hot = require("./Keys/Constants/Hot")
local HotShapes = require("./Shared/QuantityShapes")
local Names = require("./Keys/Encoding/Names")
local Observer = require("./Util/Observer")
local Reasons = require("./Keys/Constants/Reasons")
local RecordTypes = require("./Shared/RecordTypes")
local Services = require("./Roblox/Services")
local ShellSetup = require("./Roblox/Setup")
local TypeFunctions = require("./TypeFunctions")
local WritingAnswers = require("./Keys/DataStore/Answers")

type Emitted = WritingAnswers.Emitted
type MigrationRun = Guards.MigrationRun
type Mode = Hot.Mode
type Ops = ShellSetup.Ops
type Serials = HotShapes.Serials
type StoreKey = Names.StoreKey

export type Reason = Reasons.Reason
export type KeyLike = Player | number | string
export type KeysMode = ShellSetup.KeysMode
export type OpMap = { [string]: { [string]: unknown } }
export type Frozen<S> = TypeFunctions.Frozen<S>
export type Future<T...> = Future.Future<T...>
export type Observer<T> = Observer.Observer<T>
export type Connection = Observer.Connection
export type Identity = Frozen<Book.Identity>
export type LoadFailedHandler = ShellSetup.LoadFailedHandler
export type ShortReason = Fates.ShortReason
export type Amount = Frozen<Amounts.SignedAmount | Amounts.UnsignedAmount>

export type Arithmetic<T = any> = {
	read Zero: T,
	read Add: (Left: T, Right: T) -> T,
	read Subtract: (Left: T, Right: T) -> T,
	read Compare: (Left: T, Right: T) -> number,
	read IsValid: (Value: unknown) -> boolean,
	read Encode: (Value: T) -> string,
	read Decode: (Text: string) -> T?,
	read Max: T?,
}

export type HoldHandle = Frozen<HotShapes.HoldHandle>
export type QuantityTotal = Frozen<HotShapes.QuantityTotal>
export type Took = Frozen<HotShapes.Took>
export type Record<D = unknown> = RecordTypes.Record<D>
export type LossRecords = RecordTypes.LossRecords
export type PendingItems = RecordTypes.PendingItems
export type KeyVersion = Services.KeyVersion

type ReadArray<Item> = { read [number]: Item }

export type Closed = {
	read Removed: ReadArray<number>,
	read Left: ReadArray<number>,
	read Missing: ReadArray<number>,
}

export type Name = string | OpId

export type Terms<O = any> = TypeFunctions.OpUnion<O, {}>
export type Op<O = any> = Terms<O>
export type OpOf<O, K> = TypeFunctions.OpOf<O, K, {}>
export type Overloads<O, Shape> = TypeFunctions.Overloads<Op<O>, Shape>
export type Reducer<S, O = any> = Guards.Reducer<S, Terms<O>>

type ConfigReducer<D, O> = Guards.Reducer<D, Terms<O>, D & {}>

export type ResultSchema<D> = ShellSetup.ResultSchema<D>

export type Migration = {
	read Run: MigrationRun,
	read IsBreaking: boolean?,
	read Fields: { string }?,
}

export type BalanceKindLimits<T = any> = {
	read Kind: string,
	read Min: TypeFunctions.NoInfer<T>?,
	read Max: TypeFunctions.NoInfer<T>?,
}

export type BalanceField<T = any> = {
	read Credit: (string | { string | BalanceKindLimits<T> })?,
	read Debit: (string | { string | BalanceKindLimits<T> })?,
	read Min: TypeFunctions.NoInfer<T>?,
	read Max: TypeFunctions.NoInfer<T>?,
	read Arithmetic: Arithmetic<T>?,
}

export type Windows = {
	[string]: {
		read Timed: number?,
		read Untimed: number?,
	},
}

export type TotalDeclaration = { read Shards: number? }

export type QuantityDeclaration = {
	read Parts: number,
	read Mode: Mode,
	read Stock: number?,
	read Serials: Serials?,
	read Proceeds: { string }?,
	read Closed: boolean?,
}

export type TypedConfig<D, O> = {
	read Name: string,
	read Keys: KeysMode,
	read Default: D,
	read Reducer: ConfigReducer<D, O>?,
	read Schema: ResultSchema<D>?,
	read Balances: { [string]: BalanceField }?,
	read Migrations: { Migration }?,
	read MustExist: boolean,
	read Erasable: boolean,
	read LegLimit: number?,
	read OnLoadFailed: LoadFailedHandler?,
	read Kick: boolean?,
	read KickMessage: string?,
	read SaveInterval: number?,
	read IdleReadInterval: number?,
	read HoldMax: number?,
	read OrphanAge: number?,
	read Windows: Windows?,
	read CutWindow: number?,
	read Totals: { [string]: TotalDeclaration }?,
	read Quantities: { [string]: QuantityDeclaration }?,
	read Mock: unknown?,
}

export type Config<D> = TypedConfig<D, any>

export type OpId = {
	read Name: { read Kind: string },
}

export type Applied = {
	read Name: { read Kind: string },
	read CallId: number,
	read Key: Frozen<StoreKey>,
}

export type Info<D = unknown> = {
	read State: Frozen<D>?,
	read Identity: Identity?,
	read Key: InfoKey?,
	read ShortReason: ShortReason?,
	read Name: Name?,
	read Outcome: Future<boolean, Reason?>?,
}

export type DidApplyInfo = Frozen<{
	IsQueued: true?,
}>

export type Cut = {
	read Name: Name,
	read Losses: LossRecords?,
}

export type EditOptions = {
	read MustExist: boolean?,
	read Id: Name?,
	read IdAt: number?,
}

export type CommitOptions = {
	read Id: Name?,
	read IdAt: number?,
}

export type BumpOptions = {
	read Id: string?,
	read IdAt: number?,
}

export type PeekOptions = {
	read Fresh: true,
}

export type DidApplyOptions = {
	read IdAt: number?,
	read Probe: boolean?,
}

export type ResetOptions<D> = {
	read Id: OpId?,
	read IdAt: number?,
	read State: Frozen<D>?,
}

export type EraseOptions = {
	read Id: OpId?,
	read IdAt: number?,
}

export type TxOptions = {
	read Id: string?,
	read IdAt: number?,
}

export type TakeOptions = {
	read Price: (number | { read [string]: unknown })?,
	read Id: string?,
	read IdAt: number?,
	read Legs: { TakeLeg }?,
}

type AnyStore = {
	read Leg: (Store: any, ...any) -> ...any,
	read Quantity: (Store: any, Name: string) -> ...any,
}

export type KeyOfStore = {
	read Store: AnyStore,
	read Key: KeyLike,
}

export type GatherOptions = {
	read Kind: string?,
	read Id: string?,
	read IdAt: number?,
}

export type WithdrawOptions = {
	read Kind: string?,
}

export type ConfirmOptions = {
	read Price: (number | { read [string]: unknown })?,
	read Legs: { TakeLeg }?,
}

export type DepositOptions = {
	read From: KeyOfStore?,
	read Field: string?,
	read Kind: string?,
	read Part: number?,
}

export type TxLeg = {
	read Store: Store<any>,
	read Key: KeyLike,
	read Op: { read Kind: string },
	read MustExist: boolean?,
}

export type LegOptions = {
	read MustExist: boolean?,
	read Slot: { string | number }?,
}

export type Leg<S> = {
	read Store: S,
	read Key: KeyLike,
	read Op: { read Kind: string },
	read MustExist: boolean?,
	read Slot: { string | number }?,
}

export type TakeLeg = Leg<AnyStore>

export type FateOp<O = any> = TypeFunctions.OpenAsAny<Frozen<Terms<O>>>

export type Fate<O = any> = {
	read Applied: Applied,
	read Fate: Emitted,
	read Op: FateOp<O>,
}

export type InfoKey = Frozen<{
	Store: string,
	Key: string | number,
}>

export type SessionCommon<D, O = any> = {
	Get: (self: SessionCommon<D, O>) -> Frozen<D>,
	Observe: (self: SessionCommon<D, O>) -> Observer<Frozen<D>>,
	ObserveFates: (self: SessionCommon<D, O>) -> Observer<Fate<O>>,
	DidApply: (
		self: SessionCommon<D, O>,
		Name: Applied | Name,
		Options: DidApplyOptions?
	) -> (boolean?, Reason?, DidApplyInfo?),
	Flush: (self: SessionCommon<D, O>) -> (boolean, Reason?, Info?),
	Refresh: (self: SessionCommon<D, O>) -> (boolean, Reason?),
	Release: (self: SessionCommon<D, O>) -> (boolean, Reason?, Info?),
}

export type TypedSession<D, O> = SessionCommon<D, O> & {
	Apply: (self: TypedSession<D, O>, Op: Op<O>) -> (boolean, Applied | Reason, Info?),
	Commit: (self: TypedSession<D, O>, Op: Op<O>, Options: CommitOptions?) -> (boolean, Frozen<D> | Reason, Info<D>?),
}

export type Session<D> = SessionCommon<D> & {
	Apply: (self: Session<D>, Op: Op) -> (boolean, Applied | Reason, Info?),
	Commit: (self: Session<D>, Op: Op, Options: CommitOptions?) -> (boolean, Frozen<D> | Reason, Info<D>?),
}

export type Quantity = {
	Total: (self: Quantity, MaxAge: number?) -> (QuantityTotal?, Reason?),
	Take: (self: Quantity, Count: number, Options: TakeOptions?) -> (boolean, Took | Reason, Info?),
	Gather: (
		self: Quantity,
		Count: number,
		To: KeyOfStore,
		Field: string,
		Options: GatherOptions?
	) -> (boolean, Reason?, Info?),
	Hold: (self: Quantity, Count: number, Duration: number) -> (boolean, HoldHandle | Reason, Info?),
	Open: (self: Quantity) -> (boolean, Reason?, Info?),
	Close: (self: Quantity) -> (boolean, Closed | Reason, Info?),
	Confirm: (self: Quantity, Hold: HoldHandle, Options: ConfirmOptions?) -> (boolean, (number | Reason)?, Info?),
	Release: (self: Quantity, Hold: HoldHandle) -> (boolean, Reason?, Info?),
	Deposit: (self: Quantity, Count: number, Options: DepositOptions?) -> (boolean, Reason?, Info?),
	Withdraw: (
		self: Quantity,
		Count: unknown,
		Part: number,
		To: number | KeyOfStore,
		Field: string,
		Options: WithdrawOptions?
	) -> (boolean, Reason?, Info?),
}

export type KeyPages<K = string | number> = {
	Next: (self: KeyPages<K>) -> ({ K }?, Reason?),
}

export type VersionPages = {
	Next: (self: VersionPages) -> ({ KeyVersion }?, Reason?),
}

export type StoreCommon<D> = {
	Peek: (
		self: StoreCommon<D>,
		Key: KeyLike,
		Freshness: (number | PeekOptions)?
	) -> (Frozen<D>?, Reason?, Info<D>?),
	Inspect: (self: StoreCommon<D>, Key: KeyLike) -> (Record<D>?, Reason?),
	DidApply: (self: StoreCommon<D>, Key: KeyLike, Name: Name, Options: DidApplyOptions?) -> (boolean?, Reason?),
	Reset: (self: StoreCommon<D>, Key: KeyLike, Options: ResetOptions<D>?) -> (boolean, Cut | Reason, Info?),
	Erase: (self: StoreCommon<D>, Key: KeyLike, Options: EraseOptions?) -> (boolean, Cut | Reason, Info?),
	Losses: (self: StoreCommon<D>, Key: KeyLike) -> (LossRecords?, Reason?),
	Pending: (self: StoreCommon<D>, Key: KeyLike) -> (PendingItems?, Reason?),
	Resettle: (self: StoreCommon<D>, Key: KeyLike) -> (boolean, Reason?, Info?),
	Follow: (self: StoreCommon<D>, Key: KeyLike) -> Observer<Frozen<D> | "Behind">,
	Stale: (self: StoreCommon<D>) -> Observer<string | number>,
	Bump: (self: StoreCommon<D>, Total: string, Amount: number, Options: BumpOptions?) -> (boolean, Reason?, Info?),
	Total: (self: StoreCommon<D>, Name: string, MaxAge: number?) -> (number?, Reason?),
	Quantity: (self: StoreCommon<D>, Name: string) -> Quantity,
	Keys: (self: StoreCommon<D>, Prefix: string?) -> KeyPages<string | number>,
	Versions: (self: StoreCommon<D>, Key: KeyLike) -> VersionPages,
	PeekVersion: (self: StoreCommon<D>, Key: KeyLike, Version: string) -> (unknown, Reason?),
	Unload: (self: StoreCommon<D>, Player: Player) -> (),
	IsLoaded: (self: StoreCommon<D>, Player: Player) -> boolean,
	Read: (self: StoreCommon<D>, Player: Player) -> Frozen<D>?,
	Destroy: (self: StoreCommon<D>) -> (),
}

export type TypedStore<D, O> = StoreCommon<D> & {
	Edit: (self: TypedStore<D, O>, Key: KeyLike, Op: Op<O>, Options: EditOptions?) -> (boolean, Reason?, Info<D>?),
	Load: (self: TypedStore<D, O>, Player: Player) -> (TypedSession<D, O>?, Reason?),
	Get: (self: TypedStore<D, O>, Player: Player) -> TypedSession<D, O>?,
	Expect: (self: TypedStore<D, O>, Player: Player) -> TypedSession<D, O>,
	WaitForLoaded: (self: TypedStore<D, O>, Player: Player) -> TypedSession<D, O>?,
	Leg: (self: TypedStore<D, O>, Key: KeyLike, Op: Terms<O>, Options: LegOptions?) -> Leg<any>,
}

export type Store<D> = StoreCommon<D> & {
	Edit: (self: Store<D>, Key: KeyLike, Op: Op, Options: EditOptions?) -> (boolean, Reason?, Info<D>?),
	Load: (self: Store<D>, Player: Player) -> (Session<D>?, Reason?),
	Get: (self: Store<D>, Player: Player) -> Session<D>?,
	Expect: (self: Store<D>, Player: Player) -> Session<D>,
	WaitForLoaded: (self: Store<D>, Player: Player) -> Session<D>?,
	Leg: (self: Store<D>, Key: KeyLike, Op: Terms<any>, Options: LegOptions?) -> Leg<any>,
}

type SameMethods =
	TypeFunctions.SameKeys<keyof<Store<any>>, keyof<TypedStore<any, any>>>
	| TypeFunctions.SameKeys<keyof<Session<any>>, keyof<TypedSession<any, any>>>

return {}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Ledger: the module surface. On the server it starts the Runner at load; on a client, read through Platform (not a
	test flag), it starts nothing: Reason works and every other function throws, naming itself. A store name opens
	once per server life. New's typed view is the one cast, which MethodsMatch guards.

	Return type: The Ledger table of functions (Now is the clock an IdAt counts in; BeforeClose gives the close, the
	platform's or a CloseAll call's, a function to run first) and Reason, and the public types.
	Example usage:
		local Ledger = require(ReplicatedStorage.Ledger)
		local Vault = Ledger.New({
			Name = "Vault", Keys = "String", MustExist = false, Erasable = false, Default = { Gold = 0 },
			Balances = { Gold = { Credit = "Deposit", Debit = "Withdraw", Max = 1000000 } },
		})
--]=]

local Answers = require("@self/Api/Answers")
local Args = require("@self/Api/Validate/Args")
local Calls = require("@self/Roblox/Calls")
local Check = require("@self/Keys/Encoding/Check")
local Cross = require("@self/Api/Validate/Cross")

local KeysModes = ShellSetup.KeysMode

local IsServer = Platform.IsServer()

local NewWhere = "Ledger.New"
local NowWhere = "Ledger.Now"
local TxWhere = "Ledger.Tx"
local IdWhere = "Ledger.Id"
local CloseAllWhere = "Ledger.CloseAll"
local BeforeCloseWhere = "Ledger.BeforeClose"
local OpenedBefore = "a store name not opened on this server before, a destroyed store's included"

local function ServerOnly(Name: string): string
	return `Ledger: {Name} runs on the server only.`
end

local function OnServer(Name: string)
	if not IsServer then
		error(ServerOnly(Name), 0)
	end
end

local function NotOpened(Value: unknown): string?
	if type(Value) == "string" and Runner.IsOpened(Value) then
		return OpenedBefore
	end
	return nil
end

local function New<D, O>(Config: TypedConfig<D, O>): TypedStore<D, O>
	OnServer("New")
	Args.OutsideStep(NewWhere)
	local Settings = Setup.Settle(Config, NewWhere)
	Cross.Check(Settings, NewWhere)
	Check.Table({ Name = Settings.Name }, { Name = NotOpened }, NewWhere)
	local IsStudio = Platform.IsStudio()
	if IsStudio then
		Cross.Probe(Settings)
	end

	local PartBuild = ShellSetup.PartBuildOf(Settings)
	local Built = Limits.Build(Settings, PartBuild, IsStudio)
	local StoreSetup = ShellSetup.SetupOf(Settings, PartBuild, Platform.Encoding, Built, IsStudio)
	if Settings.Mock ~= nil then
		Services.UseMock(Settings.Mock)
	end
	Runner.AddStore(StoreSetup, Settings.Keys == KeysModes.Player)
	local Made = Store.New(Settings)
	return (Made :: any) :: TypedStore<D, O>
end

local function Now(): number
	OnServer("Now")
	Args.OutsideStep(NowWhere)
	return Platform.Now()
end

local function Id(): (OpId?, Reason?)
	OnServer("Id")
	Args.OutsideStep(IdWhere)
	Args.OutsideListener(IdWhere)
	local IdCall: Call = { Kind = "Call", Method = "Id" :: "Id", CallId = Calls.NewCallId() }
	return Answers.IdAnswer(Runner.CallNowForId(IdCall))
end

local function Tx(TxLegs: { TxLeg }, Options: TxOptions?): (boolean, Reason?, Info?)
	OnServer("Tx")
	Args.OutsideStep(TxWhere)
	local Checked = Legs.Check(TxLegs, Options, TxWhere)
	Args.OutsideListener(TxWhere)
	local Made: Call = {
		Kind = "Call",
		Method = "Tx" :: "Tx",
		CallId = Calls.NewCallId(),
		Legs = Checked.Legs,
		Hot = nil,
		Name = Checked.Name,
	}
	local Answered, Outcome = Runner.CallWithOutcome(Made):Wait()
	local Ok, Why, Info = Answers.TxAnswer(Answered, Checked.KeysByStore)
	return Ok, Why, Answers.WithOutcome(Info, Outcome)
end

local function CloseAll(): ()
	OnServer("CloseAll")
	Args.OutsideStep(CloseAllWhere)
	Args.OutsideListener(CloseAllWhere)
	Runner.CloseAll()
end

local function BeforeClose(Fn: () -> ()): ()
	OnServer("BeforeClose")
	Args.OutsideStep(BeforeCloseWhere)
	Check.Table({ Fn = Fn }, { Fn = Check.Function }, BeforeCloseWhere)
	Runner.AddBeforeClose(Fn)
end

if IsServer then
	Runner.Start()
end

return {
	New = New,
	Now = Now,
	Id = Id,
	Tx = Tx,
	CloseAll = CloseAll,
	BeforeClose = BeforeClose,
	Reason = Reasons,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Answers: the core's Answer as each method's public returns (Answers.md 4 to 6), the one place they are made. A write
	gives Ok, its value or reason, and on a no a frozen Info; a read gives its value, or nil and the reason. Info.Key
	names a Tx or Take's deciding game key, elsewhere Missing's. GameValues makes the values.

	Return type: A plain table of functions.
	Example usage:
		local Ok, Result, Info = Answers.WriteAnswer(Runner.Call(Call):Wait())
--]=]

local Events = require("../Shared/Events")
local Fates = require("../Keys/Format/Items/Fates")
local GameValues = require("./GameValues")
local Handles = require("./Handles")
local HotShapes = require("../Shared/QuantityShapes")
local Names = require("../Keys/Encoding/Names")
local Reasons = require("../Keys/Constants/Reasons")
local Types = require("../Types")
local WritingAnswers = require("../Keys/DataStore/Answers")

type Answer = Events.Answer
type FateEmission = WritingAnswers.FateEmission
type LossRecords = Types.LossRecords
type Closed = Types.Closed
type HoldHandle = HotShapes.HoldHandle
type QuantityDeclaration = HotShapes.QuantityDeclaration
type PartReason = Fates.PartReason
type Took = HotShapes.Took
type Applied = Types.Applied
type Cut = Types.Cut
type DidApplyInfo = Types.DidApplyInfo
type Fate = Types.Fate
type Identity = Types.Identity
type Info = Types.Info
type KeysMode = Types.KeysMode
type InfoKey = Types.InfoKey
type Name = Types.Name
type OpId = Types.OpId
type Reason = Types.Reason
type ShortReason = Types.ShortReason
type StoreKey = Names.StoreKey

type Outcome = Types.Future<boolean, Reason?>

type InfoFields = {
	State: unknown,
	Identity: Identity?,
	Key: InfoKey?,
	ShortReason: ShortReason?,
	Name: Name?,
	Outcome: Outcome?,
}

local DecidingReasons: { [Reason]: true } = {
	[Reasons.Refused] = true,
	[Reasons.Full] = true,
	[Reasons.Behind] = true,
	[Reasons.Missing] = true,
}

local RefusingReasons: { [Reason]: true } = {
	[Reasons.Refused] = true,
	[Reasons.Full] = true,
}

local NoInfo: Info = table.freeze({})
local NotQueued: DidApplyInfo = table.freeze({})
local Queued: DidApplyInfo = table.freeze({ IsQueued = true :: true })

local CopyForGame = GameValues.CopyForGame
local IdentityForGame = GameValues.IdentityForGame
local NameForGame = GameValues.NameForGame
local InfoKeyOf = GameValues.InfoKeyOf

local function InfoOf(Fields: InfoFields): Info
	return table.freeze(Fields)
end

local function DecidingKeyOf(Given: Answer, KeysByStore: { [string]: KeysMode }): InfoKey?
	if Given.Kind ~= "Failed" or not DecidingReasons[Given.Reason] then
		return nil
	end
	return InfoKeyOf(Given.Key, KeysByStore)
end

local function KeyOfMissing(Given: Answer, KeysByStore: { [string]: KeysMode }): InfoKey?
	if Given.Kind ~= "Failed" or Given.Reason ~= Reasons.Missing then
		return nil
	end
	return InfoKeyOf(Given.Key, KeysByStore)
end

local function RefusedStateOf(Given: Answer): unknown
	if Given.Kind ~= "Failed" or not RefusingReasons[Given.Reason] or not GameValues.IsGameKey(Given.Key) then
		return nil
	end
	return CopyForGame(Given.State)
end

local function ShortOf(Reason: Reason, Short: PartReason?): ShortReason?
	if Reason ~= Reasons.Short then
		return nil
	end
	return GameValues.ShortReasonOf(Short)
end

local function Plain(Given: Answer): (boolean, Reason?, Info?)
	if Given.Kind == "Succeeded" then
		return true, nil, nil
	end
	return false, Given.Reason, NoInfo
end

local function ReadAnswer(Given: Answer): (unknown, Reason?)
	if Given.Kind == "Succeeded" then
		return CopyForGame(Given.Value), nil
	end
	return nil, Given.Reason
end

local function PeekAnswer(Given: Answer): (unknown, Reason?, Info?)
	if Given.Kind == "Succeeded" then
		return CopyForGame(Given.Value), nil, nil
	end
	return nil, Given.Reason, InfoOf({ State = CopyForGame(Given.State) })
end

local function IdAnswer(Given: Answer): (OpId?, Reason?)
	if Given.Kind ~= "Succeeded" then
		return nil, Given.Reason
	end
	return Handles.OpIdOf(GameValues.DrawnOf(Given.Value)), nil
end

local function DidApplyAnswer(Given: Answer): (unknown, Reason?, DidApplyInfo?)
	if Given.Kind == "Succeeded" then
		return CopyForGame(Given.Value), nil, nil
	end
	return nil, Given.Reason, NotQueued
end

local function QueuedAnswer(): (nil, Reason, DidApplyInfo)
	return nil, Reasons.Unresolved, Queued
end

local function WriteAnswer(Given: Answer): (boolean, Reason?, Info?)
	if Given.Kind == "Succeeded" then
		return true, nil, nil
	end
	return false, Given.Reason, InfoOf({ State = CopyForGame(Given.State), Identity = IdentityForGame(Given.Identity) })
end

local function CommitAnswer(Given: Answer): (boolean, unknown, Info?)
	if Given.Kind == "Succeeded" then
		return true, CopyForGame(Given.Value), nil
	end
	return WriteAnswer(Given)
end

local function ApplyAnswer(Given: Answer, CallId: number, Key: StoreKey): (boolean, Applied | Reason, Info?)
	if Given.Kind ~= "Succeeded" then
		return false, Given.Reason, NoInfo
	end
	return true, Handles.AppliedOf(GameValues.ApplyNameOf(Given.Value), CallId, Key), nil
end

local function CutAnswer(Given: Answer): (boolean, Cut | Reason, Info?)
	if Given.Kind == "Succeeded" then
		local Done = GameValues.CutValueOf(Given.Value)
		local Losses = Done.Namings
		local Made: Cut = {
			Name = Handles.PublicNameOf(Done.Name),
			Losses = if Losses == nil then nil else GameValues.RecordsForGame(Losses),
		}
		return true, table.freeze(Made), nil
	end
	return false, Given.Reason, InfoOf({ Name = NameForGame(Given.Name), Identity = IdentityForGame(Given.Identity) })
end

local function LossesAnswer(Given: Answer): (LossRecords?, Reason?)
	if Given.Kind == "Succeeded" then
		return GameValues.RecordsForGame(Given.Value), nil
	end
	return nil, Given.Reason
end

local function TxAnswer(Given: Answer, KeysByStore: { [string]: KeysMode }): (boolean, Reason?, Info?)
	if Given.Kind == "Succeeded" then
		return true, nil, nil
	end
	return false,
		Given.Reason,
		InfoOf({
			State = RefusedStateOf(Given),
			Identity = IdentityForGame(Given.Identity),
			Key = DecidingKeyOf(Given, KeysByStore),
			Name = NameForGame(Given.Name),
		})
end

local function MoveAnswer(Given: Answer, KeysByStore: { [string]: KeysMode }): (boolean, Reason?, Info?)
	if Given.Kind == "Succeeded" then
		return true, nil, nil
	end
	return false,
		Given.Reason,
		InfoOf({
			Identity = IdentityForGame(Given.Identity),
			Key = KeyOfMissing(Given, KeysByStore),
			Name = NameForGame(Given.Name),
		})
end

local function DepositAnswer(Given: Answer, KeysByStore: { [string]: KeysMode }): (boolean, Reason?, Info?)
	if Given.Kind == "Succeeded" then
		return true, nil, nil
	end
	return false,
		Given.Reason,
		InfoOf({
			State = CopyForGame(Given.State),
			Identity = IdentityForGame(Given.Identity),
			Key = KeyOfMissing(Given, KeysByStore),
			Name = NameForGame(Given.Name),
		})
end

local function TakeAnswer(Given: Answer, KeysByStore: { [string]: KeysMode }): (boolean, Took | Reason, Info?)
	if Given.Kind == "Succeeded" then
		return true, GameValues.TookForGame(Given.Value), nil
	end
	return false,
		Given.Reason,
		InfoOf({
			State = RefusedStateOf(Given),
			ShortReason = ShortOf(Given.Reason, Given.ShortReason),
			Key = DecidingKeyOf(Given, KeysByStore),
			Identity = IdentityForGame(Given.Identity),
			Name = NameForGame(Given.Name),
		})
end

local function HoldAnswer(Given: Answer, Quantity: QuantityDeclaration): (boolean, HoldHandle | Reason, Info?)
	if Given.Kind == "Succeeded" then
		return true, GameValues.HoldHandleOf(Given.Value, Quantity), nil
	end
	return false, Given.Reason, InfoOf({ ShortReason = ShortOf(Given.Reason, Given.ShortReason) })
end

local function GatherAnswer(Given: Answer, KeysByStore: { [string]: KeysMode }): (boolean, Reason?, Info?)
	if Given.Kind == "Succeeded" then
		return true, nil, nil
	end
	return false,
		Given.Reason,
		InfoOf({
			ShortReason = ShortOf(Given.Reason, Given.ShortReason),
			Key = KeyOfMissing(Given, KeysByStore),
			Identity = IdentityForGame(Given.Identity),
			Name = NameForGame(Given.Name),
		})
end

local function ConfirmAnswer(Given: Answer, KeysByStore: { [string]: KeysMode }): (boolean, (number | Reason)?, Info?)
	if Given.Kind == "Succeeded" then
		return true, GameValues.ConfirmedOf(Given.Value).Value, nil
	end
	return false,
		Given.Reason,
		InfoOf({
			ShortReason = ShortOf(Given.Reason, Given.ShortReason),
			Key = KeyOfMissing(Given, KeysByStore),
			Identity = IdentityForGame(Given.Identity),
		})
end

local function CloseAnswer(Given: Answer): (boolean, Closed | Reason, Info?)
	if Given.Kind == "Succeeded" then
		return true, GameValues.ClosedForGame(Given.Value), nil
	end
	return false, Given.Reason, NoInfo
end

local function FateOf(Emission: FateEmission, Handle: Applied): Fate
	local Made: Fate = {
		Applied = Handle,
		Fate = GameValues.EmittedForGame(Emission.Fate),
		Op = GameValues.FateOpForGame(Emission.OpKind, Emission.Terms),
	}
	return table.freeze(Made)
end

local function WithOutcome(Given: Info?, Outcome: Outcome?): Info?
	if Given == nil or Outcome == nil then
		return Given
	end
	local Fields: InfoFields = {
		State = Given.State,
		Identity = Given.Identity,
		Key = Given.Key,
		ShortReason = Given.ShortReason,
		Name = Given.Name,
		Outcome = Outcome,
	}
	return InfoOf(Fields)
end

local function FollowValue(Given: Answer): unknown
	if Given.Kind == "Succeeded" then
		return CopyForGame(Given.Value)
	end
	return Given.Reason
end

return {
	Plain = Plain,
	ReadAnswer = ReadAnswer,
	PeekAnswer = PeekAnswer,
	IdAnswer = IdAnswer,
	DidApplyAnswer = DidApplyAnswer,
	QueuedAnswer = QueuedAnswer,
	WriteAnswer = WriteAnswer,
	CommitAnswer = CommitAnswer,
	ApplyAnswer = ApplyAnswer,
	CutAnswer = CutAnswer,
	LossesAnswer = LossesAnswer,
	TxAnswer = TxAnswer,
	MoveAnswer = MoveAnswer,
	DepositAnswer = DepositAnswer,
	TakeAnswer = TakeAnswer,
	HoldAnswer = HoldAnswer,
	GatherAnswer = GatherAnswer,
	ConfirmAnswer = ConfirmAnswer,
	CloseAnswer = CloseAnswer,
	FateOf = FateOf,
	WithOutcome = WithOutcome,
	FollowValue = FollowValue,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	GameValues: the values in what the core says, as the game is handed them (Answers.md 4 to 6): frozen tables,
	public name handles, a Short's reason and a key in the game's form. Table answers and a Short's reason are
	checked for their promised shape; any other throws. An Identity that is not a table reads as none. A vetted
	table is handed as it is, so two answers may share one; any other table is a frozen copy (Guards).

	Return type: A plain table of functions.
	Example usage:
		local Shown = GameValues.CopyForGame(Given.State)
--]=]

local Cache = require("../Keys/DataStore/Cache")
local CutShapes = require("../Shared/ResetShapes")
local Events = require("../Shared/Events")
local Fates = require("../Keys/Format/Items/Fates")
local Guards = require("../Keys/Ops/Guards")
local Handles = require("./Handles")
local HotShapes = require("../Shared/QuantityShapes")
local Keys = require("./Validate/Keys")
local Names = require("../Keys/Encoding/Names")
local Record = require("../Keys/Constants/Record")
local Shapes = require("../Shared/Shapes")
local Types = require("../Types")
local Value = require("../Keys/Format/Value")
local WritingAnswers = require("../Keys/DataStore/Answers")

type AskedName = Shapes.AskedName
type CutAnswer = CutShapes.CutAnswer
type Emitted = WritingAnswers.Emitted
type FateOp = Types.FateOp
type LossRecords = Types.LossRecords
type Fields = Value.Fields
type GivenName = Events.GivenName
type Closed = Types.Closed
type HoldHandle = HotShapes.HoldHandle
type QuantityDeclaration = HotShapes.QuantityDeclaration
type PartReason = Fates.PartReason
type Took = HotShapes.Took
type Identity = Types.Identity
type InfoKey = Types.InfoKey
type KeysMode = Types.KeysMode
type Name = Types.Name
type ShortReason = Types.ShortReason
type StoreKey = Names.StoreKey

local ApplyNotATable = "GameValues: the core answered Apply true with a value that is not a table. "
	.. "An Apply's true must carry its name"
local CutNotATable = "GameValues: the core answered a cut true with a value that is not a table. "
	.. "A cut's true must carry its name"
local FateNotATable = "GameValues: the core emitted a fate that is not a table. A fate must be a table"
local FateOpNotATable = "GameValues: the core emitted a fate whose op terms are not a table. "
	.. "A fate's op must be a table"
local NotALegStore =
	"GameValues: a Tx answer names a key of a store that none of its legs is in. The core names a leg's key"
local LossesNotATable = "GameValues: the core answered Losses with a value that is not a table. "
	.. "Losses must answer the key's loss records"
local TookNotATable = "GameValues: the core answered a Take true with a value that is not a table. "
	.. "A Take's true must carry the part it took from"
local HoldNotATable = "GameValues: the core answered a Hold true with a value that is not a table. "
	.. "A Hold's true must carry its handle"
local ClosedNotATable = "GameValues: the core answered a Close true with a value that is not a table. "
	.. "A Close's true must carry the parts removed, left and missing"
local ConfirmNotATable = "GameValues: the core answered a Confirm true with a value that is not a table. "
	.. "A Confirm's true must carry the part it took from"
local IdNotATable = "GameValues: the core answered Id with a name that is not a table. Id must answer a drawn name"

local ShortReasons = Fates.ShortReason

local ShortReasonOfPart: { [PartReason]: ShortReason } = {
	[ShortReasons.Free] = ShortReasons.Free,
	[ShortReasons.Held] = ShortReasons.Held,
	[ShortReasons.Holds] = ShortReasons.Holds,
	[ShortReasons.Gone] = ShortReasons.Gone,
}

local function NotAShortReason(Reason: PartReason?): string
	return `GameValues: the core answered Short with the reason {Reason}, which no Short gives. `
		.. "A Short's reason is Free, Held, Holds or Gone"
end

local function CopyForGame(Value: unknown): unknown
	if type(Value) ~= "table" then
		return Value
	end
	return Guards.SharedOrFrozenCopy(Value :: Fields)
end

local function IdentityForGame(Held: Identity?): Identity?
	local Copy = CopyForGame(Held)
	if type(Copy) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	return Copy :: Identity
end

local function EmittedForGame(Fate: Emitted): Emitted
	local Copy = CopyForGame(Fate)
	if type(Copy) ~= "table" then
		error(FateNotATable, 0)
	end
	return Copy :: Emitted
end

local function FateOpForGame(OpKind: string, Terms: unknown): FateOp
	if type(Terms) ~= "table" then
		error(FateOpNotATable, 0)
	end
	local Copy = Guards.DeepCopy(Terms :: Fields)
	Copy.Kind = OpKind
	Guards.DeepFreeze(Copy)
	return Copy :: FateOp
end

local function NameForGame(Given: GivenName?): Name?
	if Given == nil then
		return nil
	end
	return Handles.PublicNameOf(Given)
end

local function RecordsForGame(Value: unknown): LossRecords
	local Copy = CopyForGame(Value)
	if type(Copy) ~= "table" then
		error(LossesNotATable, 0)
	end
	return Copy :: LossRecords
end

local function CutValueOf(Value: unknown): CutAnswer
	if type(Value) ~= "table" then
		error(CutNotATable, 0)
	end
	return Value :: CutAnswer
end

local function ApplyNameOf(Value: unknown): AskedName
	if type(Value) ~= "table" then
		error(ApplyNotATable, 0)
	end
	return Value :: AskedName
end

local function DrawnOf(Value: unknown): AskedName
	if type(Value) ~= "table" then
		error(IdNotATable, 0)
	end
	return Value :: AskedName
end

local function IsGameKey(Key: StoreKey?): boolean
	return Key ~= nil and Cache.KindOfKey(Key) == Record.KeyKind.Game
end

local function InfoKeyOf(Key: StoreKey?, KeysByStore: { [string]: KeysMode }): InfoKey?
	if Key == nil or not IsGameKey(Key) then
		return nil
	end
	local Mode = KeysByStore[Key.Store]
	if Mode == nil then
		error(NotALegStore, 0)
	end
	local Made: InfoKey = { Store = Key.Store, Key = Keys.GameKeyOf(Mode, Key) }
	return table.freeze(Made)
end

local function TookForGame(Value: unknown): Took
	local Copy = CopyForGame(Value)
	if type(Copy) ~= "table" then
		error(TookNotATable, 0)
	end
	return Copy :: Took
end

local function HoldHandleOf(Value: unknown, Quantity: QuantityDeclaration): HoldHandle
	local Copy = CopyForGame(Value)
	if type(Copy) ~= "table" then
		error(HoldNotATable, 0)
	end
	return Handles.HoldOf(Copy :: HoldHandle, Quantity)
end

local function ClosedForGame(Value: unknown): Closed
	local Copy = CopyForGame(Value)
	if type(Copy) ~= "table" then
		error(ClosedNotATable, 0)

	return Copy :: Closed
end

local function ConfirmedOf(Value: unknown): Took
	if type(Value) ~= "table" then

local function ShortReasonOf(Reason: PartReason?): ShortReason
	local Short = if Reason == nil then nil else ShortReasonOfPart[Reason]
	if Short == nil then

return {

	EmittedForGame = EmittedForGame,

	TookForGame = TookForGame,

	ClosedForGame = ClosedForGame,
	ConfirmedOf = ConfirmedOf,
	ShortReasonOf = ShortReasonOf,

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Handles: the frozen handles Ledger gives the game, OpId, Applied and a hold's handle. Each is kept weakly, so a
	look-alike table is refused; an Applied one with its key, a hold's with its quantity. A drawn name the core hands
	back becomes an OpId kept as handed back, a game name its text; AskedOf gives back the core's name.

	Return type: A plain table of functions.
	Example usage:
		local OpId = Handles.OpIdOf(Drawn)
		local Asked = Handles.AskedOf(OpId)
--]=]

local Events = require("../Shared/Events")
local Guards = require("../Keys/Ops/Guards")
local HotShapes = require("../Shared/QuantityShapes")
local Names = require("../Keys/Encoding/Names")
local Shapes = require("../Shared/Shapes")
local Types = require("../Types")

type AskedName = Shapes.AskedName
type GivenName = Events.GivenName
type HoldHandle = HotShapes.HoldHandle
type QuantityDeclaration = HotShapes.QuantityDeclaration
type StoreKey = Names.StoreKey
type Applied = Types.Applied
type Name = Types.Name
type OpId = Types.OpId

type Handed = { read Name: AskedName }

local Made: { [unknown]: true } = {}
setmetatable(Made, { __mode = "k" })
local AppliedKeys: { [unknown]: StoreKey } = {}
setmetatable(AppliedKeys, { __mode = "k" })
local HoldQuantities: { [unknown]: QuantityDeclaration } = {}
setmetatable(HoldQuantities, { __mode = "k" })
local HandedBack: { [unknown]: true } = {}
setmetatable(HandedBack, { __mode = "k" })

local function Registered<Handle>(Handle: Handle): Handle
	Made[Handle] = true
	Guards.DeepFreeze(Handle)
	return Handle
end

local function OpIdOf(Name: AskedName): OpId
	local Handle: Handed = { Name = Name }
	return Registered(Handle)
end

local function AppliedOf(Name: AskedName, CallId: number, Key: StoreKey): Applied
	local Handle: Applied = { Name = Name, CallId = CallId, Key = table.clone(Key) }
	AppliedKeys[Handle] = table.clone(Key)
	return Registered(Handle)
end

local function HoldOf(Handle: HoldHandle, Quantity: QuantityDeclaration): HoldHandle
	HoldQuantities[Handle] = Quantity
	return Handle
end

local function PublicNameOf(Given: GivenName): Name
	if Given.Kind == "Game" then
		return Given.Text
	end
	local Handle = OpIdOf(Given)
	HandedBack[Handle] = true
	return Handle
end

local function AppliedKeyOf(Value: unknown): StoreKey?
	return AppliedKeys[Value]
end

local function IsHandle(Value: unknown): boolean
	return Made[Value] == true
end

local function IsHandedBack(Value: unknown): boolean
	return HandedBack[Value] == true
end

local function IsHoldHandle(Value: unknown): boolean
	return HoldQuantities[Value] ~= nil
end

local function HoldQuantityOf(Value: unknown): QuantityDeclaration?
	return HoldQuantities[Value]
end

local function AskedOf(Handle: OpId | Applied): AskedName
	local Held = Handle :: Handed
	return Held.Name
end

return {
	OpIdOf = OpIdOf,
	AppliedOf = AppliedOf,
	HoldOf = HoldOf,
	PublicNameOf = PublicNameOf,
	AppliedKeyOf = AppliedKeyOf,
	IsHandle = IsHandle,
	IsHandedBack = IsHandedBack,
	IsHoldHandle = IsHoldHandle,
	HoldQuantityOf = HoldQuantityOf,
	AskedOf = AskedOf,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Pager: the pages Store:Keys and Store:Versions give, over ListKeysAsync and ListVersionsAsync on the store's own
	DataStore and scope. Next asks for one page a request and keeps no list. Keys leaves Ledger's own keys out, so a
	page can be empty. It answers nil, nil after the last page, nil, Unresolved on a failed fetch (retried, no page
	skipped), nil, Closed after CloseAll begins.

	Return type: The Pager class.
	Example usage:
		local Pages = Pager.Keys(Vault, Settings, "guild:")
		local Page, Why = Pages:Next()
--]=]

local Args = require("./Validate/Args")
local Keys = require("./Validate/Keys")
local Names = require("../Keys/Encoding/Names")
local Reasons = require("../Keys/Constants/Reasons")
local Runner = require("../Roblox/Runner")
local Services = require("../Roblox/Services")
local ShellSetup = require("../Roblox/Setup")
local Stores = require("./Validate/Stores")
local Types = require("../Types")

type KeysMode = ShellSetup.KeysMode
type KeyVersion = Services.KeyVersion
type Page<Entry> = Services.Page<Entry>
type PageResult<Entry> = Services.PageResult<Entry>
type Reason = Types.Reason
type Settings = ShellSetup.Settings
type StoreKey = Names.StoreKey

type Listing<Entry, Item> = {
	read Where: string,
	read First: () -> PageResult<Entry>,
	read Read: (Pages: Pages) -> PageResult<Entry>,
	read Items: (Entries: { Entry }) -> { Item },
}

type PagerData<Entry, Item> = {
	read Store: unknown,
	read StoreName: string,
	read Listing: Listing<Entry, Item>,
	Latest: Page<Entry>?,
	IsAdvanced: boolean,
}

local KeysWhere = "KeyPages:Next"
local VersionsWhere = "VersionPages:Next"

local function GameKeysOf(Mode: KeysMode, Listed: { string }): { string | number }
	local GameKeys: { string | number } = {}
	for _, Name in Listed do
		local Key = Keys.ListedKeyOf(Mode, Name)
		if Key ~= nil then
			table.insert(GameKeys, Key)
		end
	end
	return GameKeys
end

local function SameVersions(Versions: { KeyVersion }): { KeyVersion }
	return Versions
end

local Pager = {}
Pager.__index = Pager

export type Pager<Entry, Item> = setmetatable<PagerData<Entry, Item>, typeof(Pager)>

local function NewPager<Entry, Item>(Store: unknown, Name: string, Listing: Listing<Entry, Item>): Pager<Entry, Item>
	local Data: PagerData<Entry, Item> =
		{ Store = Store, StoreName = Name, Listing = Listing, Latest = nil, IsAdvanced = false }
	return setmetatable(Data, Pager)
end

local function Settled<Entry, Item>(self: Pager<Entry, Item>, Fetched: PageResult<Entry>): ({ Item }?, Reason?)
	if Fetched.Kind == "Err" then
		return nil, Reasons.Unresolved
	end
	self.Latest = Fetched.Page
	self.IsAdvanced = false
	return self.Listing.Items(Fetched.Page.Entries), nil
end

function Pager.Keys(Store: unknown, Settings: Settings, Prefix: string?): Pager<string, string | number>
	local Listing: Listing<string, string | number> = {
		Where = KeysWhere,
		First = function(): PageResult<string>
			return Services.ListKeys(Settings.Name, ShellSetup.StoreScope, Prefix)
		end,
		Read = Services.ReadKeys,
		Items = function(Listed: { string }): { string | number }
			return GameKeysOf(Settings.Keys, Listed)
		end,
	}
	return NewPager(Store, Settings.Name, Listing)
end

function Pager.Versions(Store: unknown, Settings: Settings, Target: StoreKey): Pager<KeyVersion, KeyVersion>
	local Listing: Listing<KeyVersion, KeyVersion> = {
		Where = VersionsWhere,
		First = function(): PageResult<KeyVersion>
			return Services.ListVersions(Target)
		end,
		Read = Services.ReadVersions,
		Items = SameVersions,
	}
	return NewPager(Store, Settings.Name, Listing)
end

function Pager.Next<Entry, Item>(self: Pager<Entry, Item>): ({ Item }?, Reason?)
	local Listing = self.Listing
	Args.OutsideStep(Listing.Where)
	Stores.CheckLive(self.Store, self.StoreName)
	Args.OutsideListener(Listing.Where)
	if Runner.IsClosing() then
		return nil, Reasons.Closed
	end
	local Latest = self.Latest
	if Latest == nil then
		return Settled(self, Listing.First())
	end
	if Latest.IsLast then
		return nil, nil
	end
	if not self.IsAdvanced then
		if Services.AdvancePages(Latest.Pages).Kind ~= "Ok" then
			return nil, Reasons.Unresolved
		end
		self.IsAdvanced = true
	end
	return Settled(self, Listing.Read(Latest.Pages))
end

return Pager

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	ProbeAdvice: the warning a DidApply asked without the probe flag earns when it answers Unresolved for a timed name,
	once per store. Without the flag the read writes nothing, so it can answer true or Unresolved and never false.

	Return type: A plain table with Heard.
	Example usage:
		ProbeAdvice.Heard(Settings.Name, Asked, IsProbe, Answered)
--]=]

local Events = require("../Shared/Events")
local Reasons = require("../Keys/Constants/Reasons")
local Shapes = require("../Shared/Shapes")

type Answer = Events.Answer
type AskedName = Shapes.AskedName

local Warned: { [string]: true } = {}

local function Advice(Store: string): string
	return `Ledger: DidApply on the store {Store} answered Unresolved for a name with a first send time. It was asked `
		.. "without Probe = true, so it read and wrote nothing and can only answer true or Unresolved. "
		.. "Ask again with Probe = true to get true or false. Ledger warns of this once per store."
end

local function IsTimed(Asked: AskedName): boolean
	return Asked.Kind == "Drawn" or (Asked.Kind == "Game" and Asked.Stamp ~= nil)
end

local function Heard(Store: string, Asked: AskedName, IsProbe: boolean, Given: Answer)
	if IsProbe or Warned[Store] ~= nil or not IsTimed(Asked) then
		return
	end
	if Given.Kind == "Failed" and Given.Reason == Reasons.Unresolved then
		Warned[Store] = true
		warn(Advice(Store))
	end
end

return {
	Heard = Heard,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Quantity: the object Store:Quantity gives for a declared quantity (hot keys 2.1 to 2.6), one per name. Each method
	refuses a destroyed store, checks its arguments, throws inside a Ledger stream's listener, sends one call and maps
	its answer through Answers. AskTotal is the store's (a declared total) and the quantity's (its parts) one Total
	call. An unopened or closed quantity's Missing warns once.

	Return type: The Quantity class.
	Example usage:
		local Tickets = Store:Quantity("Tickets")
		local Ok, Took, Info = Tickets:Take(1, { Price = 50 })
--]=]

local Answers = require("./Answers")
local Args = require("./Validate/Args")
local Cache = require("../Keys/DataStore/Cache")
local Calls = require("../Roblox/Calls")
local Events = require("../Shared/Events")
local GetOrMake = require("../Util/GetOrMake")
local HotShapes = require("../Shared/QuantityShapes")
local Moves = require("./Validate/Moves")
local Platform = require("../Roblox/Platform")
local QuantityArgs = require("./Validate/Quantity")
local Reasons = require("../Keys/Constants/Reasons")
local Record = require("../Keys/Constants/Record")
local Runner = require("../Roblox/Runner")
local ShellSetup = require("../Roblox/Setup")
local Stores = require("./Validate/Stores")
local Types = require("../Types")

type Answer = Events.Answer
type Call = Events.Call
type Closed = Types.Closed
type ConfirmOptions = Types.ConfirmOptions
type Deposit = Moves.Deposit
type DepositOptions = Types.DepositOptions
type GatherOptions = Types.GatherOptions
type HoldHandle = HotShapes.HoldHandle
type Info = Types.Info
type KeyOfStore = Types.KeyOfStore
type QuantityDeclaration = HotShapes.QuantityDeclaration
type Reason = Types.Reason
type Settings = ShellSetup.Settings
type TakeOptions = Types.TakeOptions
type Took = HotShapes.Took
type WithdrawOptions = Types.WithdrawOptions

type QuantityData = {
	read Store: unknown,
	read Settings: Settings,
	read Declaration: QuantityDeclaration,
}

local NoStockUntilOpen = "A quantity has no stock until Quantity:Open() is called once (a repeat Open changes "
	.. "nothing), or it was closed and its parts removed"

local NoPartsWarned: { [string]: { [string]: boolean } } = {}

local function NoParts(Store: string, Quantity: string, Where: string): string
	return `Ledger: store {Store}, quantity {Quantity}: {Where} answered Missing, since the quantity's parts do not `
		.. `exist. {NoStockUntilOpen}`
end

local function NewWarnedSet(): { [string]: boolean }
	return {}
end

local function IsNoParts(Answered: Answer): boolean
	if Answered.Kind ~= "Failed" or Answered.Reason ~= Reasons.Missing then
		return false
	end
	local Key = Answered.Key
	return Key == nil or Cache.KindOfKey(Key) == Record.KeyKind.Part
end

local function WarnIfNoParts(Store: string, Quantity: string, Answered: Answer, Where: string): ()
	if not IsNoParts(Answered) then
		return
	end
	local Warned = GetOrMake.GetOrMake(NoPartsWarned, Store, NewWarnedSet)
	if Warned[Quantity] then
		return
	end
	Warned[Quantity] = true
	warn(NoParts(Store, Quantity, Where))
end

local function GatherCallOf(
	Settings: Settings,
	Declaration: QuantityDeclaration,
	Units: number,
	Gathering: Moves.Gathering
): Call
	return {
		Kind = "Call",
		Method = "Take" :: "Take",
		IsGather = true,
		CallId = Calls.NewCallId(),
		Store = Settings.Name,
		Scope = ShellSetup.StoreScope,
		Quantity = Declaration,
		Count = Units,
		Receiver = Gathering.Receiver,
		PartLegsMost = Gathering.PartLegsMost,
		Name = Gathering.Name,
		Fraction = Platform.Fraction(),
	}
end

local function DepositCallOf(Settings: Settings, Declaration: QuantityDeclaration, Units: number, Given: Deposit): Call
	local From = Given.From
	if From.Kind == "Key" then
		return {
			Kind = "Call",
			Method = "Deposit" :: "Deposit",
			IsMinted = false,
			CallId = Calls.NewCallId(),
			Store = Settings.Name,
			Scope = ShellSetup.StoreScope,
			Quantity = Declaration,
			Count = Units,
			To = Given.To,
			From = From.Leg,
		}
	end
	return {
		Kind = "Call",
		Method = "Deposit" :: "Deposit",
		IsMinted = true,
		CallId = Calls.NewCallId(),
		Store = Settings.Name,
		Scope = ShellSetup.StoreScope,
		Quantity = Declaration,
		Count = Units,
		To = Given.To,
		Fraction = Platform.Fraction(),
	}
end

local Quantity = {}
Quantity.__index = Quantity

export type Quantity = setmetatable<QuantityData, typeof(Quantity)>

function Quantity.AskTotal(
	Store: unknown,
	Settings: Settings,
	Name: unknown,
	Of: QuantityDeclaration?,
	MaxAge: unknown,
	Where: string
): (unknown, Reason?)
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	Stores.CheckLive(Store, Settings.Name)
	local Declared = if Of ~= nil then QuantityArgs.PartsOf(Of) else QuantityArgs.StoreTotalOf(Settings, Name, Where)
	local Age = QuantityArgs.TotalMaxAge(MaxAge, Where)
	Args.OutsideListener(Where)
	local Made: Call = {
		Kind = "Call",
		Method = "Total" :: "Total",
		CallId = Calls.NewCallId(),
		Store = Settings.Name,
		Scope = ShellSetup.StoreScope,
		Total = Declared,
		MaxAge = Age,
		Fraction = Platform.Fraction(),
	}
	return Answers.ReadAnswer(Runner.Call(Made):Wait())
end

function Quantity.New(Store: unknown, Settings: Settings, Declaration: QuantityDeclaration): Quantity
	local Data: QuantityData = { Store = Store, Settings = Settings, Declaration = Declaration }
	return setmetatable(Data, Quantity)
end

function Quantity.Total(self: Quantity, MaxAge: number?): (unknown, Reason?)
	return Quantity.AskTotal(
		self.Store,
		self.Settings,
		self.Declaration.Name,
		self.Declaration,
		MaxAge,
		"Quantity:Total"
	)
end

function Quantity.Take(self: Quantity, Count: number, Options: TakeOptions?): (boolean, Took | Reason, Info?)
	local Where = "Quantity:Take"
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	local Settings = self.Settings
	Stores.CheckLive(self.Store, Settings.Name)
	local Units = QuantityArgs.Count(Count, Where)
	local Price, Name, Checked = QuantityArgs.TakeOptions(Settings, self.Declaration, Units, Options, Where)
	Args.OutsideListener(Where)
	local Made: Call = {
		Kind = "Call",
		Method = "Take" :: "Take",
		IsGather = false,
		CallId = Calls.NewCallId(),
		Store = Settings.Name,
		Scope = ShellSetup.StoreScope,
		Quantity = self.Declaration,
		Count = Units,
		Price = Price,
		Name = Name,
		Legs = Checked.Legs,
		Fraction = Platform.Fraction(),
	}
	local Answered, Outcome = Runner.CallWithOutcome(Made):Wait()
	WarnIfNoParts(Settings.Name, self.Declaration.Name, Answered, Where)
	local Ok, Result, Info = Answers.TakeAnswer(Answered, Checked.KeysByStore)
	return Ok, Result, Answers.WithOutcome(Info, Outcome)
end

function Quantity.Hold(self: Quantity, Count: number, Duration: number): (boolean, HoldHandle | Reason, Info?)
	local Where = "Quantity:Hold"
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	local Settings = self.Settings
	Stores.CheckLive(self.Store, Settings.Name)
	local Units = QuantityArgs.Count(Count, Where)
	local Lasting = QuantityArgs.Duration(Settings, Duration, Where)
	Args.OutsideListener(Where)
	local Made: Call = {
		Kind = "Call",
		Method = "Hold" :: "Hold",
		CallId = Calls.NewCallId(),
		Store = Settings.Name,
		Scope = ShellSetup.StoreScope,
		Quantity = self.Declaration,
		Count = Units,
		Duration = Lasting,
		Fraction = Platform.Fraction(),
	}
	local Answered = Runner.Call(Made):Wait()
	WarnIfNoParts(Settings.Name, self.Declaration.Name, Answered, Where)
	return Answers.HoldAnswer(Answered, self.Declaration)
end

function Quantity.Gather(
	self: Quantity,
	Count: number,
	To: KeyOfStore,
	Field: string,
	Options: GatherOptions?
): (boolean, Reason?, Info?)
	local Where = "Quantity:Gather"
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	local Settings = self.Settings
	Stores.CheckLive(self.Store, Settings.Name)
	local Units = QuantityArgs.Count(Count, Where)
	local Gathering = Moves.Gathering(Settings, self.Declaration, Units, To, Field, Options, Where)
	Args.OutsideListener(Where)
	local Made = GatherCallOf(Settings, self.Declaration, Units, Gathering)
	return Answers.GatherAnswer(Runner.Call(Made):Wait(), Gathering.KeysByStore)
end

function Quantity.Open(self: Quantity): (boolean, Reason?, Info?)
	local Where = "Quantity:Open"
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	local Settings = self.Settings
	Stores.CheckLive(self.Store, Settings.Name)
	QuantityArgs.OpenAllowed(Settings, self.Declaration, Where)
	Args.OutsideListener(Where)
	local Made: Call = {
		Kind = "Call",
		Method = "Open" :: "Open",
		CallId = Calls.NewCallId(),
		Store = Settings.Name,
		Scope = ShellSetup.StoreScope,
		Quantity = self.Declaration,
	}
	return Answers.Plain(Runner.Call(Made):Wait())
end

function Quantity.Close(self: Quantity): (boolean, Closed | Reason, Info?)
	local Where = "Quantity:Close"
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	local Settings = self.Settings
	Stores.CheckLive(self.Store, Settings.Name)
	Args.OutsideListener(Where)
	local Made: Call = {
		Kind = "Call",
		Method = "Close" :: "Close",

	return Answers.CloseAnswer(Runner.Call(Made):Wait())
end

function Quantity.Confirm(
	self: Quantity,
	Hold: HoldHandle,

): (boolean, (number | Reason)?, Info?)
	local Where = "Quantity:Confirm"
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	local Settings = self.Settings
	Stores.CheckLive(self.Store, Settings.Name)
	local Handle = Moves.HoldHandle(self.Declaration, Hold, Where)
	local Price, Checked = Moves.ConfirmOptions(Settings, self.Declaration, Handle, Options, Where)
	Args.OutsideListener(Where)
	local Made: Call = {
		Kind = "Call",
		Method = "Confirm" :: "Confirm",
		CallId = Calls.NewCallId(),
		Store = Settings.Name,
		Scope = ShellSetup.StoreScope,
		Quantity = self.Declaration,
		Hold = Handle,
		Price = Price,
		Legs = Checked.Legs,
		Fraction = Platform.Fraction(),
	}
	return Answers.ConfirmAnswer(Runner.Call(Made):Wait(), Checked.KeysByStore)
end

function Quantity.Release(self: Quantity, Hold: HoldHandle): (boolean, Reason?, Info?)
	local Where = "Quantity:Release"
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	local Settings = self.Settings
	Stores.CheckLive(self.Store, Settings.Name)
	local Handle = Moves.HoldHandle(self.Declaration, Hold, Where)
	Args.OutsideListener(Where)
	local Made: Call = {
		Kind = "Call",
		Method = "ReleaseHold" :: "ReleaseHold",
		CallId = Calls.NewCallId(),
		Store = Settings.Name,
		Scope = ShellSetup.StoreScope,
		Quantity = self.Declaration,
		Hold = Handle,
		Fraction = Platform.Fraction(),
	}
	return Answers.Plain(Runner.Call(Made):Wait())
end

function Quantity.Deposit(self: Quantity, Count: number, Options: DepositOptions?): (boolean, Reason?, Info?)
	local Where = "Quantity:Deposit"
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	local Settings = self.Settings
	Stores.CheckLive(self.Store, Settings.Name)
	local Units = QuantityArgs.Count(Count, Where)
	local Given = Moves.Deposit(Settings, self.Declaration, Units, Options, Where)
	Args.OutsideListener(Where)
	local Made = DepositCallOf(Settings, self.Declaration, Units, Given)
	local Answered = Runner.Call(Made):Wait()
	WarnIfNoParts(Settings.Name, self.Declaration.Name, Answered, Where)
	if Given.From.Kind == "Key" then
		return Answers.MoveAnswer(Answered, Given.KeysByStore)
	end
	return Answers.DepositAnswer(Answered, Given.KeysByStore)
end

function Quantity.Withdraw(
	self: Quantity,
	Count: unknown,
	Part: number,
	To: number | KeyOfStore,
	Field: string,
	Options: WithdrawOptions?
): (boolean, Reason?, Info?)
	local Where = "Quantity:Withdraw"
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	local Settings = self.Settings
	Stores.CheckLive(self.Store, Settings.Name)
	local Moved = Moves.Withdraw(Settings, self.Declaration, Count, Part, To, Field, Options, Where)
	Args.OutsideListener(Where)
	local Made: Call = {
		Kind = "Call",
		Method = "Withdraw" :: "Withdraw",
		CallId = Calls.NewCallId(),
		Store = Settings.Name,
		Scope = ShellSetup.StoreScope,
		Quantity = self.Declaration,
		Part = Moved.Part,
		Field = Moved.Field,
		Amount = Moved.Amount,
		To = Moved.To,
	}
	local Answered = Runner.Call(Made):Wait()
	WarnIfNoParts(Settings.Name, self.Declaration.Name, Answered, Where)
	return Answers.MoveAnswer(Answered, Moved.KeysByStore)
end

return Quantity

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Session: a player's key from Load to its Release's answer (record 6), the object the game holds. A released object
	throws, never reaching the core. An Apply inside a listener delivers its view nested, so Get is current. An op's
	fate is unknown when it came back Unknown or has not come. Refresh reads at most once at a time.

	Return type: A plain table with New, Phase, PhaseOf, Opened, NotOpened, EndUnanswered, MarkLeaving, End,
	WaitForLoad, LoadFailureOf, WaitForEnd and UnknownFateCount, and the Session type.
	Example usage:
		local Ok, Handle, Info = Session:Apply({ Kind = "AddGold", Amount = 5 })
		local Took, Reason, Queued = Session:DidApply(Handle)
--]=]

local Answers = require("./Answers")
local Args = require("./Validate/Args")
local Calls = require("../Roblox/Calls")
