type Answer = Events.Answer
type Applied = Types.Applied
type AskedName = Shapes.AskedName
type Call = Events.Call
type CommitOptions = Types.CommitOptions
type Connection = Observer.Connection
type DidApplyInfo = Types.DidApplyInfo
type DidApplyOptions = Types.DidApplyOptions
type Fate = Types.Fate
type FateEmission = WritingAnswers.FateEmission
type Future<T...> = Future.Future<T...>
type Info = Types.Info
type Name = Types.Name
type Observer<T> = Observer.Observer<T>
type Op = Types.Op
type Reason = Types.Reason
type Settings = ShellSetup.Settings
type StoreKey = Names.StoreKey
type Subject<T> = Observer.Subject<T>

type Fated = { read Emission: FateEmission, read Handle: Applied }

local Phase = {
	Loading = "Loading" :: "Loading",
	Leaving = "Leaving" :: "Leaving",
	Loaded = "Loaded" :: "Loaded",
	Releasing = "Releasing" :: "Releasing",
	Released = "Released" :: "Released",
}

export type Phase = keyof<typeof(Phase)>

type SessionData = {
	read Settings: Settings,
	read Player: Player,
	read Key: StoreKey,
	Phase: Phase,
	LoadFailure: Reason?,
	read LoadEnded: Future<boolean>,
	read EndLoad: (IsLoaded: boolean) -> (),
	read Ended: Future<()>,
	read EndSession: () -> (),
	read Handles: { [number]: Applied },
	read Unfated: { [unknown]: true },
	read FateSubject: Subject<Fated>,
	UnknownFates: number,
	FateWatch: Connection?,
	CoreView: unknown,
	GameView: unknown,
}

local NoView = "Session: a loaded session's key has no view kept. The core emits a view whenever a session opens"

local function NotCurrent(Where: string): string
	return `{Where}: the session must be its key's current one, got a released session. Get the player's session again`
end

local function DidApplyCallOf(Key: StoreKey, Asked: AskedName, IsProbe: boolean): Call
	if IsProbe then
		return {
			Kind = "Call",
			Method = "DidApplyWithProbe" :: "DidApplyWithProbe",
			CallId = Calls.NewCallId(),
			Key = Key,
			Name = Asked,
		}
	end
	return { Kind = "Call", Method = "DidApply" :: "DidApply", CallId = Calls.NewCallId(), Key = Key, Name = Asked }
end

local function DidApplyAnswerOf(Made: Call, Asked: AskedName, Where: string): Answer
	if Asked.Kind == "Minted" or Asked.Kind == "Queued" then
		return Runner.CallNow(Made)
	end
	Args.OutsideListener(Where)
	return Runner.Call(Made):Wait()
end

local Session = {}
Session.__index = Session

export type Session = setmetatable<SessionData, typeof(Session)>

local function Current(Object: Session, Where: string)
	if Object.Phase ~= Phase.Loaded then
		error(NotCurrent(Where), 0)
	end
end

local function GameViewOf(Object: Session, View: unknown): unknown
	if View ~= Object.CoreView then
		Object.CoreView = View
		Object.GameView = GameValues.CopyForGame(View)
	end
	return Object.GameView
end

local function NoteFate(Object: Session, Emission: FateEmission)
	local Handle = Object.Handles[Emission.CallId]
	if Handle == nil then
		return
	end
	Object.Handles[Emission.CallId] = nil
	Object.Unfated[Handle] = nil
	if Emission.Fate.Kind == "Unknown" then
		Object.UnknownFates += 1
	end
	Object.FateSubject:Push({ Emission = Emission, Handle = Handle })
end

local function New(Settings: Settings, Player: Player, Key: StoreKey): Session
	local LoadEnded: Future<boolean>, EndLoad: (boolean) -> () = Future.Pending()
	local Ended: Future<()>, EndSession: () -> () = Future.Pending()
	local FateSubject = Observer.New() :: Subject<Fated>
	local Data: SessionData = {
		Settings = Settings,
		Player = Player,
		Key = Key,
		Phase = Phase.Loading,
		LoadEnded = LoadEnded,
		EndLoad = EndLoad,
		Ended = Ended,
		EndSession = EndSession,
		Handles = {},
		Unfated = {},
		FateSubject = FateSubject,
		UnknownFates = 0,
	}
	return setmetatable(Data, Session)
end

local function PhaseOf(Object: Session): Phase
	return Object.Phase
end

local function Opened(Object: Session)
	Object.Phase = Phase.Loaded
	Object.FateWatch = Streams.Fates(Object.Key):Subscribe(function(Emission: FateEmission)
		NoteFate(Object, Emission)
	end)
	Object.EndLoad(true)
end

local function NotOpened(Object: Session, Why: Reason?)
	Object.LoadFailure = Why
	Object.Phase = Phase.Released
	Object.EndLoad(false)
	Object.EndSession()
end

local function EndUnanswered(Object: Session)
	if Object.LoadEnded:Happened() then
		return
	end
	NotOpened(Object, Reasons.Unresolved)
end

local function MarkLeaving(Object: Session)
	if Object.Phase == Phase.Loading then
		Object.Phase = Phase.Leaving
	end
end

local function End(Object: Session): Answer
	local WasLoaded = Object.Phase == Phase.Loaded
	Object.Phase = Phase.Releasing
	local Made: Call = { Kind = "Call", Method = "Release" :: "Release", CallId = Calls.NewCallId(), Key = Object.Key }
	local Given = Runner.Call(Made):Wait()
	local Watch = Object.FateWatch
	if Watch ~= nil then
		Watch:Disconnect()
	end
	Streams.Forget(Object.Key)
	Object.FateSubject:Destroy()
	Object.Phase = Phase.Released
	if not WasLoaded then
		Object.EndLoad(false)
	end
	Object.EndSession()
	return Given
end

local function WaitForLoad(Object: Session): boolean
	Object.LoadEnded:Wait()
	return Object.Phase == Phase.Loaded
end

local function LoadFailureOf(Object: Session): Reason?
	return Object.LoadFailure
end

local function WaitForEnd(Object: Session)
	Object.Ended:Wait()
end

local function UnknownFateCount(Object: Session): number
	local Count = Object.UnknownFates
	for _ in Object.Unfated do
		Count += 1
	end
	return Count
end

function Session.Get(self: Session): unknown
	local Where = "Session:Get"
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	Current(self, Where)
	local View = Streams.ViewOf(self.Key)
	if View == nil then
		error(NoView, 0)
	end
	return GameViewOf(self, View)
end

function Session.Observe(self: Session): Observer<unknown>
	local Where = "Session:Observe"
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	Current(self, Where)
	return Streams.Views(self.Key):Map(function(View: unknown): unknown
		return GameViewOf(self, View)
	end)
end

function Session.ObserveFates(self: Session): Observer<Fate>
	local Where = "Session:ObserveFates"
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	Current(self, Where)
	return self.FateSubject:Map(function(Fated: Fated): Fate
		return Answers.FateOf(Fated.Emission, Fated.Handle)
	end)
end

function Session.Apply(self: Session, Op: Op): (boolean, Applied | Reason, Info?)
	local Where = "Session:Apply"
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	Current(self, Where)
	local OpKind, Terms = Args.Op(self.Settings, Op, Where)
	local Made: Call = {
		Kind = "Call",
		Method = "Apply" :: "Apply",
		CallId = Calls.NewCallId(),
		Key = self.Key,
		OpKind = OpKind,
		Terms = Terms,
	}
	if Runner.WouldWait(Made) then
		Args.OutsideListener(Where)
	end
	local Ok, Handed, Info = Answers.ApplyAnswer(Runner.CallNow(Made), Made.CallId, self.Key)
	if type(Handed) == "table" then
		self.Handles[Made.CallId] = Handed
		self.Unfated[Handed] = true
	end
	return Ok, Handed, Info
end

function Session.Commit(self: Session, Op: Op, Options: CommitOptions?): (boolean, unknown, Info?)
	local Where = "Session:Commit"
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	Current(self, Where)
	local Name = Args.CommitName(Options, Where)
	local OpKind, Terms = Args.Op(self.Settings, Op, Where)
	Args.UntimedWindow(self.Settings, OpKind, Name, Where)
	Args.OutsideListener(Where)
	local Made: Call = {
		Kind = "Call",
		Method = "Commit" :: "Commit",
		CallId = Calls.NewCallId(),
		Key = self.Key,
		OpKind = OpKind,
		Terms = Terms,
		Name = Name,
	}
	local Answered, Outcome = Runner.CallWithOutcome(Made):Wait()
	local Ok, Result, Info = Answers.CommitAnswer(Answered)
	return Ok, Result, Answers.WithOutcome(Info, Outcome)
end

function Session.DidApply(
	self: Session,
	Name: Applied | Name,
	Options: DidApplyOptions?
): (unknown, Reason?, DidApplyInfo?)
	local Where = "Session:DidApply"
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	Current(self, Where)
	local Asked, IsProbe = Args.ProbeName(Name, Options, Where)
	Args.HandleOfKey(self.Key, Name, Where)
	if self.Unfated[Name] then
		return Answers.QueuedAnswer()
	end
	local Made = DidApplyCallOf(self.Key, Asked, IsProbe)
	local Answered = DidApplyAnswerOf(Made, Asked, Where)
	ProbeAdvice.Heard(self.Settings.Name, Asked, IsProbe, Answered)
	return Answers.DidApplyAnswer(Answered)
end

function Session.Flush(self: Session): (boolean, Reason?, Info?)
	local Where = "Session:Flush"
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	Current(self, Where)
	Args.OutsideListener(Where)
	local Made: Call = { Kind = "Call", Method = "Flush" :: "Flush", CallId = Calls.NewCallId(), Key = self.Key }
	return Answers.Plain(Runner.Call(Made):Wait())
end

function Session.Refresh(self: Session): (boolean, Reason?)
	local Where = "Session:Refresh"
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	Current(self, Where)
	Args.OutsideListener(Where)
	local Made: Call = { Kind = "Call", Method = "Refresh" :: "Refresh", CallId = Calls.NewCallId(), Key = self.Key }
	local Ok, Why = Answers.Plain(Runner.Call(Made):Wait())
	return Ok, Why
end

function Session.Release(self: Session): (boolean, Reason?, Info?)
	local Where = "Session:Release"
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	Current(self, Where)
	Args.OutsideListener(Where)
	return Answers.Plain(End(self))
end

return {
	New = New,
	Phase = Phase,
	PhaseOf = PhaseOf,
	Opened = Opened,
	NotOpened = NotOpened,
	EndUnanswered = EndUnanswered,
	MarkLeaving = MarkLeaving,
	End = End,
	WaitForLoad = WaitForLoad,
	LoadFailureOf = LoadFailureOf,
	WaitForEnd = WaitForEnd,
	UnknownFateCount = UnknownFateCount,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Sessions: a player store's Load, Unload, lookups and each key's session until Release answers. Load answers the
	session, nil and the load's reason (after OnLoadFailed, then the kick if Kick), or nil and nil if the player left,
	the server closed or Destroy began meanwhile. A second Load answers as the first. Loading a held key ends its
	session first.

	Return type: A plain table with Load, Unload, Get, Expect, IsLoaded, WaitForLoaded, Read and ReleaseAll.
	Example usage:
		Store.Load = Sessions.Load
		local Session, Reason = Vault:Load(Player)
--]=]

local Args = require("./Validate/Args")
local Calls = require("../Roblox/Calls")
local Events = require("../Shared/Events")
local Future = require("../Util/Future")
local Keys = require("./Validate/Keys")
local Names = require("../Keys/Encoding/Names")
local Reasons = require("../Keys/Constants/Reasons")
local Runner = require("../Roblox/Runner")
local Session = require("./Session")
local ShellSetup = require("../Roblox/Setup")
local Stores = require("./Validate/Stores")
local Threads = require("../Util/Threads")

type Call = Events.Call
type Future<T...> = Future.Future<T...>
type Reason = Reasons.Reason
type Session = Session.Session
type Settings = ShellSetup.Settings

type Holder = {
	read Settings: Settings,
	read Sessions: { [string]: Session },
}

local Phases = Session.Phase

local PlayersService = "Players"

local function NotLoaded(Where: string, Player: Player): string
	return `{Where}: Player must be a player whose session is loaded on this store, got the player with UserId `
		.. `{Player.UserId}`
end

local function IsGone(Player: Player): boolean
	return Player.Parent ~= game:GetService(PlayersService)
end

local function Failed(Settings: Settings, Player: Player, Why: Reason)
	local Handler = Settings.OnLoadFailed
	if Handler ~= nil then
		Threads.Spawn(Handler, Player, Why)
	end
	if Settings.Kick then
		Player:Kick(Settings.KickMessage)
	end
end

local function IsHeldFor(Found: Session, Player: Player): boolean
	local Phase = Session.PhaseOf(Found)
	if Found.Player ~= Player then
		return false
	end
	return Phase == Phases.Loading or Phase == Phases.Leaving or Phase == Phases.Loaded
end

local function Leave(Found: Session)
	if Session.PhaseOf(Found) == Phases.Loaded then
		Session.End(Found)
		return
	end
	Session.MarkLeaving(Found)
	Session.WaitForEnd(Found)
end

local function DropWhenEnded(Store: Holder, Text: string, Found: Session)
	Session.WaitForEnd(Found)
	if Store.Sessions[Text] == Found then
		Store.Sessions[Text] = nil
	end
end

local function HeldOf(Store: Holder, Text: string): Session?
	local Found = Store.Sessions[Text]
	if Found == nil or Session.PhaseOf(Found) == Phases.Released then
		return nil
	end
	return Found
end

local function TextOf(Store: Holder, Player: Player, Where: string): string
	local Checked = Keys.Player(Store.Settings, Player, Where)
	return Names.KeyText(Keys.Key(Store.Settings, Checked, Where))
end

local function FoundOf(Store: Holder, Player: Player, Where: string): Session?
	local Found = HeldOf(Store, TextOf(Store, Player, Where))
	if Found == nil or Found.Player ~= Player then
		return nil
	end
	return Found
end

local function LoadedOf(Store: Holder, Player: Player, Where: string): Session?
	local Found = FoundOf(Store, Player, Where)
	if Found == nil or Session.PhaseOf(Found) ~= Phases.Loaded then
		return nil
	end
	return Found
end

local function HeldSessions(Store: Holder): { Session }
	local Held: { Session } = {}
	for Text in Store.Sessions do
		local Found = HeldOf(Store, Text)
		if Found ~= nil then
			table.insert(Held, Found)
		end
	end
	return Held
end

local function LeaveAll(Leaving: { Session }, Seconds: number)
	if #Leaving == 0 then
		return
	end
	local AllLeft: Future<()>, EndAll: () -> () = Future.Pending()
	local Left = #Leaving
	local function LeaveOne(Found: Session)
		Leave(Found)
		Left -= 1
		if Left == 0 then
			EndAll()
		end
	end
	for _, Found in Leaving do
		Threads.Spawn(LeaveOne, Found)
	end
	AllLeft:Wait(Seconds)
end

local function AnswerOfEarlier(Earlier: Session): (Session?, Reason?)
	if Session.WaitForLoad(Earlier) then
		return Earlier, nil
	end
	return nil, Session.LoadFailureOf(Earlier)
end

local function LoadOpening(Settings: Settings, Player: Player, Opening: Session): (Session?, Reason?)
	local Made: Call = {
		Kind = "Call",
		Method = "Load" :: "Load",
		CallId = Calls.NewCallId(),
		Key = Opening.Key,
		MustExist = Settings.MustExist,
	}
	local Given = Runner.Call(Made):Wait()
	local HasLeft = Session.PhaseOf(Opening) == Phases.Leaving or IsGone(Player)
	if Given.Kind ~= "Succeeded" then
		local IsReported = Given.Reason ~= Reasons.Closed and not HasLeft
		local Why = if IsReported then Given.Reason else nil
		Session.NotOpened(Opening, Why)
		if Why ~= nil then
			Failed(Settings, Player, Why)
		end
		return nil, Why
	end
	if HasLeft then
		Session.End(Opening)
		return nil, nil
	end
	Session.Opened(Opening)
	return Opening, nil
end

local function Load(self: Holder, Player: Player): (Session?, Reason?)
	local Where = "Store:Load"
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	local Settings = self.Settings
	Stores.CheckNotDestroying(self, Settings.Name)
	local Checked = Keys.Player(Settings, Player, Where)
	local Key = Keys.Key(Settings, Checked, Where)
	Args.OutsideListener(Where)
	local Text = Names.KeyText(Key)

	local Earlier = HeldOf(self, Text)
	while Earlier ~= nil do
		if IsHeldFor(Earlier, Checked) then
			return AnswerOfEarlier(Earlier)
		end
		Leave(Earlier)
		Earlier = HeldOf(self, Text)
	end
	if Stores.IsDestroyingOrDestroyed(self) then
		return nil, nil
	end

	local Opening = Session.New(Settings, Checked, Key)
	self.Sessions[Text] = Opening
	Threads.Spawn(DropWhenEnded, self, Text, Opening)
	local IsAnswered, Loaded, Why = pcall(LoadOpening, Settings, Checked, Opening)
	if not IsAnswered then
		Session.EndUnanswered(Opening)
		error(Loaded, 0)
	end
	return Loaded, Why
end

local function Unload(self: Holder, Player: Player): ()
	local Where = "Store:Unload"
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	Stores.CheckLive(self, self.Settings.Name)
	local Found = FoundOf(self, Player, Where)
	Args.OutsideListener(Where)
	if Found ~= nil then
		Leave(Found)
	end
end

local function Get(self: Holder, Player: Player): Session?
	local Where = "Store:Get"
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	Stores.CheckLive(self, self.Settings.Name)
	return LoadedOf(self, Player, Where)
end

local function Expect(self: Holder, Player: Player): Session
	local Where = "Store:Expect"
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	Stores.CheckLive(self, self.Settings.Name)
	local Found = LoadedOf(self, Player, Where)
	if Found == nil then
		error(NotLoaded(Where, Player), 0)
	end
	return Found
end

local function IsLoaded(self: Holder, Player: Player): boolean
	local Where = "Store:IsLoaded"
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	Stores.CheckLive(self, self.Settings.Name)
	return LoadedOf(self, Player, Where) ~= nil
end

local function WaitForLoaded(self: Holder, Player: Player): Session?
	local Where = "Store:WaitForLoaded"
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	Stores.CheckLive(self, self.Settings.Name)
	local Found = FoundOf(self, Player, Where)
	if Found == nil then
		return nil
	end
	if Session.PhaseOf(Found) ~= Phases.Loaded then
		Args.OutsideListener(Where)
	end
	if not Session.WaitForLoad(Found) then
		return nil
	end
	return Found
end

local function Read(self: Holder, Player: Player): unknown
	local Where = "Store:Read"
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	Stores.CheckLive(self, self.Settings.Name)
	local Found = LoadedOf(self, Player, Where)
	if Found == nil then
		return nil
	end
	return Found:Get()
end

local function ReleaseAll(Store: Holder, Seconds: number): number
	local Releasing = HeldSessions(Store)
	LeaveAll(Releasing, Seconds)
	local Unknown = 0
	for _, Found in Releasing do
		Unknown += Session.UnknownFateCount(Found)
	end
	return Unknown
end

return {
	Load = Load,
	Unload = Unload,
	Get = Get,
	Expect = Expect,
	IsLoaded = IsLoaded,
	WaitForLoaded = WaitForLoaded,
	Read = Read,
	ReleaseAll = ReleaseAll,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Store: Ledger.New's object, with its methods on any key and Sessions'. Each but Leg checks its arguments, and each
	but Leg, Keys, Versions and PeekVersion then sends one call and maps its answer through Answers. A MaxAge Peek
	answering Unresolved makes one plain Peek. Keys pages game keys and Versions a key's DataStore versions, for one
	caller at a time; an erased key is not listed. PeekVersion reads one version once, outside the core, and decodes it
	through OldVersion as a step. Destroy ends the sessions, then every method throws.

	Return type: The Store class.
	Example usage:
		local Vault = Store.New(Settings)
		local State, Reason = Vault:Peek("alice")
--]=]

local Reasons = require("../Keys/Constants/Reasons")
local Rules = require("./Validate/Rules")
local Runner = require("../Roblox/Runner")
local Services = require("../Roblox/Services")
local Session = require("./Session")
local Sessions = require("./Sessions")
local Shapes = require("../Shared/Shapes")
local ShellSetup = require("../Roblox/Setup")
local Stepping = require("../Roblox/Stepping")
local Stores = require("./Validate/Stores")
local Streams = require("../Roblox/Streams")
local Types = require("../Types")

type Answer = Events.Answer
type AskedName = Shapes.AskedName
type Call = Events.Call
type Cut = Types.Cut
type DidApplyOptions = Types.DidApplyOptions
type EditOptions = Types.EditOptions
type Info = Types.Info
type KeyLike = Types.KeyLike
type KeyVersion = Types.KeyVersion
type LegOptions = Types.LegOptions
type Observer<T> = Observer.Observer<T>
type LossRecords = Types.LossRecords

type Quantity = Quantity.Quantity

type StoreData = {
	read Settings: Settings,
	read Sessions: { [string]: Session },
	read Follows: { [Observer<unknown>]: true },
	read Stales: { [Observer<string | number>]: true },
	read Quantities: { [string]: Quantity },
}

local WeakKeys = { __mode = "k" }

local FollowWhere = "Store:Follow"
local LegWhere = "Store:Leg"

local VersionRule = Check.TextAtLeast(1)

local LegOptionRules: { [string]: Rule } = {
	MustExist = Check.AnyValue,
	Slot = Check.AnyValue,
}

local IsStaleAsked = false

local function FatesUnknown(Name: string, Count: number): string
	return `Ledger: {Name} was destroyed with {Count} ops of its released sessions whose fate is unknown. `
		.. "They may or may not have been saved."
end

local function FollowOf(Object: unknown, Key: StoreKey): Observer<Answer>
	local function Start()
		Args.OutsideStep(FollowWhere)
		if not Stores.IsLive(Object) then
			return
		end
		local Following: Call = { Kind = "Call", Method = "Follow" :: "Follow", CallId = Calls.NewCallId(), Key = Key }
		Runner.Call(Following)
	end
	local function Stop()
		Args.OutsideStep(FollowWhere)
		if not Stores.IsLive(Object) then
			return
		end
		local Unfollowing: Call =
			{ Kind = "Call", Method = "Unfollow" :: "Unfollow", CallId = Calls.NewCallId(), Key = Key }
		Runner.Call(Unfollowing)
	end
	return Streams.Follows(Key, Start, Stop)
end

local function AskStale()
	if IsStaleAsked then
		return
	end
	IsStaleAsked = true
	local Watching: Call = { Kind = "Call", Method = "Stale" :: "Stale", CallId = Calls.NewCallId() }
	Runner.Call(Watching)
end

local function PlainPeekOf(Key: StoreKey): Call
	return { Kind = "Call", Method = "Peek" :: "Peek", CallId = Calls.NewCallId(), Key = Key }
end

local function PeekCallOf(Key: StoreKey, Freshness: unknown, Where: string): Call
	if Freshness == nil then
		return PlainPeekOf(Key)
	end
	if type(Freshness) ~= "table" then
		local MaxAge = Args.MaxAge(Freshness, Where)
		return {
			Kind = "Call",
			Method = "PeekWithin" :: "PeekWithin",
			CallId = Calls.NewCallId(),
			Key = Key,
			MaxAge = MaxAge,
		}
	end
	if Args.PeekOptions(Freshness, Where) then
		return { Kind = "Call", Method = "PeekFresh" :: "PeekFresh", CallId = Calls.NewCallId(), Key = Key }
	end
	return PlainPeekOf(Key)
end

local function IsFailedWith(Answered: Answer, Reason: Reason): boolean
	return Answered.Kind == "Failed" and Answered.Reason == Reason
end

local function DidApplyCallOf(Key: StoreKey, Asked: AskedName, IsProbe: boolean): Call
	if IsProbe then
		return {
			Kind = "Call",
			Method = "DidApplyWithProbe" :: "DidApplyWithProbe",
			CallId = Calls.NewCallId(),
			Key = Key,
			Name = Asked,
		}
	end
	return { Kind = "Call", Method = "DidApply" :: "DidApply", CallId = Calls.NewCallId(), Key = Key, Name = Asked }
end

local function DidApplyOutsideListener(Asked: AskedName, Where: string)
	if Asked.Kind == "Minted" or Asked.Kind == "Queued" then
		return
	end
	Args.OutsideListener(Where)
end

local function EndEach<T>(Observers: { [Observer<T>]: true })
	local Made = next(Observers)
	while Made ~= nil do
		Observers[Made] = nil
		Made:Destroy()
		Made = next(Observers)
	end
end

local Store = {}
Store.__index = Store

type Leg = {
	read Store: Store,
	read Key: KeyLike,
	read Op: Terms,
	read MustExist: unknown,
	read Slot: unknown,
}

function Store.New(Settings: Settings): Store
	local Follows: { [Observer<unknown>]: true } = {}
	setmetatable(Follows, WeakKeys)
	local Stales: { [Observer<string | number>]: true } = {}
	setmetatable(Stales, WeakKeys)
	local Data: StoreData = { Settings = Settings, Sessions = {}, Follows = Follows, Stales = Stales, Quantities = {} }
	local Made = setmetatable(Data, Store)
	Stores.Register(Made, Settings)
	return Made
end

function Store.Peek(self: Store, Key: KeyLike, Freshness: (number | PeekOptions)?): (unknown, Reason?, Info?)
	local Where = "Store:Peek"
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	Stores.CheckLive(self, self.Settings.Name)
	local Target = Keys.Key(self.Settings, Key, Where)
	local Made = PeekCallOf(Target, Freshness, Where)
	Args.OutsideListener(Where)
	local Answered = Runner.Call(Made):Wait()
	if Made.Method == "PeekWithin" and IsFailedWith(Answered, Reasons.Unresolved) then
		local Plain = Runner.Call(PlainPeekOf(Target)):Wait()
		if not IsFailedWith(Plain, Reasons.Closed) then
			Answered = Plain
		end
	end
	return Answers.PeekAnswer(Answered)
end

function Store.PeekVersion(self: Store, Key: KeyLike, Version: string): (unknown, Reason?)
	local Where = "Store:PeekVersion"
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	local Settings = self.Settings
	Stores.CheckLive(self, Settings.Name)
	local Target = Keys.Key(Settings, Key, Where)
	Check.Table({ Version = Version }, { Version = VersionRule }, Where)
	Args.OutsideListener(Where)
	if Runner.IsClosing() then
		return nil, Reasons.Closed
	end
	local Fetched = Services.GetVersion(Target, Version)
	if Fetched.Kind == "Err" then
		return nil, Reasons.Unresolved
	end
	local Raw = if Fetched.Kind == "Ok" then Fetched.Value else nil
	local Answered = Stepping.Run(OldVersion.AnswerOf, Runner.OpenedSetup(Settings.Name), Raw)
	return Answers.ReadAnswer(Answered)
end

	local Cached = self.Quantities[Declaration.Name]

function Store.Destroy(self: Store): ()
	local Where = "Store:Destroy"
	Args.OutsideStep(Where)
	local Name = self.Settings.Name
	Stores.CheckNotDestroying(self, Name)
	Args.OutsideListener(Where)
	Stores.MarkDestroying(self)
	local Limits = Runner.OpenedSetup(Name).Limits
	local UnknownCount = Sessions.ReleaseAll(self, Limits.ShutdownSeconds - Limits.Jump)
	if UnknownCount > 0 then
		warn(FatesUnknown(Name, UnknownCount))
	end
	EndEach(self.Follows)
	EndEach(self.Stales)
	Stores.Unregister(self)
end

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Calls: what the server does with an arriving call, once Step has its State. First, in order: CloseAll, a call after
	the close began, a Behind session's call, a call that must wait for a number. An Id is closed to only once the close
	ended with no server number; AnswerAtEndedClose then answers the held Ids Closed.

	Return type: A plain table with OnCall, WouldWait, CallIdOf, TouchWriters and AnswerAtEndedClose.
	Example usage:
		Calls.OnCall(State, Call, Clock, Clock, Commands)
--]=]

local Closing = require("../Keys/DataStore/Closing")
local Composed = require("../Shared/Composed")
local CutServer = require("../Features/Resets/Server")
local CutShapes = require("../Shared/ResetShapes")
local DidApply = require("../Keys/DataStore/DidApply")
local Durable = require("../Keys/DataStore/Durable")
local Events = require("../Shared/Events")
local ExtrasServer = require("../Features/Reads/Server")
local ExtrasShapes = require("../Shared/ReadShapes")
local Hearing = require("../Keys/DataStore/Hearing")
local HotServer = require("../Features/Quantity/Server")
local HotShapes = require("../Shared/QuantityShapes")
local InFlight = require("../Keys/DataStore/InFlight")
local Names = require("../Keys/Encoding/Names")
local Numbers = require("../Keys/DataStore/Numbers")
local Reads = require("../Keys/DataStore/Reads")
local Reasons = require("../Keys/Constants/Reasons")
local Replies = require("../Shared/Replies")
local Session = require("../Keys/DataStore/Session")
local Shapes = require("../Shared/Shapes")
local Showables = require("../Keys/DataStore/Showables")
local Sorted = require("../Util/Sorted")
local TxServer = require("../Features/Trades/Server")

type Call = Events.Call
type Command = Events.Command
type DidApplyCall = DidApply.DidApplyCall
type AskedName = Shapes.AskedName
type DurableCall = Durable.DurableCall
type ApplyCall = Session.ApplyCall
type ReleaseCall = Session.ReleaseCall
type LoadCall = Reads.LoadCall
type ReadOut = Reads.ReadOut
type KeyCall = Reads.ReadCall
type IdCall = { read CallId: number }
type EditCall = DurableCall & { read MustExist: boolean }
type PeekCall = KeyCall & { read Method: Events.ReadMethod }
type TxCall = Events.TxCall
type PendingCall = Events.PendingCall
type ResettleCall = Events.ResettleCall
type EraseOrResetCall = CutShapes.EraseCall | CutShapes.ResetCall
type ExtrasCall = ExtrasShapes.ExtrasCall
type HotCall = HotShapes.HotCall
type ServerState = Shapes.ServerState
type HeldCall = Composed.HeldCall
type Held = Composed.Held
type CallHandler = (State, Call, number, number, { Command }) -> ()
type State = Composed.State

local function DrawName(Server: ServerState, CallId: number, Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	local Fresh = Numbers.DrawFreshId(Server)
	local Drawn: AskedName = { Kind = "Drawn", Server = Fresh.Server, Counter = Fresh.Counter, Stamp = Clock }
	Replies.Reply(Commands, CallId, { Kind = "Succeeded", Value = Drawn })
end

local function CallIdOf(Holding: Held): number
	if Holding.Kind == "Held" then
		return Holding.Call.CallId
	end
	return Holding.Out.CallId
end

local function TouchWriters(State: State)
	for _, Store in State.Server.Stores do
		for Text, Writer in Store.Writers do
			Composed.NoteSendableAt(State, Text, Writer.Key)
		end
	end
end

local function NoteSessionsMoved(State: State)
	for Text, Open in State.Sessions.Open do
		Composed.NoteTimersMovedAt(State, Text, Open.Key)
	end
end

local function IsHeldId(Holding: Held): boolean
	return Holding.Kind == "Held" and Holding.Call.Method == "Id"
end

local function AnswerAtEndedClose(State: State, Commands: { Command })
	local Kept: { Held } = {}
	for _, Holding in State.Held do
		if IsHeldId(Holding) then
			Replies.ReplyFailed(Commands, CallIdOf(Holding), Reasons.Closed)
		else
			table.insert(Kept, Holding)
		end
	end
	State.Held = Kept
end

local function CloseLoads(State: State, Commands: { Command })
	local function IsLoad(_: number, Out: ReadOut): boolean
		return Out.Want.Kind == "Load"
	end
	for _, RequestId in Sorted.SortedDueIds(State.Reads, IsLoad) do
		Replies.ReplyFailed(Commands, State.Reads[RequestId].CallId, Reasons.Closed)
		State.Reads[RequestId] = nil
	end
	local Kept: { Held } = {}
	for _, Holding in State.Held do
		if IsHeldId(Holding) then
			table.insert(Kept, Holding)
		else
			Replies.ReplyFailed(Commands, CallIdOf(Holding), Reasons.Closed)
		end
	end
	State.Held = Kept
	TouchWriters(State)
end

local function MustWait(State: State, Call: Call, Clock: number): boolean
	if
		Call.Method == "Id"
		or Call.Method == "Tx"
		or Call.Method == "Resettle"
		or Call.Method == "Erase"
		or Call.Method == "Reset"
	then
		return State.Server.ServerNumber == nil
	end
	if Call.Method == "Apply" or Call.Method == "Edit" or Call.Method == "Commit" then
		return not InFlight.CanWrite(State.Server, Call.Key)
	end
	if Call.Method == "Bump" then
		return ExtrasServer.MustWait(State, Call)
	end
	local Hot = HotServer.HotCallOf(Call)
	if Hot ~= nil then
		return HotServer.MustWait(State, Hot, Clock)
	end
	return false
end

local function IsClosedTo(State: State, Call: Call): boolean
	if Call.Method == "Id" then
		return Closing.IsEnded(State.Sessions) and State.Server.ServerNumber == nil
	end
	return State.Sessions.Shutdown ~= nil
end

local function IsBehindTo(State: State, Call: Call): boolean
	if Call.Method ~= "Apply" and Call.Method ~= "Commit" and Call.Method ~= "Flush" and Call.Method ~= "Refresh" then
		return false
	end
	local Open = State.Sessions.Open[Names.KeyText(Call.Key)]
	return Open ~= nil and Open.IsBehind
end

local function WouldWait(State: State, Call: Call, Clock: number): boolean
	if Call.Method == "CloseAll" or IsClosedTo(State, Call) or IsBehindTo(State, Call) then
		return false
	end
	return MustWait(State, Call, Clock)
end

local function OnId(State: State, Call: IdCall, _Arrived: number, Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	DrawName(State.Server, Call.CallId, Clock, Commands)
end

local function OnLoad(State: State, Call: LoadCall, _Arrived: number, Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	local Out = Reads.StartLoad(State.Server, Call, Clock, Commands)
	State.Reads[Out.RequestId] = Out
end

local function OnApply(State: State, Call: ApplyCall, _Arrived: number, Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	Session.Apply(State.Server, State.Sessions, Call, Clock, Commands)
	Composed.NoteTimersMoved(State, Call.Key)
end

local function OnEdit(State: State, Call: EditCall, Arrived: number, _Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	Durable.Start(State, Call, Call.MustExist, Arrived, Commands)
end

local function OnCommit(State: State, Call: DurableCall, Arrived: number, _Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	local Open = State.Sessions.Open[Names.KeyText(Call.Key)]
	if Open == nil then
		return Replies.ReplyFailed(Commands, Call.CallId, Reasons.Closed)
	end
	Durable.Start(State, Call, not Open.MayCreate, Arrived, Commands)
	Open.PushAsked = true
end

local function OnFlush(State: State, Call: KeyCall, _Arrived: number, Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	Hearing.Flush(State, Call, Clock, Commands)
end

local function OnRefresh(State: State, Call: KeyCall, _Arrived: number, Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	Hearing.Refresh(State, Call, Clock, Commands)
	Composed.NoteTimersMoved(State, Call.Key)
end

local function OnRelease(State: State, Call: ReleaseCall, _Arrived: number, Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	Closing.Release(State.Server, State.Sessions, Call, Clock, Commands)
	Showables.Release(State.Server, Call.Key, Composed.ServedOf(State))
	Composed.NoteSendable(State, Call.Key)
end

local function OnTx(State: State, Call: TxCall, Arrived: number, Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	TxServer.OnCall(State, Call, Arrived, Clock, Commands)
end

local function OnPending(State: State, Call: PendingCall, Arrived: number, Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	TxServer.OnCall(State, Call, Arrived, Clock, Commands)
end

local function OnResettle(State: State, Call: ResettleCall, Arrived: number, Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	TxServer.OnCall(State, Call, Arrived, Clock, Commands)
end

local function OnCut(State: State, Call: EraseOrResetCall, Arrived: number, Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	CutServer.OnCall(State, Call, Arrived, Clock, Commands)
end

local function OnExtras(State: State, Call: ExtrasCall, Arrived: number, Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	ExtrasServer.OnCall(State, Call, Arrived, Clock, Commands)
end

local function OnHot(State: State, Call: HotCall, Arrived: number, Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	HotServer.OnCall(State, Call, Arrived, Clock, Commands)
end

local function OnDidApply(State: State, Call: DidApplyCall, _Arrived: number, Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	local Out = DidApply.DidApply(State.Server, Call, Clock, Commands)
	if Out ~= nil then
		State.Reads[Out.RequestId] = Out
	end
end

local function OnDidApplyWithProbe(
	State: State,
	Call: DidApplyCall,
	_Arrived: number,
	Clock: number,
	Commands: { Command }
)
	local Out = DidApply.DidApplyWithProbe(State.Server, Call, Clock, Commands)
	if Out ~= nil then
		State.Reads[Out.RequestId] = Out
	end
end

local function OnPeek(State: State, Call: PeekCall, _Arrived: number, Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	local Out = Reads.Start(State.Server, Call, Call.Method, Clock, Commands)
	State.Reads[Out.RequestId] = Out
end

local CallHandlers = {
	Id = OnId,
	Load = OnLoad,
	Apply = OnApply,
	Edit = OnEdit,
	Commit = OnCommit,
	Flush = OnFlush,
	Refresh = OnRefresh,
	Release = OnRelease,
	Tx = OnTx,
	Pending = OnPending,
	Resettle = OnResettle,
	Erase = OnCut,
	Reset = OnCut,
	Bump = OnExtras,
	Total = OnExtras,
	Follow = OnExtras,
	Unfollow = OnExtras,
	Stale = OnExtras,
	PeekWithin = OnExtras,
	Take = OnHot,
	Hold = OnHot,
	Open = OnHot,
	Close = OnHot,
	Confirm = OnHot,
	ReleaseHold = OnHot,
	Deposit = OnHot,
	Withdraw = OnHot,
	DidApply = OnDidApply,
	DidApplyWithProbe = OnDidApplyWithProbe,
	Peek = OnPeek,
	Inspect = OnPeek,
	PeekFresh = OnPeek,
	Losses = OnPeek,
}

type HandledMethod = keyof<typeof(CallHandlers)>

local function OnCall(State: State, Call: Call, Arrived: number, Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	if Call.Method == "CloseAll" then
		NoteSessionsMoved(State)
		Closing.CloseAll(State.Server, State.Sessions, Call.CallId, Call.BeganAt or Clock, Commands)
		TxServer.CloseAll(State, Commands)
		CutServer.CloseAll(State, Commands)
		return CloseLoads(State, Commands)
	end
	if IsClosedTo(State, Call) then
		return Replies.ReplyFailed(Commands, Call.CallId, Reasons.Closed)
	end
	if IsBehindTo(State, Call) then
		return Replies.ReplyFailed(Commands, Call.CallId, Reasons.Behind)
	end
	if MustWait(State, Call, Clock) then
		local Holding: HeldCall = { Kind = "Held", Call = Call, At = Arrived }
		table.insert(State.Held, Holding)
		return
	end
	local Handler = (CallHandlers :: { [HandledMethod]: CallHandler })[Call.Method]
	Handler(State, Call, Arrived, Clock, Commands)
end

return {
	OnCall = OnCall,
	WouldWait = WouldWait,
	CallIdOf = CallIdOf,
	TouchWriters = TouchWriters,
	AnswerAtEndedClose = AnswerAtEndedClose,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Step: the server's state machine, step(state, event) -> (state', commands) (Charter item 23); the State is
	Composed's, changed in place.

	A call is held for the server's number; a replay that raises leaves the rest held. Each event sheds what passed
	its queue deadline (an Id's by the server's first Limits recorded) before any send. Only a probe calls FullWake.

	Return type: A plain table with Step and FullWake, and the State type.
	Example usage:
		local State = Composed.NewState(Server)
		Composed.OpenStore(State, Setup)
		local Next, Commands = Step.Step(State, { Clock = Now, Happening = { Kind = "Clock" } })
--]=]

local Adoption = require("../Keys/DataStore/Adoption")
local Cache = require("../Keys/DataStore/Cache")
local Calls = require("./Calls")
local Closing = require("../Keys/DataStore/Closing")
local Composed = require("../Shared/Composed")
local CopiesServer = require("../Features/Reads/Copies/Server")
local CutServer = require("../Features/Resets/Server")
local Events = require("../Shared/Events")
local ExtrasServer = require("../Features/Reads/Server")
local Hearing = require("../Keys/DataStore/Hearing")
local HotServer = require("../Features/Quantity/Server")
local InFlight = require("../Keys/DataStore/InFlight")
local Numbers = require("../Keys/DataStore/Numbers")
local Reasons = require("../Keys/Constants/Reasons")
local Replies = require("../Shared/Replies")
local Sending = require("../Keys/DataStore/Sending")
local Shapes = require("../Shared/Shapes")
local Shedding = require("../Keys/DataStore/Shedding")
local StepAnswer = require("../Features/Trades/Call/StepAnswer")
local Touch = require("../Features/Trades/Work/Touch")
local TxServer = require("../Features/Trades/Server")
local Waking = require("../Keys/DataStore/Waking")
local Writers = require("../Keys/DataStore/Writer")
local Writing = require("../Keys/DataStore/Writing")

type Call = Events.Call
type Command = Events.Command
type Event = Events.Event
type Outcome = Events.Outcome
type ReadOutcome = Events.ReadOutcome
type Limits = Shapes.Limits
type NumberAsk = Shapes.NumberAsk
type ServerState = Shapes.ServerState
type Held = Composed.Held

export type State = Composed.State

local LifeAsk: NumberAsk = table.freeze({ Kind = "Life" :: "Life" })
local SharedAsk: NumberAsk = table.freeze({ Kind = "Shared" :: "Shared" })

local RoutingFault = "Step: this call is never made."
local NoStores = `{RoutingFault} A counter answered on a server that holds no store.`
local UnusableCounterWarning = "the counter key holds a value its own writer never writes, or a count too large for"
	.. " another server number, so it gave no number. The server asks it again after the retry gap, and writes no key"
	.. " until a number lands."

local function IsAsked(State: State, Kind: "Life" | "Shared"): boolean
	for _, Ask in State.Server.NumbersAsked do
		if Ask.Kind == Kind then
			return true
		end
	end
	for _, Ask in State.NumberRetry.Asks do
		if Ask.Kind == Kind then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function HoldsForWriter(State: State): boolean
	for _, Holding in State.Held do
		if Holding.Kind ~= "Held" or Holding.Call.Method ~= "Id" then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function AskNumber(Server: ServerState, Ask: NumberAsk, Limits: Limits, Commands: { Command })
	local RequestId = Numbers.NewRequestId(Server)
	table.insert(Commands, Numbers.AskServerNumber(Server, RequestId, Ask, Limits))
end

local function AskNumbers(State: State, Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	local Server = State.Server
	local Limits = State.Server.Limits
	if Limits == nil then
		return
	end
	if Closing.IsPastDeadline(State.Sessions, Clock) then
		return
	end
	if Server.ServerNumber == nil then
		if not IsAsked(State, "Life") then
			AskNumber(Server, LifeAsk, Limits, Commands)
		end
		return
	end
	if Server.WriterNumber ~= nil or IsAsked(State, "Shared") then
		return
	end
	if HoldsForWriter(State) then
		AskNumber(Server, SharedAsk, Limits, Commands)
	end
end

local function AskAgain(State: State, Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	local Retry = State.NumberRetry
	local Limits = State.Server.Limits
	if Limits == nil or Retry.RetryAt == nil or Clock < Retry.RetryAt then
		return
	end
	if Closing.IsPastDeadline(State.Sessions, Clock) then
		return
	end
	local Asks = Retry.Asks
	Retry.Asks = {}
	Retry.RetryAt = nil
	for _, Ask in Asks do
		AskNumber(State.Server, Ask, Limits, Commands)
	end
end

local function ReplayHeld(State: State, Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	for _ = 1, #State.Held do
		local Holding = State.Held[1]
		table.remove(State.Held, 1)
		if Holding.Kind == "Held" then
			Calls.OnCall(State, Holding.Call, Holding.At, Clock, Commands)
		else
			InFlight.OpenSession(State, Holding, Clock, Commands)
		end
	end
end

local function OnCounted(State: State, RequestId: number, Written: string?, Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	local Server = State.Server
	local Limits = State.Server.Limits
	if Limits == nil then
		error(NoStores)
	end
	local Ask, Number = Numbers.TakeServerNumber(Server, RequestId, Written, Limits)
	local Retry = State.NumberRetry
	if Number == nil then
		Retry.ErrorsInARow += 1
		Retry.RetryAt = Clock + Sending.RetryGap(Retry.ErrorsInARow, Limits)
		table.insert(Retry.Asks, Ask)
		return
	end
	Retry.ErrorsInARow = 0
	Retry.IsUnusableWarned = false
	if Ask.Kind ~= "Writer" then
		Calls.TouchWriters(State)
		return ReplayHeld(State, Clock, Commands)
	end
	Writers.TakeWriterNumber(Server, Ask.Key, Number)
	Composed.NoteSendable(State, Ask.Key)
end

local function OnCounterUnusable(State: State, RequestId: number, Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	local Limits = State.Server.Limits
	if Limits == nil then
		error(NoStores)
	end
	local Retry = State.NumberRetry
	if not Retry.IsUnusableWarned then
		Retry.IsUnusableWarned = true
		local CounterKey = Numbers.CounterKeyOf(State.Server, Limits)
		local Warn: Command = { Kind = "Warn", Key = CounterKey, Text = UnusableCounterWarning }
		table.insert(Commands, Warn)
	end
	OnCounted(State, RequestId, nil, Clock, Commands)
end

local function EndCloseAfterWork(State: State, Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	Composed.EndClose(State, Clock, Commands)
end

local function OnRead(
	State: State,
	RequestId: number,
	Fetched: ReadOutcome,
	Fraction: number,
	Clock: number,
	Commands: { Command }
)
	if CutServer.OnRead(State, RequestId, Fetched, Clock, Commands) then
		return EndCloseAfterWork(State, Clock, Commands)
	end
	if TxServer.OnRead(State, RequestId, Fetched, Clock, Commands) then
		return EndCloseAfterWork(State, Clock, Commands)
	end
	if ExtrasServer.OnRead(State, RequestId, Fetched, Fraction, Clock, Commands) then
		return EndCloseAfterWork(State, Clock, Commands)
	end
	if HotServer.OnRead(State, RequestId, Fetched, Clock, Commands) then
		return EndCloseAfterWork(State, Clock, Commands)
	end
	local Out = State.Reads[RequestId]
	if Out ~= nil then
		return InFlight.OnReadResult(State, Out, Fetched, Clock, Commands)
	end
	local Open = InFlight.TakeIdleReader(State.Sessions, RequestId)
	if Open == nil then
		return Writing.LearnIncarnation(State, RequestId, Fetched, Clock, Commands)
	end
	Composed.NoteTimersMovedAt(State, Open.Text, Open.Key)
	if Adoption.OnIdleRead(State.Server, State.Sessions, Open.Key, RequestId, Fetched, Clock, Commands) then
		Touch.ActForSession(State, Open.Key, Clock, Commands)
	end
end

local function OnResult(State: State, RequestId: number, Result: Outcome, Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	if CutServer.OnResult(State, RequestId, Result, Clock, Commands) then
		return EndCloseAfterWork(State, Clock, Commands)
	end
	if TxServer.OnResult(State, RequestId, Result, Clock, Commands) then
		return EndCloseAfterWork(State, Clock, Commands)
	end
	if HotServer.OnResult(State, RequestId, Result, Clock, Commands) then
		return EndCloseAfterWork(State, Clock, Commands)
	end
	local Out = State.Reads[RequestId]
	if Out == nil then
		local Finished = Hearing.Hear(State, RequestId, Result, Clock, Commands)
		TxServer.OnCarried(State, Finished, Clock, Commands)
		return
	end
	InFlight.OnUpdateResult(State, Out, Result, Clock, Commands)
end

local function IdDeadline(Server: ServerState, Arrived: number): number?
	local Recorded = Server.Limits
	if Recorded == nil then
		return nil
	end
	return Shedding.QueueDeadline(Arrived, Recorded)
end

local function DeadlineOf(Server: ServerState, Holding: Held): number?
	if Holding.Kind ~= "Held" then
		return InFlight.BoundOf(Server, Holding.Out)
	end
	local Call = Holding.Call
	if Call.Method == "Id" then
		return IdDeadline(Server, Holding.At)
	end
	if Call.Method == "Tx" then
		return TxServer.QueueDeadline(Server, Call, Holding.At)
	end
	if Call.Method == "Bump" then
		return Shedding.StoreQueueDeadline(Server, Call.Store, Holding.At)
	end
	local Hot = HotServer.HotCallOf(Call)
	if Hot ~= nil then
		return Shedding.StoreQueueDeadline(Server, Hot.Store, Holding.At)
	end
	if
		Call.Method ~= "Apply"
		and Call.Method ~= "Edit"
		and Call.Method ~= "Commit"
		and Call.Method ~= "Resettle"
		and Call.Method ~= "Erase"
		and Call.Method ~= "Reset"
	then
		return nil
	end
	return Shedding.QueueDeadline(Holding.At, Cache.StoreOf(Server, Call.Key).Setup.Limits)
end

local function TimeOutHeld(State: State, Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	if #State.Held == 0 then
		return
	end
	local Kept: { Held } = {}
	for _, Holding in State.Held do
		local Deadline = DeadlineOf(State.Server, Holding)
		if Deadline == nil or Clock < Deadline then
			table.insert(Kept, Holding)
		else
			Replies.ReplyFailed(Commands, Calls.CallIdOf(Holding), Reasons.Busy)
		end
	end
	State.Held = Kept
end

local function ShedPastDeadline(State: State, Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	TimeOutHeld(State, Clock, Commands)
	Waking.ShedPastDeadline(State, Clock, Commands)
end

local function OnClock(State: State, Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	InFlight.TickReads(State, Clock, Commands)
	AskAgain(State, Clock, Commands)
	TxServer.OnClock(State, Clock, Commands)
	CutServer.OnClock(State, Clock, Commands)
	ExtrasServer.OnClock(State, Clock, Commands)
	HotServer.OnClock(State, Clock, Commands)
	Waking.OnClock(State, Clock, Commands)
end

local function OthersWake(State: State, Soonest: number?, Clock: number): number?
	local Server = State.Server
	for _, Holding in State.Held do
		Soonest = Composed.EarliestAfter(Soonest, DeadlineOf(Server, Holding), Clock)
	end
	for _, Out in State.Reads do
		Soonest = Composed.EarliestAfter(Soonest, Out.RetryAt, Clock)
		Soonest = Composed.EarliestAfter(Soonest, InFlight.BoundOf(Server, Out), Clock)
	end
	Soonest = Composed.EarliestAfter(Soonest, TxServer.NextWake(State, Clock), Clock)
	Soonest = Composed.EarliestAfter(Soonest, CutServer.NextWake(State, Clock), Clock)
	Soonest = Composed.EarliestAfter(Soonest, ExtrasServer.NextWake(State, Clock), Clock)
	Soonest = Composed.EarliestAfter(Soonest, HotServer.NextWake(State, Clock), Clock)
	return Composed.EarliestAfter(Soonest, State.NumberRetry.RetryAt, Clock)
end

local function NextWake(State: State, Event: Event): number?
	if Event.Happening.Kind == "Clock" then
		return OthersWake(State, Waking.NextWake(State, Event.Clock), Event.Clock)
	end
	return OthersWake(State, Waking.FoldWake(State, Event.Clock), Event.Clock)
end

local function FullWake(State: State, Clock: number): number?
	return OthersWake(State, Waking.TrueWake(State, Clock), Clock)
end

local function Handle(State: State, Event: Event, Commands: { Command })
	local Happening = Event.Happening
	local Clock = Event.Clock
	if Happening.Kind == "Call" then
		return Calls.OnCall(State, Happening, Clock, Clock, Commands)
	end
	if Happening.Kind == "Result" then
		return OnResult(State, Happening.RequestId, Happening.Outcome, Clock, Commands)
	end
	if Happening.Kind == "Read" then
		CopiesServer.NoteRead(State, Happening.RequestId, Happening.Fetched, Happening.Fraction)
		return OnRead(State, Happening.RequestId, Happening.Fetched, Happening.Fraction, Clock, Commands)
	end
	if Happening.Kind == "MemoryRead" then
		ExtrasServer.OnMemoryRead(State, Happening.RequestId, Happening.Fetched, Happening.Fraction, Clock, Commands)
		return EndCloseAfterWork(State, Clock, Commands)
	end
	if Happening.Kind == "MemoryResult" then
		ExtrasServer.OnMemoryResult(State, Happening.RequestId, Happening.Outcome, Clock, Commands)
		return EndCloseAfterWork(State, Clock, Commands)
	end
	if Happening.Kind == "Decoded" then
		CopiesServer.OnDecoded(State, Happening.RequestId, Happening.Outcome, Clock, Commands)
		return EndCloseAfterWork(State, Clock, Commands)
	end
	if Happening.Kind == "Counted" then
		return OnCounted(State, Happening.RequestId, Happening.Written, Clock, Commands)
	end
	if Happening.Kind == "CounterUnusable" then
		return OnCounterUnusable(State, Happening.RequestId, Clock, Commands)
	end
	if Happening.Kind == "Send" then
		return Writing.SendOnEvent(State, Happening.Key, Clock, Commands)
	end
	if Happening.Kind == "Clock" then
		return OnClock(State, Clock, Commands)
	end
	local Erased = CutServer.OnRemoved(State, Happening.RequestId, Happening.IsOk, Clock)
	if Erased ~= nil then
		CopiesServer.AdviseErased(State, Erased, Commands)
	end
	if HotServer.OnRemoved(State, Happening.RequestId, Happening.IsOk, Commands) then
		EndCloseAfterWork(State, Clock, Commands)
	end
end

local function AnswerAtEndedClose(State: State, Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	Calls.AnswerAtEndedClose(State, Commands)
	TxServer.AnswerAtEndedClose(State, Commands)
	CutServer.AnswerAtEndedClose(State, Commands)
	ExtrasServer.AnswerAtEndedClose(State, Clock, Commands)
end

local function Step(State: State, Event: Event): (State, { Command })
	local Commands: { Command } = {}
	ShedPastDeadline(State, Event.Clock, Commands)
	Handle(State, Event, Commands)
	TxServer.AfterEvent(State, Event.Clock, Commands)
	CutServer.AfterEvent(State, Event.Clock, Commands)
	ExtrasServer.AfterEvent(State, Event.Clock, Commands)
	HotServer.AfterEvent(State, Event.Clock, Commands)
	CopiesServer.OnCopyReads(State, Event.Clock, Commands)
	if #State.Server.StepOut == 0 then
		EndCloseAfterWork(State, Event.Clock, Commands)
	end
	if Closing.IsEnded(State.Sessions) then
		AnswerAtEndedClose(State, Event.Clock, Commands)
		HotServer.AnswerAtEndedClose(State, Event.Clock, Commands)
		HotServer.AfterEndedClose(State, Event.Clock, Commands)
		StepAnswer.AbandonAtClose(State)
		CutServer.AbandonAtClose(State)
	end
	State.Server.Landed = {}
	Writing.ReadySendable(State, Event.Clock, Commands)
	AskNumbers(State, Event.Clock, Commands)
	local At = NextWake(State, Event)
	if At ~= nil then
		local Wake: Command = { Kind = "Wake", At = At }
		table.insert(Commands, Wake)
	end
	return State, Commands
end

return {
	Step = Step,
	FullWake = FullWake,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Shard: a total's shard (extras sheet E1, E2 B0, B5, B6): its key, build and bump terms. The state is
	{ s = sum }, created at 0; the reducer is the bump rule, and a bump past ShardMax gives no state, so the op is
	Refused. BumpTerms refuses what a call must not send.

	Return type: A plain table of functions, and the BumpTerms type.
	Example usage:
		local Key = Shard.ShardKey("Shop", "global", { Name = "coins", KeyCount = 16, Keys = "Shard" }, 3)
		--> { Store = "Shop", Scope = "global", Key = "$T:coins:16:3" }
--]=]

local Extras = require("./Constants/Extras")
local ExtrasShapes = require("../Shared/ReadShapes")
local Names = require("./Encoding/Names")
local Record = require("./Constants/Record")
local Shapes = require("../Shared/Shapes")

type Build = Shapes.Build
type StoreKey = Names.StoreKey
type TotalDeclaration = ExtrasShapes.TotalDeclaration
type Fields = { [unknown]: unknown }

export type BumpTerms = {
	read Amount: number,
	read Shards: number,
}

type ShardRef = {
	read Total: TotalDeclaration,
	read Index: number,
}

local KeyKinds = Record.KeyKind

local ShardSumField = Extras.ShardSumField
local ShardSumMost = Extras.ShardSumMost
local ShardsMost = Extras.ShardsMost

local ShardKeyPrefix = Record.ShardKeyPrefix
local ShardKeyShape = "^(.*):(%d+):(%d+)$"

local ModuleName = "Shard"
local CallerMustGive = `{ModuleName}: a bump holds a number under {ShardSumField} in its state, and an Amount and`
	.. ` Shards in its terms. The caller must give them`
local ShardsOutOfRange = `{ModuleName}: a total has a whole number of shards from 1 to {ShardsMost}. The caller must`
	.. ` give one`
local AmountOutOfRange = `{ModuleName}: a bump's Amount is a whole number of at least 1 in size and at most ShardMax.`
	.. ` The caller must give one`
local NotAShardKey = `{ModuleName}: this key does not name a shard of a total. The caller must give a shard's key`

local function ShardMax(Shards: number): number
	return math.floor(ShardSumMost / Shards)
end

local function SumOfState(State: unknown): number
	if type(State) ~= "table" then
		error(CallerMustGive)
	end
	local Sum = (State :: Fields)[ShardSumField]
	if type(Sum) ~= "number" then
		error(CallerMustGive)
	end
	return Sum
end

local function ShardKey(Store: string, Scope: string, Total: TotalDeclaration, Index: number): StoreKey
	return { Store = Store, Scope = Scope, Key = `{ShardKeyPrefix}{Total.Name}:{Total.KeyCount}:{Index}` }
end

local function ShardOfKey(Key: StoreKey): ShardRef
	local Name, Shards, Index = string.match(string.sub(Key.Key, #ShardKeyPrefix + 1), ShardKeyShape)
	local ShardCount = tonumber(Shards)
	local ShardIndex = tonumber(Index)
	if Name == nil or ShardCount == nil or ShardIndex == nil then
		error(NotAShardKey)
	end
	return { Total = { Name = Name, KeyCount = ShardCount, Keys = KeyKinds.Shard }, Index = ShardIndex }
end

local function BumpTerms(Amount: number, Shards: number): BumpTerms
	if Shards % 1 ~= 0 or Shards < 1 or Shards > ShardsMost then
		error(ShardsOutOfRange)
	end
	local Size = math.abs(Amount)
	if Amount % 1 ~= 0 or Size < 1 or Size > ShardMax(Shards) then
		error(AmountOutOfRange)
	end
	return { Amount = Amount, Shards = Shards }
end

local function BumpTermsOf(Terms: unknown): BumpTerms
	if type(Terms) ~= "table" then
		error(CallerMustGive)
	end
	local Given = Terms :: Fields
	local Amount = Given.Amount
	local Shards = Given.Shards
	if type(Amount) ~= "number" or type(Shards) ~= "number" then
		error(CallerMustGive)
	end
	return { Amount = Amount, Shards = Shards }
end

local function Bump(State: unknown, Terms: unknown): Fields?
	local Given = BumpTermsOf(Terms)
	local Sum = SumOfState(State) + Given.Amount
	if math.abs(Sum) > ShardMax(Given.Shards) then
		return nil
	end
	return { [ShardSumField] = Sum }
end

local function NewBuild(): Build
	local Made: Build = {
		KeyKind = KeyKinds.Shard,
		Migrations = {},
		MigrationCount = 0,
		BreakingIndex = 0,
		Reducer = Bump,
		Default = { [ShardSumField] = 0 },
		Declared = { [ShardSumField] = true },
		Balances = {},
		BalanceOps = {},
	}
	table.freeze(Made.Migrations)
	table.freeze(Made.Default)
	table.freeze(Made.Declared)
	table.freeze(Made.Balances)
	table.freeze(Made.BalanceOps)
	return table.freeze(Made)
end

return {
	ShardKey = ShardKey,
	ShardOfKey = ShardOfKey,
	ShardMax = ShardMax,
	SumOfState = SumOfState,
	BumpTerms = BumpTerms,
	NewBuild = NewBuild,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Calls: the game's call ids, positive (the core's helpers take negative ones), and their futures. An answer before
	Open is kept for Take only for a CallNow call (Expect). A step's answers leave Pending at Claim and settle at
	Resume, after SettleOutcomes. A WithOutcome call answered Unresolved gets an Outcome. CloseAll settles every rest
	Unresolved, an Id Closed.

	Return type: A plain table with NewCallId, Open, OpenWithOutcome, Expect, Claim, SettleOutcomes, Resume, Take and
	CloseAll, and the Outcome type.
	Example usage:
		local Job = Calls.Open(Call.CallId, Call.Method)
		local Waiters = Calls.Claim(Answers)
		Calls.SettleOutcomes(Settled)
		Calls.Resume(Waiters)
--]=]

local Events = require("../Shared/Events")
local Future = require("../Util/Future")
local Reasons = require("../Keys/Constants/Reasons")
local Replies = require("../Shared/Replies")

type Answer = Events.Answer
type AnswerCommand = Events.AnswerCommand
type OutcomeEmission = Replies.OutcomeEmission
type Reason = Reasons.Reason
type Future<T...> = Future.Future<T...>

export type Outcome = Future<boolean, Reason?>

type Settle = (boolean, Reason?) -> ()

type AnswerOpened = { read Kind: "Answer", read Method: string, read Done: (Answer) -> () }
type OutcomeOpened = { read Kind: "WithOutcome", read Method: string, read Done: (Answer, Outcome?) -> () }
type Opened = AnswerOpened | OutcomeOpened

type Waiter = { read CallId: number, read Opened: Opened, read Answer: Answer, read Outcome: Outcome? }

local LeftOver: Answer = { Kind = "Failed", Reason = Reasons.Unresolved, State = nil }
table.freeze(LeftOver)
local NeverRan: Answer = { Kind = "Failed", Reason = Reasons.Closed, State = nil }
table.freeze(NeverRan)

local IdMethod = "Id" :: "Id"

local LastCallId = 0
local Pending: { [number]: Opened } = {}
local Claimed: { [number]: Waiter } = {}
local Given: { [number]: Answer } = {}
local Expected: { [number]: true } = {}
local Outcomes: { [number]: Settle } = {}

local function NewCallId(): number
	LastCallId += 1
	return LastCallId
end

local function LeftOverOf(Method: string): Answer
	if Method == IdMethod then
		return NeverRan
	end
	return LeftOver
end

local function Open(CallId: number, Method: string): Future<Answer>
	local Job: Future<Answer>, Done: (Answer) -> () = Future.Pending()
	local Opening: AnswerOpened = { Kind = "Answer", Method = Method, Done = Done }
	Pending[CallId] = Opening
	return Job
end

local function OpenWithOutcome(CallId: number, Method: string): Future<Answer, Outcome?>
	local Job: Future<Answer, Outcome?>, Done: (Answer, Outcome?) -> () = Future.Pending()
	local Opening: OutcomeOpened = { Kind = "WithOutcome", Method = Method, Done = Done }
	Pending[CallId] = Opening
	return Job
end

local function Expect(CallId: number)
	Expected[CallId] = true
end

local function OwesOutcome(Opened: Opened, Answered: Answer): boolean
	return Opened.Kind == "WithOutcome" and Replies.IsUnresolved(Answered)
end

local function OpenOutcome(CallId: number): Outcome
	local Job: Outcome, Done: Settle = Future.Pending()
	Outcomes[CallId] = Done
	return Job
end

local function SettledUnresolved(): Outcome
	return Future.Completed(false, Reasons.Unresolved :: Reason?)
end

local function Deliver(Opened: Opened, Answered: Answer, Outcome: Outcome?)
	if Opened.Kind == "Answer" then
		return Opened.Done(Answered)
	end
	Opened.Done(Answered, Outcome)
end

local function Claim(Commands: { AnswerCommand }): { Waiter }
	local Waiters: { Waiter } = {}
	for _, Command in Commands do
		local CallId = Command.CallId
		local Opened = Pending[CallId]
		if Opened == nil then
			if Expected[CallId] then
				Given[CallId] = Command.Answer
			end
			continue
		end
		Pending[CallId] = nil
		local Outcome = if OwesOutcome(Opened, Command.Answer) then OpenOutcome(CallId) else nil
		local Waiting: Waiter = { CallId = CallId, Opened = Opened, Answer = Command.Answer, Outcome = Outcome }
		Claimed[CallId] = Waiting
		table.insert(Waiters, Waiting)
	end
	return Waiters
end

local function SettleOutcome(Emission: OutcomeEmission)
	local Done = Outcomes[Emission.CallId]
	if Done == nil then
		return
	end
	Outcomes[Emission.CallId] = nil
	local Answered = Emission.Answer
	if Answered.Kind == "Succeeded" then
		return Done(true, nil)
	end
	Done(false, Answered.Reason)
end

local function SettleOutcomes(Settled: { OutcomeEmission })
	for _, Emission in Settled do
		SettleOutcome(Emission)
	end
end

local function Resume(Waiters: { Waiter })
	for _, Waiting in Waiters do
		if Claimed[Waiting.CallId] == Waiting then
			Claimed[Waiting.CallId] = nil
			Deliver(Waiting.Opened, Waiting.Answer, Waiting.Outcome)
		end
	end
end

local function Take(CallId: number): Answer?
	local Answer = Given[CallId]
	Given[CallId] = nil
	Expected[CallId] = nil
	return Answer
end

local function CloseAll()
	local Owed = Outcomes
	local Stranded = Claimed
	local Left = Pending
	Outcomes = {}
	Claimed = {}
	Pending = {}
	for _, Done in Owed do
		Done(false, Reasons.Unresolved)
	end
	for _, Waiting in Stranded do
		Deliver(Waiting.Opened, Waiting.Answer, Waiting.Outcome)
	end
	for _, Opened in Left do
		local Answered = LeftOverOf(Opened.Method)
		local Outcome = if OwesOutcome(Opened, Answered) then SettledUnresolved() else nil
		Deliver(Opened, Answered, Outcome)
	end
end

return {
	NewCallId = NewCallId,
	Open = Open,
	OpenWithOutcome = OpenWithOutcome,
	Expect = Expect,
	Claim = Claim,
	SettleOutcomes = SettleOutcomes,
	Resume = Resume,
	Take = Take,
	CloseAll = CloseAll,
}

local function RoomsByKind(Game: number, Shard: number, Part: number): { [string]: number }
	local Rooms: { [string]: number } = {

local function TimedWindowsOf(Settings: Settings, PartBuild: Build): Windows
