--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Memory: runs the MemoryStore commands and the JSON Decode, each in its own thread, and feeds the event each gives
	back. SetAsync throws when it cannot set, so its boolean is not read. An Update's Ok carries the value it wrote;
	an Update answering nil is a cancel only when its last run returned nil, else the retry limit. A throwing item is
	raised again and feeds nothing.

	Return type: A plain table with OnGet, OnSet, OnUpdate, OnRemove and OnDecode.
	Example usage:
		Memory.OnGet(Command, Feed)
--]=]

local Events = require("../Shared/Events")
local Platform = require("./Platform")
local Services = require("./Services")
local Threads = require("../Util/Threads")

type DecodeCommand = Events.DecodeCommand
type DecodeOutcome = Events.DecodeOutcome
type Happening = Events.Happening
type MemoryFetched = Events.MemoryFetched
type MemoryGetCommand = Events.MemoryGetCommand
type MemoryOutcome = Events.MemoryOutcome
type MemoryRemoveCommand = Events.MemoryRemoveCommand
type MemorySetCommand = Events.MemorySetCommand
type MemoryUpdateCommand = Events.MemoryUpdateCommand
type Result = Services.Result

type Feed = (Happening: Happening) -> ()

type CompletedRun = { read Output: unknown }

local function CoreFault(Command: MemoryUpdateCommand): never
	error(
		`Memory: the core faulted inside the item of the MemoryUpdate request on {Command.Map}/{Command.Key}.`
			.. ` The update did not land and no event was fed.`
			.. ` See the console's TransformCallbackFailed line for the fault.`,
		0
	)
end

local function FetchedOf(Result: Result): MemoryFetched
	if Result.Kind == "Ok" then
		return { Kind = "Found", Value = Result.Value }
	end
	if Result.Kind == "Absent" then
		return { Kind = "Absent" }
	end
	return { Kind = "Failed" }
end

local function UpdateOutcomeOf(Result: Result, LastRun: CompletedRun?): MemoryOutcome
	if Result.Kind == "Err" or LastRun == nil then
		return { Kind = "Err" }
	end
	if Result.Kind == "Ok" then
		return { Kind = "Ok", Value = Result.Value }
	end
	if LastRun.Output ~= nil then
		return { Kind = "Err" }
	end
	return { Kind = "Nil" }
end

local function SetOutcomeOf(Result: Result): MemoryOutcome
	if Result.Kind == "Err" then
		return { Kind = "Err" }
	end
	return { Kind = "Ok", Value = nil }
end

local function DecodeOutcomeOf(Result: Result): DecodeOutcome
	if Result.Kind == "Ok" then
		return { Kind = "Found", Value = Result.Value }
	end
	if Result.Kind == "Absent" then
		return { Kind = "Found", Value = nil }
	end
	return { Kind = "Failed" }
end

local function OnGet(Command: MemoryGetCommand, Feed: Feed)
	Threads.Spawn(function()
		local Fetched = FetchedOf(Services.MemoryGet(Command.Map, Command.Key))
		Feed({ Kind = "MemoryRead", RequestId = Command.RequestId, Fetched = Fetched, Fraction = Platform.Fraction() })
	end)
end

local function OnSet(Command: MemorySetCommand, Feed: Feed)
	Threads.Spawn(function()
		local Result = Services.MemorySet(Command.Map, Command.Key, Command.Item, Command.Expiry)
		Feed({ Kind = "MemoryResult", RequestId = Command.RequestId, Outcome = SetOutcomeOf(Result) })
	end)
end

local function OnUpdate(Command: MemoryUpdateCommand, Feed: Feed)
	Threads.Spawn(function()
		local IsRunning = false
		local LastRun: CompletedRun? = nil
		local Result = Services.MemoryUpdate(Command.Map, Command.Key, function(Current: unknown): unknown
			IsRunning = true
			local Next = Command.Item(Current, Platform.Now())
			IsRunning = false
			LastRun = { Output = Next }
			return Next
		end, Command.Expiry)
		if IsRunning then
			CoreFault(Command)
		end
		Feed({ Kind = "MemoryResult", RequestId = Command.RequestId, Outcome = UpdateOutcomeOf(Result, LastRun) })
	end)
end

local function OnRemove(Command: MemoryRemoveCommand, Feed: Feed)
	Threads.Spawn(function()
		local Result = Services.MemoryRemove(Command.Map, Command.Key)
		local Outcome: MemoryOutcome = if Result.Kind == "Err" then { Kind = "Err" } else { Kind = "Ok", Value = nil }
		Feed({ Kind = "MemoryResult", RequestId = Command.RequestId, Outcome = Outcome })
	end)
end

local function OnDecode(Command: DecodeCommand, Feed: Feed)
	Threads.Spawn(function()
		local Outcome = DecodeOutcomeOf(Services.JsonDecode(Command.Text))
		Feed({ Kind = "Decoded", RequestId = Command.RequestId, Outcome = Outcome })
	end)
end

return {
	OnGet = OnGet,
	OnSet = OnSet,
	OnUpdate = OnUpdate,
	OnRemove = OnRemove,
	OnDecode = OnDecode,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Platform: what the core may not ask the platform for. The protocol's clock is whole seconds since StampEpoch
	(Format 2); SecondsUntil is negative once the stamp has passed. Random:NextNumber() may give 1, so a 1 is drawn
	again, up to DrawsMost draws, then 0: a fraction is uniform in [0, 1). Util/Threads times durations. ParseJson
	throws on text that is not JSON.

	Return type: A plain table with Now, SecondsUntil, Fraction, JobId, IsStudio, IsServer and Encoding.
	Example usage:
		local Clock = Platform.Now()
		local Wait = Platform.SecondsUntil(Clock + 30)
--]=]

local HashInputs = require("../Keys/Encoding/HashInputs")
local Record = require("../Keys/Constants/Record")

type Encoding = HashInputs.Encoding

local EncodingService = game:GetService("EncodingService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local MillisecondsPerSecond = 1000

local Generator = Random.new()
local DrawsMost = 8

local ZstdLevel = 1

local function Now(): number
	return DateTime.now().UnixTimestamp - Record.StampEpoch
end

local function SecondsUntil(At: number): number
	local MillisecondsSinceEpoch = DateTime.now().UnixTimestampMillis - Record.StampEpoch * MillisecondsPerSecond
	return At - MillisecondsSinceEpoch / MillisecondsPerSecond
end

local function Fraction(): number
	for _ = 1, DrawsMost do
		local Drawn = Generator:NextNumber()
		if Drawn < 1 then
			return Drawn
		end
	end
	return 0
end

local function JobId(): string
	return game.JobId
end

local function IsStudio(): boolean
	return RunService:IsStudio()
end

local function IsServer(): boolean
	return RunService:IsServer()
end

local function Sha256(Input: buffer): buffer
	return EncodingService:ComputeBufferHash(Input, Enum.HashAlgorithm.Sha256)
end

local function Compress(Input: buffer): buffer
	return EncodingService:CompressBuffer(Input, Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd, ZstdLevel)
end

local function Blake3(Input: buffer): string
	return buffer.tostring(EncodingService:ComputeBufferHash(Input, Enum.HashAlgorithm.Blake3))
end

local function ParseJson(Text: string): unknown
	return HttpService:JSONDecode(Text)
end

local Encoding: Encoding = {
	Sha256 = Sha256,
	Compress = Compress,
	ParseJson = ParseJson,
	Blake3 = Blake3,
}

return {
	Now = Now,
	SecondsUntil = SecondsUntil,
	Fraction = Fraction,
	JobId = JobId,
	IsStudio = IsStudio,
	IsServer = IsServer,
	Encoding = Encoding,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Requests: runs the DataStore commands Update, Count, Get and Remove, each in a thread, and feeds each event
	back. An Update's transform runs Transform.Step at the landing clock, as Stepping, and passes its closure to a
	rerun. A throwing transform is raised again and feeds nothing. Its candidates are LastWritten, the game state this
	server's last transform on the key wrote, then the one its command carries. Both are hints, since the stored
	bytes decide. LastWritten lives here because a command's candidate comes from Cache, which only step updates, so
	it misses a state written moments before by a leg whose result has not been heard yet.

	Return type: A plain table with OnUpdate, OnCount, OnGet and OnRemove, and the Store type.
	Example usage:
		Requests.OnUpdate(Command, Stores[Command.Target.Store], Feed)
--]=]

local Cache = require("../Keys/DataStore/Cache")
local Events = require("../Shared/Events")
local JudgingShapes = require("../Shared/OpShapes")
local Names = require("../Keys/Encoding/Names")
local Platform = require("./Platform")
local Record = require("../Keys/Constants/Record")
local Services = require("./Services")
local Shapes = require("../Shared/Shapes")
local ShellSetup = require("./Setup")
local Stepping = require("./Stepping")
local Threads = require("../Util/Threads")
local Transform = require("../Keys/Ops/Transform")
local Value = require("../Keys/Format/Value")

type Closure = JudgingShapes.Closure
type KeyKind = Shapes.KeyKind
type Note = JudgingShapes.Note
type Setup = Shapes.Setup
type StoreKey = Names.StoreKey
type CountCommand = Events.CountCommand
type GetCommand = Events.GetCommand
type Happening = Events.Happening
type Outcome = Events.Outcome
type ReadOutcome = Events.ReadOutcome
type RemoveCommand = Events.RemoveCommand
type UpdateCommand = Events.UpdateCommand
type Result = Services.Result
type Candidates = Value.Candidates
type Fields = Value.Fields

export type Store = {
	read Setup: Setup,
	read IsPlayerStore: boolean,
}

type Feed = (Happening: Happening) -> ()

local GameKind = Record.KeyKind.Game

local LastWritten = setmetatable({} :: { [string]: Fields }, { __mode = "v" })

local function RequestText(Target: StoreKey, Kind: string): string
	return `the {Kind} request on {Target.Store}/{Target.Scope}/{Target.Key}`
end

local function CoreFault(Target: StoreKey, Kind: string): never
	error(
		`Requests: the core faulted inside the transform of {RequestText(Target, Kind)}.`
			.. ` The write did not land and no event was fed.`
			.. ` See the console's "Transform function error" line for the fault.`,
		0
	)
end

local function NotUserId(Target: StoreKey): never
	error(
		`Requests: the key {Target.Key} of the player store {Target.Store} is not a user id.`
			.. ` The API must give a player store keys that are user ids.`,
		0
	)
end

local function UserIdsOf(Store: Store, Target: StoreKey, Kind: KeyKind): { number }?
	if not Store.IsPlayerStore or Kind ~= GameKind then
		return nil
	end
	if not ShellSetup.IsUserIdKey(Target.Key) then
		return NotUserId(Target)
	end
	return { tonumber(Target.Key) :: number }
end

local function OutcomeOf(Result: Result, Note: Note?): Outcome
	if Result.Kind == "Err" then
		return { Kind = "Err" }
	end
	if Note == nil then
		return { Kind = "Err" }
	end
	if Result.Kind == "Ok" then
		return { Kind = "Ok", Value = Result.Value, Note = Note }
	end
	return { Kind = "Nil", Note = Note }
end

local function FetchedOf(Result: Result): ReadOutcome
	if Result.Kind == "Ok" then
		return { Kind = "Found", Value = Result.Value }
	end
	if Result.Kind == "Absent" then
		return { Kind = "Absent" }
	end
	return { Kind = "Failed", IsThrottled = Result.IsThrottled }
end

local function CandidatesOf(Text: string, Command: UpdateCommand): Candidates
	local Candidates: Candidates = {}
	local Written = LastWritten[Text]
	if Written ~= nil then
		table.insert(Candidates, Written)
	end
	local Carried = Command.Candidate
	if Carried ~= nil and Carried ~= Written then
		table.insert(Candidates, Carried)
	end
	return Candidates
end

local function NoteLastWritten(Text: string, Kind: KeyKind, Note: Note): ()
	local Written = Note.WrittenValue
	if Kind == GameKind and Written ~= nil and Written.Kind == "Kept" then
		LastWritten[Text] = Written.State
	end
end

local function OnUpdate(Command: UpdateCommand, Store: Store, Feed: Feed)
	Threads.Spawn(function()
		local Target = Command.Target
		local Kind = Cache.KindOfKey(Target)
		local UserIds = UserIdsOf(Store, Target, Kind)
		local Closure: Closure = { Wrote = false, Ran = {} }
		local Text = Names.KeyText(Target)
		local LastNote: Note? = nil
		local IsRunning = false
		local Result = Services.Update(Target, function(Stored: unknown): (unknown, { number }?)
			IsRunning = true
			local Output, Note = Stepping.Run(
				Transform.Step,
				Stored,
				Command.Request,
				Platform.Now(),
				Store.Setup,
				Closure,
				Kind,
				CandidatesOf(Text, Command)
			)
			IsRunning = false
			Closure = Note.Closure
			LastNote = Note
			if Output.Kind == "Cancel" then
				return nil, nil
			end
			NoteLastWritten(Text, Kind, Note)
			return Output.Value, UserIds
		end)
		if IsRunning then
			CoreFault(Target, Command.Request.Kind)
		end
		Feed({ Kind = "Result", RequestId = Command.RequestId, Outcome = OutcomeOf(Result, LastNote) })
	end)
end

local function OnCount(Command: CountCommand, Feed: Feed)
	Threads.Spawn(function()
		local Written: string? = nil
		local IsRunning = false
		local IsRefused = false
		local Result = Services.Update(Command.Target, function(Stored: unknown): (unknown, { number }?)
			IsRunning = true
			local Added = Command.Add(Stored)
			IsRunning = false
			Written = Added
			IsRefused = Added == nil
			return Added, nil
		end)
		if IsRunning then
			CoreFault(Command.Target, Command.Kind)
		end
		if IsRefused then
			Feed({ Kind = "CounterUnusable", RequestId = Command.RequestId })
			return
		end
		local Counted = if Result.Kind == "Ok" then Written else nil
		Feed({ Kind = "Counted", RequestId = Command.RequestId, Written = Counted })
	end)
end

local function OnGet(Command: GetCommand, Feed: Feed)
	Threads.Spawn(function()
		local Result = Services.Get(Command.Target)
		Feed({
			Kind = "Read",
			RequestId = Command.RequestId,
			Fetched = FetchedOf(Result),
			Fraction = Platform.Fraction(),
		})
	end)
end

local function OnRemove(Command: RemoveCommand, Feed: Feed)
	Threads.Spawn(function()
		local Result = Services.Remove(Command.Target)
		Feed({ Kind = "Removed", RequestId = Command.RequestId, IsOk = Result.Kind ~= "Err" })
	end)
end

return {
	OnUpdate = OnUpdate,
	OnCount = OnCount,
	OnGet = OnGet,
	OnRemove = OnRemove,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Runner: the server's loop, wakes, stores and close. Events step at once, even inside commands; an unhandled command
	faults. A step's answers leave Pending before its other commands, settling after them and its outcomes, the close's
	last. Wakes fire at whole-second stamps. BeforeClose functions get BeforeCloseSeconds of the close's deadline, which
	no fault passes. A store-less Id brings default Limits.

	Return type: A plain table with Start, AddStore, AddBeforeClose, IsOpened, OpenedSetup, Call, CallWithOutcome,
	WouldWait, CallNow, CallNowForId, CloseAll, IsClosing and IsStepping.
	Example usage:
		Runner.Start()
		Runner.AddStore(Setup, false)
		local Answer = Runner.CallNow(Call)
--]=]

local Calls = require("./Calls")
local Composed = require("../Shared/Composed")
local CoreCalls = require("../Core/Calls")
local CoreClosing = require("../Keys/DataStore/Closing")
local Events = require("../Shared/Events")
local Future = require("../Util/Future")
local Memory = require("./Memory")
local Names = require("../Keys/Encoding/Names")
local Platform = require("./Platform")
local Replies = require("../Shared/Replies")
local Requests = require("./Requests")
local Shapes = require("../Shared/Shapes")
local ShellLimits = require("./Limits")
local Step = require("../Core/Step")
local Stepping = require("./Stepping")
local Streams = require("./Streams")
local Threads = require("../Util/Threads")

type Answer = Events.Answer
type AnswerCommand = Events.AnswerCommand
type Call = Events.Call
type Command = Events.Command
type Event = Events.Event
type Happening = Events.Happening
type ReadyCommand = Events.ReadyCommand
type UpdateCommand = Events.UpdateCommand
type WakeCommand = Events.WakeCommand
type WarnCommand = Events.WarnCommand
type Future<T...> = Future.Future<T...>
type Outcome = Calls.Outcome
type OutcomeEmission = Replies.OutcomeEmission
type Setup = Shapes.Setup
type State = Composed.State
type Store = Requests.Store
type StoreKey = Names.StoreKey

type Feed = (Happening: Happening) -> ()

type Handler = (Command: Command, Feed: Feed) -> ()

type Timer = { read At: number, read Thread: thread }

local CloseMethod: "CloseAll" = "CloseAll"
local BeforeCloseSeconds = 5

local NotStarted = "Runner: Start has not run, so the server has no state to step."
local StartedTwice = "Runner: Start ran twice. The server has one loop, and it starts once."

local function NoHandler(Kind: string): string
	return `Runner: the core emitted a command of kind {Kind}, which no handler runs.`
end

local function AlreadyOpened(Name: string): string
	return `Runner: the store {Name} was opened on this server before. A store name is kept for the server's life.`
end

local function NoStore(Name: string): string
	return `Runner: a request targets the store {Name}, which this server never opened.`
end

local function NoSetup(Name: string): string
	return `Runner: the store {Name} was never opened on this server, so it has no Setup. Ask IsOpened first.`
end

local ServerClosing = "Ledger.BeforeClose: the server is closing, so a function registered now would never run. "
	.. "Register it before the close starts"

local function BeforeCloseErrored(Trace: string): string
	return `Ledger: a BeforeClose function errored, and the close goes on without it: {Trace}`
end

local Current: State? = nil
local Stores: { [string]: Store } = {}
local Waking: Timer? = nil
local Closing: Future<()>? = nil
local CloseCallId: number? = nil
local BeforeCloseFunctions: { () -> () } = {}

local Feed: Feed

local function StateOf(): State
	if Current == nil then
		error(NotStarted, 0)
	end
	return Current
end

local function StoreOf(Target: StoreKey): Store
	local Found = Stores[Target.Store]
	if Found == nil then
		error(NoStore(Target.Store), 0)
	end
	return Found
end

local function OnUpdate(Command: UpdateCommand, Feed: Feed)
	Requests.OnUpdate(Command, StoreOf(Command.Target), Feed)
end

local function Arm(At: number, Feed: Feed)
	local DueSecond = math.ceil(At)
	local Thread = Threads.Delay(math.max(Platform.SecondsUntil(DueSecond), 0), function()
		Waking = nil
		if Platform.Now() < At then
			return Arm(At, Feed)
		end
		Feed({ Kind = "Clock" })
	end)
	Waking = { At = At, Thread = Thread }
end

local function OnWake(Command: WakeCommand, Feed: Feed)
	local Kept = Waking
	if Kept ~= nil then
		if Kept.At <= Command.At then
			return
		end
		Threads.Cancel(Kept.Thread)
	end
	Arm(Command.At, Feed)
end

local function OnReady(Command: ReadyCommand, Feed: Feed)
	Feed({ Kind = "Send", Key = Command.Key })
end

local function OnWarn(Command: WarnCommand)
	local Key = Command.Key
	if Key == nil then
		warn(Command.Text)
		return
	end
	warn(`Ledger: {Key.Store}/{Key.Scope}/{Key.Key}: {Command.Text}`)
end

local Handlers = {
	Update = OnUpdate,
	Count = Requests.OnCount,
	Get = Requests.OnGet,
	Remove = Requests.OnRemove,
	MemoryGet = Memory.OnGet,
	MemorySet = Memory.OnSet,
	MemoryUpdate = Memory.OnUpdate,
	MemoryRemove = Memory.OnRemove,
	Decode = Memory.OnDecode,
	Emit = Streams.OnEmit,
	Wake = OnWake,
	Ready = OnReady,
	Warn = OnWarn,
}

local function AnswersOf(Commands: { Command }): { AnswerCommand }
	local Answers: { AnswerCommand } = {}
	local CloseAnswers: { AnswerCommand } = {}
	for _, Command in Commands do
		if Command.Kind == "Answer" then
			table.insert(if Command.CallId == CloseCallId then CloseAnswers else Answers, Command)
		end
	end
	table.move(CloseAnswers, 1, #CloseAnswers, #Answers + 1, Answers)
	return Answers
end

local function IsOutcome(Command: Command): boolean
	return Command.Kind == "Emit" and Command.Stream == Replies.OutcomeStream
end

local function OutcomesOf(Commands: { Command }): { OutcomeEmission }
	local Settled: { OutcomeEmission } = {}
	for _, Command in Commands do
		if Command.Kind == "Emit" and IsOutcome(Command) then
			table.insert(Settled, Command.Value :: OutcomeEmission)
		end
	end
	return Settled
end

local function Run(Commands: { Command })
	local Waiters = Calls.Claim(AnswersOf(Commands))
	for _, Command in Commands do
		if Command.Kind == "Answer" or IsOutcome(Command) then
			continue
		end
		local Handler = (Handlers :: { [string]: Handler })[Command.Kind]
		if Handler == nil then
			error(NoHandler(Command.Kind), 0)
		end
		Handler(Command, Feed)
	end
	Calls.SettleOutcomes(OutcomesOf(Commands))
	Calls.Resume(Waiters)
end

local function FeedAt(Clock: number, Happening: Happening)
	local Event: Event = { Clock = Clock, Happening = Happening }
	local _, Commands = Stepping.Run(Step.Step, StateOf(), Event)
	Run(Commands)
end

function Feed(Happening: Happening)
	FeedAt(Platform.Now(), Happening)
end

local function Call(Made: Call): Future<Answer>
	local Job = Calls.Open(Made.CallId, Made.Method)
	Feed(Made)
	return Job
end

local function CallWithOutcome(Made: Call): Future<Answer, Outcome?>
	local Job = Calls.OpenWithOutcome(Made.CallId, Made.Method)
	Feed(Made)
	return Job
end

local function WouldWait(Made: Call): boolean
	return CoreCalls.WouldWait(StateOf(), Made, Platform.Now())
end

local function CallNow(Made: Call): Answer
	Calls.Expect(Made.CallId)
	Feed(Made)
	local Given = Calls.Take(Made.CallId)
	if Given ~= nil then
		return Given
	end
	return Calls.Open(Made.CallId, Made.Method):Wait()
end

local function CallNowForId(Made: Call): Answer
	if next(Stores) == nil then
		Composed.RecordServerLimits(StateOf(), ShellLimits.BuildDefault(Platform.IsStudio()))
	end
	return CallNow(Made)
end

local function SecondsLeft(Deadline: number?): number
	if Deadline == nil then
		return 0
	end
	return math.max(Platform.SecondsUntil(Deadline), 0)
end

local function EndByDeadline(Answered: Future<Answer>, Deadline: number?, EndClose: () -> ())
	Answered:Wait(SecondsLeft(Deadline))
	if not Answered:Happened() then
		local Tick: Happening = { Kind = "Clock" }
		Threads.Spawn(Feed, Tick)
	end
	Calls.CloseAll()
	EndClose()
end

local function Called(Body: () -> ()): string?
	Body()
	return nil
end

local function TraceOf(Problem: unknown): string
	return debug.traceback(tostring(Problem))
end

local function WaitForBeforeClose()
	local Running = #BeforeCloseFunctions
	local AllReturned: Future<()>, EndAll: () -> () = Future.Pending()
	local function RunOne(Body: () -> ())
		local _, Trace = xpcall(Called, TraceOf, Body)
		if Trace ~= nil then
			warn(BeforeCloseErrored(Trace))
		end
		Running -= 1
		if Running == 0 then
			EndAll()
		end
	end
	for _, Body in BeforeCloseFunctions do
		Threads.Spawn(RunOne, Body)
	end
	AllReturned:Wait(BeforeCloseSeconds)
end

local function Started(): Future<()>
	local Kept = Closing
	if Kept ~= nil then
		return Kept
	end
	local Ended: Future<()>, EndClose: () -> () = Future.Pending()
	Closing = Ended
	local Began = Platform.Now()
	local Deadline = CoreClosing.ShutdownDeadline(StateOf().Server, Began)
	local Clock = Began
	if #BeforeCloseFunctions > 0 then
		WaitForBeforeClose()
		Clock = Platform.Now()
	end
	local CloseCall: Call = { Kind = "Call", Method = CloseMethod, CallId = Calls.NewCallId(), BeganAt = Began }
	CloseCallId = CloseCall.CallId
	local Answered = Calls.Open(CloseCall.CallId, CloseCall.Method)
	Threads.Spawn(EndByDeadline, Answered, Deadline, EndClose)
	FeedAt(Clock, CloseCall)
	return Ended
end

local function CloseAll()
	Started():Wait()
end

local function IsClosing(): boolean
	return Closing ~= nil
end

local function Start()
	if Current ~= nil then
		error(StartedTwice, 0)
	end
	Current = Composed.NewState(Composed.NewServer(Platform.JobId(), Platform.Encoding))
	game:BindToClose(CloseAll)
end

local function AddBeforeClose(Body: () -> ())
	if Closing ~= nil then
		error(ServerClosing, 0)
	end
	table.insert(BeforeCloseFunctions, Body)
end

local function IsOpened(Name: string): boolean
	return Stores[Name] ~= nil
end

local function OpenedSetup(Name: string): Setup
	local Found = Stores[Name]
	if Found == nil then
		error(NoSetup(Name), 0)
	end
	return Found.Setup
end

local function AddStore(Setup: Setup, IsPlayerStore: boolean)
	local Running = StateOf()
	if IsOpened(Setup.Store) then
		error(AlreadyOpened(Setup.Store), 0)
	end
	Composed.OpenStore(Running, Setup)
	Stores[Setup.Store] = { Setup = Setup, IsPlayerStore = IsPlayerStore }
	Feed({ Kind = "Clock" })
end

return {
	Start = Start,
	AddStore = AddStore,
	AddBeforeClose = AddBeforeClose,
	IsOpened = IsOpened,
	OpenedSetup = OpenedSetup,
	Call = Call,
	CallWithOutcome = CallWithOutcome,
	WouldWait = WouldWait,
	CallNow = CallNow,
	CallNowForId = CallNowForId,
	CloseAll = CloseAll,
	IsClosing = IsClosing,
	IsStepping = Stepping.IsStepping,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Services: the DataStore, MemoryStore and JSON calls, one request in, one Result out, through ResultOf's one pcall;
	a listing gives one page through PageResultOf's. A failed request's error is not read: a failed Get is throttled
	when this server's StandardRead budget is below 1, every other failure fails plainly. A key listing takes 50 keys
	a page, deleted ones left out; a version listing takes the platform's default page (0, which is 1024), oldest
	first, the order named since the Mock defaults to newest first. Server-only services are got at first use. A mock,
	given through a store's Mock option, stands in for both services for the whole server, since Ledger's own stores
	cannot be split from the game's: one mock per server, and only before the first request, so a store opened on the
	real services never continues on it.

	Return type: A plain table with one function per call, and the Result, Page, PageResult, KeyVersion and Transform
	types.
	Example usage:
		local Result = Services.Get({ Store = "Players", Scope = "global", Key = "Alice" })
		if Result.Kind == "Err" and Result.IsThrottled then ... end
--]=]

local GetOrMake = require("../Util/GetOrMake").GetOrMake
local Names = require("../Keys/Encoding/Names")

type StoreKey = Names.StoreKey

export type Result =
	{ read Kind: "Ok", read Value: unknown }
	| { read Kind: "Absent" }
	| { read Kind: "Err", read IsThrottled: boolean }

export type Page<Entry> = {
	read Pages: Pages,
	read Entries: { Entry },
	read IsLast: boolean,
}

export type PageResult<Entry> = { read Kind: "Ok", read Page: Page<Entry> } | { read Kind: "Err" }

export type KeyVersion = {
	read Version: string,
	read CreatedTime: number,
	read IsDeleted: boolean,
}

export type Transform = (Current: unknown) -> (unknown, { number }?)

export type MemoryTransform = (Current: unknown) -> unknown

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local KeysPageSize = 50
local AnyKeyPrefix = ""
local ExcludeDeleted = true
local DefaultPageSize = 0
local NoDateBound = 0

local DataStores: { [string]: { [string]: DataStore } } = {}
local Maps: { [string]: MemoryStoreHashMap } = {}

local ChosenMock: unknown? = nil
local IsRequested = false

local MockAfterRequest = "Ledger.New: Mock must be given before Ledger's first request on the real services, "
	.. "since a server cannot move its stores from one to the other"
local AnotherMock = "Ledger.New: Mock must be the mock the first store on this server gave, since Ledger's own "
	.. "stores share one set of services with the game's, got another one"

local function NewUncachedGet(): DataStoreGetOptions
	local Options = Instance.new("DataStoreGetOptions")
	Options.UseCache = false
	return Options
end

local Uncached: DataStoreGetOptions? = nil

local function NoScopes(): { [string]: DataStore }
	return {}
end

local function UncachedGet(): DataStoreGetOptions
	local Kept = Uncached
	if Kept ~= nil then
		return Kept
	end
	local Made = NewUncachedGet()
	Uncached = Made
	return Made
end

local function GetDataStoreService(): DataStoreService
	IsRequested = true
	local Mock = ChosenMock
	if Mock ~= nil then
		return Mock :: any
	end
	return game:GetService("DataStoreService")
end

local function GetMemoryStoreService(): MemoryStoreService
	IsRequested = true
	local Mock = ChosenMock
	if Mock ~= nil then
		return Mock :: any
	end
	return game:GetService("MemoryStoreService")
end

local function DataStoreOf(Store: string, Scope: string): DataStore
	local Scopes = GetOrMake(DataStores, Store, NoScopes)
	return GetOrMake(Scopes, Scope, function(): DataStore
		return GetDataStoreService():GetDataStore(Store, Scope)
	end)
end

local function MapOf(Name: string): MemoryStoreHashMap
	return GetOrMake(Maps, Name, function(): MemoryStoreHashMap
		return GetMemoryStoreService():GetHashMap(Name)
	end)
end

local function ResultOf(Body: () -> unknown): Result
	local IsReturned, Answer = pcall(Body)
	if not IsReturned then
		return { Kind = "Err", IsThrottled = false }
	end
	if Answer == nil then
		return { Kind = "Absent" }
	end
	return { Kind = "Ok", Value = Answer }
end

local function ReadGetBudget(): unknown
	return GetDataStoreService():GetRequestBudgetForRequestType(Enum.DataStoreRequestType.StandardRead)
end

local function IsGetBudgetSpent(): boolean
	local Budget = ResultOf(ReadGetBudget)
	if Budget.Kind ~= "Ok" then
		return false
	end
	local Left = Budget.Value
	if type(Left) ~= "number" then
		return false
	end
	return Left < 1
end

local function ReadGetThrottle(Result: Result): Result
	if Result.Kind ~= "Err" then
		return Result
	end
	return { Kind = "Err", IsThrottled = IsGetBudgetSpent() }
end

local function Update(Target: StoreKey, Transform: Transform): Result
	return ResultOf(function()
		return (DataStoreOf(Target.Store, Target.Scope):UpdateAsync(Target.Key, Transform))
	end)
end

local function Get(Target: StoreKey): Result
	local Result = ResultOf(function()
		return (DataStoreOf(Target.Store, Target.Scope):GetAsync(Target.Key, UncachedGet()))
	end)
	return ReadGetThrottle(Result)
end

local function GetVersion(Target: StoreKey, Version: string): Result
	return ResultOf(function()
		return (DataStoreOf(Target.Store, Target.Scope):GetVersionAsync(Target.Key, Version))
	end)
end

local function Remove(Target: StoreKey): Result
	return ResultOf(function()
		return (DataStoreOf(Target.Store, Target.Scope):RemoveAsync(Target.Key))
	end)
end

local function MemoryGet(Map: string, Key: string): Result
	return ResultOf(function()
		return MapOf(Map):GetAsync(Key)
	end)
end

local function MemorySet(Map: string, Key: string, Value: unknown, Expiry: number): Result
	return ResultOf(function()
		return MapOf(Map):SetAsync(Key, Value, Expiry)
	end)
end

local function MemoryUpdate(Map: string, Key: string, Transform: MemoryTransform, Expiry: number): Result
	return ResultOf(function()
		return MapOf(Map):UpdateAsync(Key, Transform, Expiry)
	end)
end

local function MemoryRemove(Map: string, Key: string): Result
	return ResultOf(function()
		MapOf(Map):RemoveAsync(Key)
		return nil
	end)
end

local function KeysPageOf(Pages: Pages): Page<string>
	local Names: { string } = {}
	for _, Entry in Pages:GetCurrentPage() do
		table.insert(Names, (Entry :: DataStoreKey).KeyName)
	end
	return { Pages = Pages, Entries = Names, IsLast = Pages.IsFinished }
end

local function VersionsPageOf(Pages: Pages): Page<KeyVersion>
	local Versions: { KeyVersion } = {}
	for _, Entry in Pages:GetCurrentPage() do
		local Info = Entry :: DataStoreObjectVersionInfo
		table.insert(Versions, { Version = Info.Version, CreatedTime = Info.CreatedTime, IsDeleted = Info.IsDeleted })
	end
	return { Pages = Pages, Entries = Versions, IsLast = Pages.IsFinished }
end

local function PageResultOf<Entry>(Body: () -> Page<Entry>): PageResult<Entry>
	local IsReturned, Made = pcall(Body)
	if not IsReturned then
		return { Kind = "Err" }
	end
	return { Kind = "Ok", Page = Made }
end

local function ListKeys(Store: string, Scope: string, Prefix: string?): PageResult<string>
	return PageResultOf(function()
		local Listed =
			DataStoreOf(Store, Scope):ListKeysAsync(Prefix or AnyKeyPrefix, KeysPageSize, nil, ExcludeDeleted)
		return KeysPageOf(Listed)
	end)
end

local function ReadKeys(Pages: Pages): PageResult<string>
	return PageResultOf(function()
		return KeysPageOf(Pages)
	end)
end

local function ListVersions(Target: StoreKey): PageResult<KeyVersion>
	return PageResultOf(function()
		local Listed = DataStoreOf(Target.Store, Target.Scope):ListVersionsAsync(
			Target.Key,
			Enum.SortDirection.Ascending,
			NoDateBound,
			NoDateBound,
			DefaultPageSize
		)
		return VersionsPageOf(Listed)
	end)
end

local function ReadVersions(Pages: Pages): PageResult<KeyVersion>
	return PageResultOf(function()
		return VersionsPageOf(Pages)
	end)
end

local function AdvancePages(Pages: Pages): Result
	return ResultOf(function()
		Pages:AdvanceToNextPageAsync()
		return true
	end)
end

local function UseMock(Mock: unknown): ()
	local Chosen = ChosenMock
	if Chosen ~= nil then
		if not rawequal(Chosen, Mock) then
			error(AnotherMock, 0)
		end
		return
	end

	if IsRequested then
		error(MockAfterRequest, 0)
	end
	ChosenMock = Mock
end

local function JsonDecode(Text: string): Result
	return ResultOf(function()
		return HttpService:JSONDecode(Text)
	end)
end

return {
	Update = Update,
	Get = Get,
	GetVersion = GetVersion,
	Remove = Remove,
	MemoryGet = MemoryGet,
	MemorySet = MemorySet,
	MemoryUpdate = MemoryUpdate,
	MemoryRemove = MemoryRemove,
	ListKeys = ListKeys,
	ReadKeys = ReadKeys,
	ListVersions = ListVersions,
	ReadVersions = ReadVersions,
	AdvancePages = AdvancePages,
	JsonDecode = JsonDecode,
	UseMock = UseMock,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Setup: a store's Settings, scope, part build, Build and core Setup. The reducer runs the game's (twice in Studio,
	compared, and a third time only when the runs differ, threw, yielded or gave an unstorable state), warning once
	per undeclared field, then Schema on a table result; a fail warns, unsaved. Schema skips migrations' outputs,
	older builds' states and balance ops'. Of its own game keys, a player store's builds reference only UserIds.
	OnLoadFailed keeps Kick.

	Return type: A plain table with StoreScope, KeysMode, BalanceOpsOf, FieldArithmeticsOf, DeclaredOf, FrozenInputs,
	SchemaProblem, IsUserIdKey, PartBuildOf and SetupOf, and the Settings types.
	Example usage:
		local PartBuild = Setup.PartBuildOf(Settings)
		local StoreSetup = Setup.SetupOf(Settings, PartBuild, Encoding, Limits, IsStudio)
--]=]

local Balances = require("../Keys/Trades/Balances")
local Cache = require("../Keys/DataStore/Cache")
local ExtrasShapes = require("../Shared/ReadShapes")
local Guards = require("../Keys/Ops/Guards")
local HashInputs = require("../Keys/Encoding/HashInputs")
local HotShapes = require("../Shared/QuantityShapes")
local Names = require("../Keys/Encoding/Names")
local PartBuilder = require("../Keys/Quantity/Build")
local Reasons = require("../Keys/Constants/Reasons")
local Record = require("../Keys/Constants/Record")
local Shapes = require("../Shared/Shapes")

type Arithmetic = Balances.Arithmetic
type Build = Shapes.Build
type Declaration = Balances.Declaration
type Encoding = HashInputs.Encoding
type KeyReference = Names.KeyReference
type Limits = Shapes.Limits
type Migration = Shapes.Migration
type QuantityDeclaration = HotShapes.QuantityDeclaration
type Reason = Reasons.Reason
type Reducer = Guards.Reducer<unknown, unknown, unknown>
type Setup = Shapes.Setup
type TotalDeclaration = ExtrasShapes.TotalDeclaration

type Terms = { [unknown]: unknown }

local KeysMode = {
	Player = "Player" :: "Player",
	String = "String" :: "String",
}

export type KeysMode = keyof<typeof(KeysMode)>

export type LoadFailedHandler = (Player: Player, Reason: Reason) -> ()

export type ResultSchema<D> = (State: D) -> (boolean, string?)

export type KindWindows = {
	read Timed: number,
	read Untimed: number,
	read IsUntimedSet: boolean,
}

export type SettledMigration = {
	read Run: Guards.MigrationRun,
	read IsBreaking: boolean,
	read Fields: { string },
}

export type Ops = { [string]: Declaration }

export type Settings = {
	read Name: string,
	read Keys: KeysMode,
	read Default: { [string]: unknown },
	read Reducer: Reducer?,
	read Schema: ResultSchema<unknown>?,
	read Ops: Ops,
	read Balances: { [string]: Arithmetic },
	read Migrations: { SettledMigration },
	read MustExist: boolean,
	read IsErasable: boolean,
	read LegLimit: number?,
	read OnLoadFailed: LoadFailedHandler?,
	read Kick: boolean,
	read KickMessage: string,
	read SaveInterval: number,
	read IdleReadInterval: number,
	read HoldMax: number,
	read OrphanAge: number,
	read Windows: { [string]: KindWindows },
	read CutWindow: number,
	read Totals: { [string]: TotalDeclaration },
	read Quantities: { [string]: QuantityDeclaration },
	read ClosedQuantities: { [string]: boolean },
	read Mock: unknown?,
}

local StoreScope = "global"

local KeyKinds = Record.KeyKind

local FrozenInputs: Guards.FreezeLimits = table.freeze({ FreezeInputs = true })

local SchemaGaveFalse = "false"
local StateNotSaved = "the reducer's state fails Schema, so it is not saved"
local OnlyDeclaredFields = "A reducer may set only the fields in Default or an additive migration's Fields, and a "
	.. 'field that is nil in Default is not one of them. Give "none" a value such as 0 or "" in Default'

local function DifferentRuns(Store: string, OpKind: string, Difference: string): string
	return `Ledger: store {Store}, an op of kind {OpKind}: {Difference}`
end

local function SchemaFailed(Store: string, OpKind: string, Problem: string): string
	return `Ledger: store {Store}, an op of kind {OpKind}: {StateNotSaved}: {Problem}`
end

local function UndeclaredHeld(Store: string, OpKind: string, Held: string): string
	return `Ledger: store {Store}, an op of kind {OpKind}: the reducer gave a state holding {Held}, which the store `
		.. `does not declare, and such a state is refused. {OnlyDeclaredFields}`
end

local function HeldText(Key: unknown): string
	if type(Key) == "string" then
		return `the field {Key}`
	end
	return `a {typeof(Key)} key`
end

local function RefuseEveryOp(State: unknown, Op: unknown): unknown?
	return nil
end

local function KindOf(Op: unknown): string
	if type(Op) ~= "table" then
		return tostring(Op)
	end
	return tostring((Op :: Terms).Kind)
end

local function TwiceRun(Reducer: Reducer, Store: string): Reducer
	return function(State: unknown, Op: unknown): unknown?
		local First = Guards.RunReducer(Reducer, State, Op, FrozenInputs)
		local Second = Guards.RunReducer(Reducer, State, Op, FrozenInputs)
		local Difference = Guards.CompareRuns(First, Second)
		if Difference ~= nil then
			warn(DifferentRuns(Store, KindOf(Op), Difference))
			return Reducer(State, Op)
		end
		if First.Kind == "State" then
			return First.State
		end
		if First.Kind == "NoState" then
			return nil
		end
		return Reducer(State, Op)
	end
end

local function UndeclaredWarned(Reducer: Reducer, Declared: { [string]: boolean }, Store: string): Reducer
	local Warned: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	return function(State: unknown, Op: unknown): unknown?
		local Result = Reducer(State, Op)
		if type(Result) ~= "table" then
			return Result
		end
		for Key in next, Result :: Terms do
			if type(Key) == "string" and Declared[Key] then
				continue
			end
			local Held = HeldText(Key)
			if not Warned[Held] then
				Warned[Held] = true
				warn(UndeclaredHeld(Store, KindOf(Op), Held))
			end
		end
		return Result
	end
end

local function SchemaProblem(Schema: ResultSchema<unknown>, State: unknown): string?
	local Passes, Message = Schema(State)
	if Passes == true then
		return nil
	end
	if Message == nil then
		return SchemaGaveFalse
	end
	return Message
end

local function SchemaChecked(Reducer: Reducer, Schema: ResultSchema<unknown>, Store: string): Reducer
	return function(State: unknown, Op: unknown): unknown?
		local Result = Reducer(State, Op)
		if type(Result) ~= "table" then
			return Result
		end
		local Problem = SchemaProblem(Schema, Result)
		if Problem == nil then
			return Result
		end
		warn(SchemaFailed(Store, KindOf(Op), Problem))
		return nil
	end
end

local function ReducerOf(Settings: Settings, Declared: { [string]: boolean }, IsStudio: boolean): Reducer
	local Reducer = Settings.Reducer
	if Reducer == nil then
		return RefuseEveryOp
	end
	local Watched = UndeclaredWarned(Reducer, Declared, Settings.Name)
	local Run = if IsStudio then TwiceRun(Watched, Settings.Name) else Watched
	local Schema = Settings.Schema
	if Schema == nil then
		return Run
	end
	return SchemaChecked(Run, Schema, Settings.Name)
end

local function MigrationsOf(Settled: { SettledMigration }): { Migration }
	local Runs: { Migration } = {}
	for _, Migration in Settled do
		table.insert(Runs, table.freeze({ Run = Migration.Run, IsBreaking = Migration.IsBreaking }))
	end
	return table.freeze(Runs)
end

local function BreakingIndexOf(Settled: { SettledMigration }): number
	local Last = 0
	for Index, Migration in Settled do
		if Migration.IsBreaking then
			Last = Index
		end
	end
	return Last
end

local function DeclaredOf(Settings: Settings): { [string]: boolean }
	local Declared: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for Field in Settings.Default do
		Declared[Field] = true
	end
	for _, Migration in Settings.Migrations do
		for _, Field in Migration.Fields do
			Declared[Field] = true
		end
	end
	return table.freeze(Declared)
end

local function BalanceOpsOf(Settings: Settings): { [string]: Declaration }
	return Settings.Ops
end

local function FieldArithmeticsOf(Settings: Settings): { [string]: Arithmetic }
	local Fields: { [string]: Arithmetic } = table.clone(Settings.Balances)
	for _, Kind in Settings.Ops do
		if Fields[Kind.Field] ~= nil then
			continue
		end
		Fields[Kind.Field] = Balances.ArithmeticOf(Kind)
	end
	return table.freeze(Fields)
end

local function IsUserIdKey(Key: string): boolean
	return tonumber(Key) ~= nil
end

local function PlayerStoreReferences(Store: string): (Reference: KeyReference) -> boolean
	return function(Reference: KeyReference): boolean
		if Reference.Kind == "Full" and Reference.Store ~= Store then
			return true
		end
		local Named = { Store = Store, Scope = StoreScope, Key = Reference.Key }
		return Cache.KindOfKey(Named) ~= KeyKinds.Game or IsUserIdKey(Reference.Key)
	end
end

local function ReferencesOf(Settings: Settings): ((Reference: KeyReference) -> boolean)?
	if Settings.Keys ~= KeysMode.Player then
		return nil
	end
	return PlayerStoreReferences(Settings.Name)
end

local function PartBuildOf(Settings: Settings): Build
	return PartBuilder.NewBuild(FieldArithmeticsOf(Settings), ReferencesOf(Settings))
end

local function BuildOf(Settings: Settings, IsStudio: boolean): Build
	local Kinds = BalanceOpsOf(Settings)
	local Declared = DeclaredOf(Settings)
	return table.freeze({
		KeyKind = KeyKinds.Game,
		Migrations = MigrationsOf(Settings.Migrations),
		MigrationCount = #Settings.Migrations,
		BreakingIndex = BreakingIndexOf(Settings.Migrations),
		Reducer = ReducerOf(Settings, Declared, IsStudio),
		Default = Settings.Default,
		Declared = Declared,
		Balances = FieldArithmeticsOf(Settings),
		BalanceOps = Kinds,
		MayReference = ReferencesOf(Settings),
	})
end

local function SetupOf(
	Settings: Settings,
	PartBuild: Build,
	Encoding: Encoding,
	Limits: Limits,
	IsStudio: boolean
): Setup
	return table.freeze({
		Store = Settings.Name,
		Build = BuildOf(Settings, IsStudio),
		Limits = Limits,
		Encoding = Encoding,
		IsErasable = Settings.IsErasable,
		CreatesOnFirstWrite = not Settings.MustExist,
		PartBuild = PartBuild,
	})
end

return {
	StoreScope = StoreScope,
	KeysMode = table.freeze(KeysMode),
	FrozenInputs = FrozenInputs,
	SchemaProblem = SchemaProblem,
	IsUserIdKey = IsUserIdKey,
	BalanceOpsOf = BalanceOpsOf,
	FieldArithmeticsOf = FieldArithmeticsOf,
	DeclaredOf = DeclaredOf,
	PartBuildOf = PartBuildOf,
	SetupOf = SetupOf,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Stepping: marks the game code Ledger runs (the core's steps and transforms, the API's checks), so the API can
	refuse a Ledger call from it, on the marked thread or a coroutine that thread resumed. A mark holds only while Run
	is on its thread's stack, so a raise leaves none.

	Return type: A plain table with Run and IsStepping.
	Example usage:
		local _, Commands = Stepping.Run(Step.Step, State, Event)
		local IsInside = Stepping.IsStepping()
--]=]

local Threads = require("../Util/Threads")

local NormalStatus = "normal"

local Depths: { [thread]: number } = {}
setmetatable(Depths, { __mode = "k" })

local function Unmarked<Result...>(Thread: thread, ...: Result...): Result...
	local Depth = Depths[Thread] - 1
	Depths[Thread] = if Depth == 0 then nil else Depth
	return ...
end

local function Run<Args..., Result...>(Body: (Args...) -> Result..., ...: Args...): Result...
	local Thread = coroutine.running()
	Depths[Thread] = (Depths[Thread] or 0) + 1
	return Unmarked(Thread, Body(...))
end

local function IsStepping(): boolean
	local Current = coroutine.running()
	for Thread in Depths do
		if Thread == Current or coroutine.status(Thread) == NormalStatus then
			if Threads.HasFrame(Thread, Run) then
				return true
			end
			Depths[Thread] = nil
		end
	end
	return false
end

return {
	Run = Run,
	IsStepping = IsStepping,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Streams: the observer streams the core's Emit commands feed, by stream name and key. A key's last View is kept with
	no listener. Follows keeps one observer per key, whose first caller's Start and Stop serve all; a late listener gets
	its last value. Forget drops a released session's view and its View and Fate streams, never a Follow observer.

	Return type: A plain table with OnEmit, ViewOf, Views, Fates, Follows, Stales and Forget.
	Example usage:
		Streams.Views(Key):Subscribe(print)
		Streams.OnEmit({ Kind = "Emit", Stream = "View", Key = Key, Value = View })
--]=]

local Events = require("../Shared/Events")
local Names = require("../Keys/Encoding/Names")
local Observer = require("../Util/Observer")
local Value = require("../Keys/Format/Value")
local WritingAnswers = require("../Keys/DataStore/Answers")

type Answer = Events.Answer
type EmitCommand = Events.EmitCommand
type StoreKey = Names.StoreKey
type Fields = Value.Fields
type FateEmission = WritingAnswers.FateEmission
type Observer<T> = Observer.Observer<T>
type Subject<T> = Observer.Subject<T>

type Handler = (Key: StoreKey, Given: unknown) -> ()

local function NoStream(Stream: string): string
	return `Streams: the core emitted on the stream {Stream}, which no handler feeds.`
end

local LastViews: { [string]: Fields } = {}
local ViewSubjects: { [string]: Subject<Fields> } = {}
local FateSubjects: { [string]: Subject<FateEmission> } = {}

local FollowObservers: { [string]: Observer<Answer> } = {}
local FollowEmits: { [string]: (Answer) -> () } = {}

local StaleSubjects: { [string]: Subject<StoreKey> } = {}

local function SubjectOf<T>(Subjects: { [string]: Subject<T> }, Text: string): Subject<T>
	local Kept = Subjects[Text]
	if Kept ~= nil then
		return Kept
	end
	local Made: Subject<T> = Observer.New()
	Subjects[Text] = Made
	return Made
end

local function DestroySubject<T>(Subjects: { [string]: Subject<T> }, Text: string)
	local Kept = Subjects[Text]
	if Kept == nil then
		return
	end
	Kept:Destroy()
	Subjects[Text] = nil
end

local function OnView(Key: StoreKey, View: Fields)
	local Text = Names.KeyText(Key)
	LastViews[Text] = View
	local Subject = ViewSubjects[Text]
	if Subject ~= nil then
		Subject:Push(View)
	end
end

local function OnFate(Key: StoreKey, Emission: FateEmission)
	local Subject = FateSubjects[Names.KeyText(Key)]
	if Subject ~= nil then
		Subject:Push(Emission)
	end
end

local function OnFollow(Key: StoreKey, Given: Answer)
	local Emit = FollowEmits[Names.KeyText(Key)]
	if Emit ~= nil then
		Emit(Given)
	end
end

local function OnStale(Key: StoreKey)
	local Subject = StaleSubjects[Key.Store]
	if Subject ~= nil then
		Subject:Push(Key)
	end
end

local Handlers = {
	View = OnView,
	Fate = OnFate,
	Follow = OnFollow,
	Stale = OnStale,
}

local function OnEmit(Command: EmitCommand)
	local Handler = (Handlers :: { [string]: Handler })[Command.Stream]
	if Handler == nil then
		error(NoStream(Command.Stream), 0)
	end
	Handler(Command.Key, Command.Value)
end

local function ViewOf(Key: StoreKey): Fields?
	return LastViews[Names.KeyText(Key)]
end

local function Views(Key: StoreKey): Observer<Fields>
	return SubjectOf(ViewSubjects, Names.KeyText(Key))
end

local function Fates(Key: StoreKey): Observer<FateEmission>
	return SubjectOf(FateSubjects, Names.KeyText(Key))
end

local function Follows(Key: StoreKey, Start: () -> (), Stop: () -> ()): Observer<Answer>
	local Text = Names.KeyText(Key)
	local Kept = FollowObservers[Text]
	if Kept ~= nil then
		return Kept
	end
	local Made = Observer.FromLatest(function(Emit: (Answer) -> ())
		FollowEmits[Text] = Emit
		Start()
		return function()
			FollowEmits[Text] = nil
			Stop()
		end
	end)
	FollowObservers[Text] = Made
	return Made
end

local function Stales(Store: string): Observer<StoreKey>
	return SubjectOf(StaleSubjects, Store)
end

local function Forget(Key: StoreKey)
	local Text = Names.KeyText(Key)
	LastViews[Text] = nil
	DestroySubject(ViewSubjects, Text)
	DestroySubject(FateSubjects, Text)
end

return {
	OnEmit = OnEmit,
	ViewOf = ViewOf,
	Views = Views,
	Fates = Fates,
	Follows = Follows,
	Stales = Stales,
	Forget = Forget,
}

--!optimize 2

--[=[

	flight, the held calls, the transaction, cut, extras and hot states, the kept wake and the requests out by id.

	A replay passes its own server to NewState. Opening a store forgets the kept wake. Its first Limits recorded stay.

	Return type: A plain table of functions, and the State, Held, HeldCall, IncarnationRead, Flush, NumberRetry,
	WriterRequest and KeptWake types.

		Composed.OpenStore(State, Setup)
--]=]

local function NewServer(JobId: string, Encoding: Encoding): ServerState
	return {
		JobId = JobId,
		Encoding = Encoding,
		NumbersAsked = {},
		Counter = 0,
		RequestCounter = 0,
		HelperCounter = 0,
		Caches = {},
		CacheOrder = Recency.New(),
		Unserved = { States = {}, Order = Recency.New() },
		Shown = {
			Order = Recency.New(),
			Keys = {},
			Counts = {},
			Incarnations = {},
			LastShown = {},
			Bits = buffer.create(Record.ShownBitCount // Record.BitsPerByte),
		},
		SentNames = {},
		SentOrder = Recency.New(),
		Stores = {},
		Rides = {},
		WorkSeen = {},
		SealsSeen = {},
		Landed = {},
		StepOut = {},
	}

local function NewState(Server: ServerState): State
	return {
		Server = Server,
		Sessions = Session.NewState(),
		Reads = {},
		Incarnations = {},
		Flushing = {},
		Held = {},
		NumberRetry = { ErrorsInARow = 0, Asks = {}, IsUnusableWarned = false },
		Sendable = {},
		TimersMoved = {},
		Wake = { IsKnown = false, KeyAt = {}, KeyShedAt = {}, KeyOf = {} },
		WriterRequests = {},
		IncarnationReads = {},
		Tx = TxState.NewState(),
		Cuts = CutState.NewState(),
		Extras = ExtrasState.NewState(),
		Hot = HotState.NewState(),
	}

local function RecordServerLimits(State: State, Limits: Limits)
	local Server = State.Server
	if Server.Limits == nil then
		Server.Limits = Limits
	end
end

local function OpenStore(State: State, Setup: Setup)
	State.Server.Stores[Setup.Store] = { Setup = Setup, Writers = {} }
	RecordServerLimits(State, Setup.Limits)
	State.Wake.IsKnown = false
end

local function ServedOf(State: State): Served
	return { Open = State.Sessions.Open, Followers = State.Extras.Followers, CopyHolders = State.Extras.CopyHolders }
end

local function ReadContextAt(State: State, Clock: number): ReadContext
	return {
		Clock = Clock,
		Served = ServedOf(State),
		IsSilent = Closing.IsPastDeadline(State.Sessions, Clock),
		Aborted = TxState.AbortedUses(State.Tx),
	}
end

local function NoteTimersMovedAt(State: State, Text: string, Key: StoreKey)
	State.TimersMoved[Text] = Key
end

local function NoteTimersMoved(State: State, Key: StoreKey)
	NoteTimersMovedAt(State, Names.KeyText(Key), Key)
end

local function NoteSendableAt(State: State, Text: string, Key: StoreKey)
	State.Sendable[Text] = Key
	NoteTimersMovedAt(State, Text, Key)
end

local function NoteSendable(State: State, Key: StoreKey)
	NoteSendableAt(State, Names.KeyText(Key), Key)
end

local function OpenCount(State: State): number
	return TxState.OpenCount(State.Tx)
		+ CutState.OpenCount(State.Cuts)
		+ ExtrasState.OpenCount(State.Extras)
		+ HotState.OpenCount(State.Hot, State.Server)
end

local function EndClose(State: State, Clock: number, Commands: { Command })
	if not Closing.IsEnding(State.Sessions) then
		return
	end
	Closing.EndClose(State.Server, State.Sessions, OpenCount(State), Clock, Commands)
end

local function IsReached(At: number?, Clock: number): boolean
	return At ~= nil and Clock >= At
end

local function EarliestAfter(Soonest: number?, At: number?, Clock: number): number?
	if At == nil or At <= Clock then
		return Soonest
	end
	if Soonest == nil or At < Soonest then
		return At
	end
	return Soonest
end

return {
	NewServer = NewServer,
	NewState = NewState,
	RecordServerLimits = RecordServerLimits,
	OpenStore = OpenStore,
	ServedOf = ServedOf,
	ReadContextAt = ReadContextAt,
	NoteSendable = NoteSendable,
	NoteSendableAt = NoteSendableAt,
	NoteTimersMoved = NoteTimersMoved,
	NoteTimersMovedAt = NoteTimersMovedAt,
	EndClose = EndClose,
	IsReached = IsReached,
	EarliestAfter = EarliestAfter,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	DueTimes: times at which items fall due, kept as a binary min-heap in a plain array (an empty table is an empty
	one), so a pass over what is due touches only the due items and not every item held.

	An added time is a hint and is never taken back. The owner checks each item TakeDue hands it against the item's own
	fields, and Soonest counts a time only where the caller's IsCurrent says it is still the item's; so a time left
	behind by a change costs one look when it falls due. TakeDue gives the items in heap order, which is not
	deterministic among equal times: an owner that needs an order sorts what it gets.

	Return type: A plain table with Add, TakeDue and Soonest, and the Due and DueTimes types.
	Example usage:
		DueTimes.Add(Times, Text, Clock + CheckEvery)
		for _, Text in DueTimes.TakeDue(Times, Clock) do ... end
--]=]

export type Due<Item> = { read At: number, read Item: Item }

export type DueTimes<Item> = { Due<Item> }

local HeapArity = 2

local function SiftUp<Item>(Heap: { Due<Item> }, Index: number)
	local Moving = Heap[Index]
	while Index > 1 do
		local Parent = Index // HeapArity
		local Above = Heap[Parent]
		if Above.At <= Moving.At then
			break
		end
		Heap[Index] = Above
		Index = Parent
	end
	Heap[Index] = Moving
end

local function SiftDown<Item>(Heap: { Due<Item> }, Index: number)
	local Size = #Heap
	local Moving = Heap[Index]
	while true do
		local Child = Index * HeapArity
		if Child > Size then
			break
		end
		if Child < Size and Heap[Child + 1].At < Heap[Child].At then
			Child += 1
		end
		if Moving.At <= Heap[Child].At then
			break
		end
		Heap[Index] = Heap[Child]
		Index = Child
	end
	Heap[Index] = Moving
end

local function Add<Item>(Heap: DueTimes<Item>, Item: Item, At: number)
	table.insert(Heap, { At = At, Item = Item })
	SiftUp(Heap, #Heap)
end

local function TakeFirst<Item>(Heap: { Due<Item> }): Due<Item>
	local First = Heap[1]
	local Last = table.remove(Heap) :: Due<Item>
	if #Heap > 0 then
		Heap[1] = Last
		SiftDown(Heap, 1)
	end
	return First
end

local function TakeDue<Item>(Heap: DueTimes<Item>, Clock: number): { Item }
	local Taken: { Item } = {}
	while #Heap > 0 and Heap[1].At <= Clock do
		table.insert(Taken, TakeFirst(Heap).Item)
	end
	return Taken
end

local function SoonestFrom<Item, Context>(
	Heap: { Due<Item> },
	Index: number,
	Clock: number,
	Context: Context,
	IsCurrent: (Context, Item, number) -> boolean,
	Found: number?
): number?
	local Node = Heap[Index]
	if Node == nil or (Found ~= nil and Node.At >= Found) then
		return Found
	end
	if Node.At > Clock and IsCurrent(Context, Node.Item, Node.At) then
		return Node.At
	end
	local Left = SoonestFrom(Heap, Index * HeapArity, Clock, Context, IsCurrent, Found)
	return SoonestFrom(Heap, Index * HeapArity + 1, Clock, Context, IsCurrent, Left)
end

local function Soonest<Item, Context>(
	Heap: DueTimes<Item>,
	Clock: number,
	Context: Context,
	IsCurrent: (Context, Item, number) -> boolean
): number?
	return SoonestFrom(Heap, 1, Clock, Context, IsCurrent, nil)
end

return {
	Add = Add,
	TakeDue = TakeDue,
	Soonest = Soonest,
}

--!strict

--[=[
	Replies: the one way the core answers a call, an Answer command, and settles an Unresolved call's outcome, an Emit
	on the Outcome stream: true, Refused, Spent, Full, Missing, Behind or Expired as heard, else Unresolved. A named no
	carries its call's name and first send time; Busy and Closed, decided before anything is sent, carry none.

	Return type: A plain table with DoneAnswer, UnresolvedAnswer, FailedAnswer, GivenNameOf, Named, Reply, ReplyFailed,
	OutcomeStream, IsUnresolved, SettleOutcome and SettleOutcomeUnresolved, and the OutcomeEmission type.
	Example usage:
		Replies.ReplyFailed(Commands, CallId, Reasons.Closed)
--]=]

local Events = require("./Events")
local Names = require("../Keys/Encoding/Names")
local Reasons = require("../Keys/Constants/Reasons")

type Answer = Events.Answer
type Command = Events.Command
type GivenName = Names.GivenName
type OpName = Names.OpName
type StoreKey = Names.StoreKey
type Reason = Reasons.Reason

export type OutcomeEmission = { read CallId: number, read Answer: Answer }

local DoneAnswer: Answer = table.freeze({ Kind = "Succeeded" :: "Succeeded", Value = nil })

local OutcomeStream = "Outcome"

local SentNothing: { [Reason]: true } = {
	[Reasons.Busy] = true,
	[Reasons.Closed] = true,
}

local function FailedAnswer(Reason: Reason): Answer
	return { Kind = "Failed", Reason = Reason, State = nil }
end

local UnresolvedAnswer: Answer = table.freeze(FailedAnswer(Reasons.Unresolved))

local OutcomeReasons: { [Reason]: true } = {
	[Reasons.Refused] = true,
	[Reasons.Spent] = true,
	[Reasons.Full] = true,
	[Reasons.Missing] = true,
	[Reasons.Behind] = true,
	[Reasons.Expired] = true,
}

local function GivenNameOf(Name: OpName, Stamp: number): GivenName
	if Name.Kind == "Drawn" then
		return { Kind = "Drawn", Server = Name.Server, Counter = Name.Counter, Stamp = Stamp }
	end
	return { Kind = "Game", Text = Name.Text, Stamp = Stamp }
end

local function Named(Given: Answer, Name: GivenName?): Answer
	if Given.Kind ~= "Failed" or Name == nil or SentNothing[Given.Reason] then
		return Given
	end
	return {
		Kind = "Failed",
		Reason = Given.Reason,
		State = Given.State,
		Identity = Given.Identity,
		Name = Name,
		ShortReason = Given.ShortReason,
		Key = Given.Key,
	}
end

local function Reply(Commands: { Command }, CallId: number, Given: Answer)
	local Answered: Command = { Kind = "Answer", CallId = CallId, Answer = Given }
	table.insert(Commands, Answered)
end

local function ReplyFailed(Commands: { Command }, CallId: number, Reason: Reason)
	Reply(Commands, CallId, FailedAnswer(Reason))
end

local function IsUnresolved(Given: Answer): boolean
	return Given.Kind == "Failed" and Given.Reason == Reasons.Unresolved
end

local function OutcomeAnswerOf(Given: Answer): Answer
	if Given.Kind == "Succeeded" or OutcomeReasons[Given.Reason] then
		return Given
	end
	return UnresolvedAnswer
end

local function SettleOutcome(Commands: { Command }, Key: StoreKey, CallId: number, Given: Answer)
	local Emission: OutcomeEmission = { CallId = CallId, Answer = OutcomeAnswerOf(Given) }
	local Emitted: Command = { Kind = "Emit", Stream = OutcomeStream, Key = Key, Value = Emission }
	table.insert(Commands, Emitted)
end

local function SettleOutcomeUnresolved(Commands: { Command }, Key: StoreKey, CallId: number)
	SettleOutcome(Commands, Key, CallId, UnresolvedAnswer)
end

return {
	DoneAnswer = DoneAnswer,
	UnresolvedAnswer = UnresolvedAnswer,
	FailedAnswer = FailedAnswer,
	GivenNameOf = GivenNameOf,
	Named = Named,
	Reply = Reply,
	ReplyFailed = ReplyFailed,
	OutcomeStream = OutcomeStream,
	IsUnresolved = IsUnresolved,
	SettleOutcome = SettleOutcome,
	SettleOutcomeUnresolved = SettleOutcomeUnresolved,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Future: Plumbing. Holds the answer to a call that has not finished yet.

	A future settles once, and a second settle throws. Wait with a timeout gives back nothing when the
	timeout comes first, and the future may still settle later. A waiter whose thread is gone is skipped.

	Return type: The Future class.
	Example usage:
		local Answer = Job:Wait()
--]=]

type Packed = { n: number, [number]: any }

type FutureImpl<T...> = {
	__index: FutureImpl<T...>,
	Wait: (self: Future<T...>, Timeout: number?) -> T...,
	Happened: (self: Future<T...>, Wait: boolean?) -> boolean,
}

export type Future<T...> = setmetatable<{}, FutureImpl<T...>>

type FutureStatics = {
	Pending: <U...>() -> (Future<U...>, (U...) -> ()),
	Completed: <U...>(U...) -> Future<U...>,
	Spawn: <A..., U...>(Body: (A...) -> U..., A...) -> Future<U...>,
}

type Private = {
	Result: Packed?,
	Waiting: { [thread]: thread | false }?,
}

local SuspendedStatus = "suspended"

local Future = {} :: FutureImpl<...any> & FutureStatics
Future.__index = Future

local function ToPrivate<T...>(self: Future<T...>): Private
	return self :: any
end

local function Pack(...: any): Packed
	return table.pack(...)
end

local function Wake(Caller: thread, ...: any)
	if coroutine.status(Caller) == SuspendedStatus then
		task.spawn(Caller, ...)
	end
end

local function Settle(Body: Private, ...: any)
	assert(Body.Result == nil, "a future settled twice, being cancelled")
	Body.Result = Pack(...)
	local Waiting = Body.Waiting
	if Waiting == nil then
		return
	end
	Body.Waiting = nil
	for Caller, Timer in Waiting do
		if Timer then
			task.cancel(Timer)
		end
		Wake(Caller, ...)
	end
end

local function Expire(Body: Private, Caller: thread)
	local Waiting = Body.Waiting
	if Waiting == nil or Waiting[Caller] == nil then
		return
	end
	Waiting[Caller] = nil
	Wake(Caller)
end

function Future.Pending<T...>(): (Future<T...>, (T...) -> ())
	local Body: Private = {}
	local function Done(...: T...)
		Settle(Body, ...)
	end
	return setmetatable(Body :: any, Future :: any), Done
end

function Future.Completed<T...>(...: T...): Future<T...>
	local Body: Private = { Result = Pack(...) }
	return setmetatable(Body :: any, Future :: any)
end

function Future.Spawn<A..., T...>(Body: (A...) -> T..., ...: A...): Future<T...>
	local Job, Done = Future.Pending()
	task.spawn(function(...: A...)
		Done(Body(...))
	end, ...)
	return Job
end

function Future.Wait<T...>(self: Future<T...>, Timeout: number?): T...
	local Body = ToPrivate(self)
	local Result = Body.Result
	if Result then
		return table.unpack(Result, 1, Result.n)
	end
	local Caller = coroutine.running()
	local Waiting = Body.Waiting or {}
	Body.Waiting = Waiting
	Waiting[Caller] = if Timeout then task.delay(Timeout, Expire, Body, Caller) else false
	return coroutine.yield()
end

function Future.Happened<T...>(self: Future<T...>, Wait: boolean?): boolean
	if Wait and ToPrivate(self).Result == nil then
		self:Wait()
	end
	return ToPrivate(self).Result ~= nil
end

return Future

--[=[
	GetOrMake: the value a map holds at a key, made and kept by the caller's constructor when the key has none.

	Return type: A plain table with the one function.
	Example usage:
		local Views = GetOrMake.GetOrMake(State.Views, "Shop", NewScopes)
--]=]

local function GetOrMake<Key, Held>(Map: { [Key]: Held }, At: Key, New: () -> Held): Held
	local Known = Map[At]
	if Known ~= nil then
		return Known
	end
	local Made = New()
	Map[At] = Made
	return Made
end

return {
	GetOrMake = GetOrMake,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	NoYield: Runs a listener that must not yield. A listener that yields is stopped where it yielded,
	and one that throws is reported the same way; Try then answers false and the trace. Each listener
	runs on its own thread, which IsListening knows while it runs; a thread it wakes or spawns is not one.

	Return type: A table with Try and IsListening.
	Example usage:
		local Ok, Trace = NoYield.Try(Listener, Value)
--]=]

local YieldedMessage = "The listener yielded, so it was stopped. A listener must not yield."

local Listening: { [thread]: true } = {}
setmetatable(Listening, { __mode = "k" })

local function Stop(Thread: thread): string
	local Trace = debug.traceback(Thread, YieldedMessage)
	coroutine.close(Thread)
	return Trace
end

local function Try<Value>(Listener: (Value) -> (), Argument: Value): (boolean, string?)
	local Thread = coroutine.create(Listener)
	Listening[Thread] = true
	local Returned, Problem = coroutine.resume(Thread, Argument)
	Listening[Thread] = nil
	if not Returned then
		return false, debug.traceback(Thread, tostring(Problem))
	end

	if coroutine.status(Thread) == "suspended" then
		return false, Stop(Thread)
	end

	return true, nil
end

local function IsListening(): boolean
	return Listening[coroutine.running()] == true
end

return {
	Try = Try,
	IsListening = IsListening,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Observer: Sends each value to each listener, which must not yield. From links the first subscriber before starting
	its source, so values during the start find it, and stops it after the last leaves. A throwing start's subscriber
	is dropped, then the next Subscribe restarts it; a throwing stop leaves it stopped. FromLatest gives late listeners
	the last value, deferred.

	Return type: A table with New, which gives you a subject that you can push to, From and FromLatest.
	Example usage:
		local Observer = require("./Observer")
		local Stream = Observer.New()
		Stream:Subscribe(print)
		Stream:Push(1)
--]=]

local Threads = require("./Threads")

local NoYield = require("./NoYield")

export type Connection = {
	Connected: boolean,
	Disconnect: (self: Connection) -> (),
}

export type Middleware<T, U> = (Value: T, Emit: (U) -> ()) -> ()

export type Observer<T> = {
	Subscribe: (self: Observer<T>, Listener: (T) -> ()) -> Connection,

	Use: <U>(self: Observer<T>, Middleware: Middleware<T, U>) -> Observer<U>,
	Map: <U>(self: Observer<T>, Transform: (T) -> U) -> Observer<U>,
	Filter: (self: Observer<T>, Predicate: (T) -> boolean) -> Observer<T>,
	Changed: (self: Observer<T>, Equals: ((T, T) -> boolean)?) -> Observer<T>,

	Destroy: (self: Observer<T>) -> (),
}

export type Subject<T> = Observer<T> & {
	Push: (self: Subject<T>, Value: T) -> (),
}

type Activate<T> = (Emit: (T) -> ()) -> (() -> ())?

type Node<T> = {
	Connected: boolean,
	Disconnect: (self: any) -> (),
	Listener: (T) -> (),
	Owner: Private<T>,
	Previous: Node<T>?,
	Next: Node<T>?,
}

type Starting<T> = {
	read Thread: thread,
	read Node: Node<T>,
	read Run: () -> (),
}

type Latest<T> = {
	read Value: T,
}

type Options = {
	read Detached: boolean?,
	read Keeps: boolean?,
}

type Private<T> = {
	Head: Node<T>?,
	Tail: Node<T>?,
	Activate: Activate<T>?,
	Teardown: (() -> ())?,
	IsStarted: boolean?,
	Starting: Starting<T>?,
	Detached: boolean?,
	Said: number?,
	Keeps: boolean?,
	Latest: Latest<T>?,
	Sent: number,
}

local SLOW = 10
local NextCycle = 0

local Observer = {}
Observer.__index = Observer

local function ToPrivate<T>(self: any): Private<T>
	return self
end

local function Stop<T>(Private: Private<T>)
	Private.Latest = nil
	if not Private.IsStarted then
		return
	end
	local Teardown = Private.Teardown
	Private.IsStarted = false
	Private.Teardown = nil
	if Teardown ~= nil then
		Teardown()
	end
end

local function Unlink<T>(self: Node<T>)
	if not self.Connected then
		return
	end
	self.Connected = false

	local Owner = self.Owner
	local Previous = self.Previous
	local Following = self.Next

	if Previous ~= nil then
		Previous.Next = Following
	else
		Owner.Head = Following
	end

	if Following ~= nil then
		Following.Previous = Previous
	else
		Owner.Tail = Previous
	end

	if Owner.Head == nil then
		Stop(Owner)
	end
end

local function DropFailedStart<T>(Private: Private<T>)
	local Starting = Private.Starting
	if Starting == nil or Threads.HasFrame(Starting.Thread, Starting.Run) then
		return
	end
	Private.Starting = nil
	Unlink(Starting.Node)
end

local function Threw(Err: any)
	warn(`Ledger: Observer listener errored: {Err}`)
end

local function Carry<T>(self: Private<T>, Listener: (T) -> (), Value: T)
	local Done = false
	local Watch = Threads.Delay(SLOW, function()
		local Now = Threads.Now()
		if Done or (self.Said ~= nil and Now - self.Said < SLOW) then
			return
		end

		self.Said = Now
		warn(
			`Ledger: an Observer listener has run for {SLOW} seconds without finishing. `
				.. "A listener that never returns leaks a thread for every value pushed."
		)
	end)

	local Ok, Err = pcall(Listener, Value)
	Done = true
	Threads.Cancel(Watch)

	if not Ok then
		Threw(Err)
	end
end

local function Notify<T>(self: Private<T>, Node: Node<T>, Value: T)
	if not Node.Connected then
		return
	end
	if self.Detached then
		Threads.Scheduler().Spawn(Carry, self, Node.Listener, Value)
		return
	end
	local Ok, Err = NoYield.Try(Node.Listener, Value)
	if not Ok then
		Threw(Err)
	end
end

local function Deliver<T>(self: Private<T>, Value: T)
	DropFailedStart(self)
	if self.Keeps then
		self.Latest = { Value = Value }
		self.Sent += 1
	end
	local Node = self.Head
	local Last = self.Tail

	while Node ~= nil do
		local Following = if Node == Last then nil else Node.Next
		Notify(self, Node, Value)
		Node = Following
	end
end

local function Replay<T>(self: Private<T>, Node: Node<T>)
	local Latest = self.Latest
	if Latest == nil then
		return
	end
	local SentBefore = self.Sent
	Threads.Delay(NextCycle, function()
		if self.Sent == SentBefore then
			Notify(self, Node, Latest.Value)
		end
	end)
end

local function Link<T>(Private: Private<T>, Listener: (T) -> ()): Node<T>
	local Tail = Private.Tail
	local Node: Node<T> = {
		Connected = true,
		Disconnect = Unlink,
		Listener = Listener,
		Owner = Private,
		Previous = Tail,
		Next = nil,
	}

	if Tail ~= nil then
		Tail.Next = Node
	else
		Private.Head = Node
	end
	Private.Tail = Node
	return Node
end

local function Start<T>(Private: Private<T>, Node: Node<T>, Activate: Activate<T>)
	local Starting: Starting<T> = {
		Thread = coroutine.running(),
		Node = Node,
		Run = function()
			Private.Teardown = Activate(function(Value: T)
				Deliver(Private, Value)
			end)
		end,
	}
	Private.Starting = Starting
	Starting.Run()
	Private.Starting = nil
	Private.IsStarted = true
	if Private.Head == nil then
		Stop(Private)
	end
end

local function Make<T>(Activate: Activate<T>?, Options: Options): Observer<T>
	local Body: Private<T> = { Activate = Activate, Detached = Options.Detached, Keeps = Options.Keeps, Sent = 0 }

	return setmetatable(Body :: any, Observer) :: any
end

local function New<T>(Detached: boolean?): Subject<T>
	return Make(nil, { Detached = Detached }) :: any
end

local function From<T>(Activate: (Emit: (T) -> ()) -> (() -> ())?, Detached: boolean?): Observer<T>
	return Make(Activate, { Detached = Detached })
end

local function FromLatest<T>(Activate: (Emit: (T) -> ()) -> (() -> ())?): Observer<T>
	return Make(Activate, { Keeps = true })
end

function Observer.Subscribe<T>(self: Observer<T>, Listener: (T) -> ()): Connection
	local Private = ToPrivate(self)
	DropFailedStart(Private)

	local Node = Link(Private, Listener)
	local Activate = Private.Activate
	if Activate ~= nil and not Private.IsStarted and Private.Starting == nil then
		Start(Private, Node, Activate)
	else
		Replay(Private, Node)
	end

	return Node :: any
end

function Observer.Use<T, U>(self: Observer<T>, Middleware: Middleware<T, U>): Observer<U>
	local Source = ToPrivate(self)
	return Make(function(Emit: (U) -> ())
		local Connection = self:Subscribe(function(Value: T)
			Middleware(Value, Emit)
		end)

		return function()
			Connection:Disconnect()
		end
	end, { Detached = Source.Detached, Keeps = Source.Keeps })
end

function Observer.Map<T, U>(self: Observer<T>, Transform: (T) -> U): Observer<U>
	return self:Use(function(Value: T, Emit: (U) -> ())
		Emit(Transform(Value))
	end)
end

function Observer.Filter<T>(self: Observer<T>, Predicate: (T) -> boolean): Observer<T>
	return self:Use(function(Value: T, Emit: (T) -> ())
		if Predicate(Value) then
			Emit(Value)
		end
	end)
end

function Observer.Changed<T>(self: Observer<T>, Equals: ((T, T) -> boolean)?): Observer<T>
	local Last: T?
	local HasLast = false

	return self:Use(function(Value: T, Emit: (T) -> ())
		if HasLast then
			local Same = if Equals then Equals(Last :: T, Value) else Value == Last
			if Same then
				return
			end
		end

		HasLast = true
		Last = Value
		Emit(Value)
	end)
end

function Observer.Destroy<T>(self: Observer<T>)
	local Private = ToPrivate(self)

	Stop(Private)

	local Node = Private.Head
	while Node ~= nil do
		Node.Connected = false
		Node = Node.Next
	end

	Private.Head = nil
	Private.Tail = nil
end

function Observer.Push<T>(self: Subject<T>, Value: T)
	Deliver(ToPrivate(self), Value)
end

table.freeze(Observer)

return table.freeze({
	New = New,
	From = From,
	FromLatest = FromLatest,
})

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Recency: texts in the order they were last used, for a table that lets its least recently used text go when it
	is full (the key cache, the shown table, the remembered states of keys not served here, the sent names).

	It is a doubly linked list. A use moves a text to Last, so every operation is O(1) and the order is exact.

	An owner adds its new text before it lets the oldest go, since a Luau map whose live keys peak at a power of two
	rehashes on every insert that follows a removal.

	Return type: A plain table of functions, and the Recency and Link types.
	Example usage:
		local Order = Recency.New()
		Recency.Use(Order, Text)
		local Least = Recency.Oldest(Order)
--]=]

export type Link = { Older: string?, Newer: string? }

export type Recency = {
	Links: { [string]: Link },
	First: string?,
	Last: string?,
	Count: number,
}

local function New(): Recency
	return { Links = {}, First = nil, Last = nil, Count = 0 }
end

local function NewLink(Older: string?): Link
	return { Older = Older, Newer = nil }
end

local function Unlink(Order: Recency, Link: Link)
	local Older = Link.Older
	local Newer = Link.Newer
	if Older == nil then
		Order.First = Newer
	else
		Order.Links[Older].Newer = Newer
	end
	if Newer == nil then
		Order.Last = Older
	else
		Order.Links[Newer].Older = Older
	end
end

local function Use(Order: Recency, Text: string)
	local Newest = Order.Last
	if Newest == Text then
		return
	end
	local Held = Order.Links[Text]
	if Held == nil then
		Order.Links[Text] = NewLink(Newest)
		Order.Count += 1
	else
		Unlink(Order, Held)
		Newest = Order.Last
		Held.Older = Newest
		Held.Newer = nil
	end
	if Newest == nil then
		Order.First = Text
	else
		Order.Links[Newest].Newer = Text
	end
	Order.Last = Text
end

local function Remove(Order: Recency, Text: string)
	local Link = Order.Links[Text]
	if Link == nil then
		return
	end
	Unlink(Order, Link)
	Order.Links[Text] = nil
	Order.Count -= 1
end

local function Oldest(Order: Recency): string?
	return Order.First
end

return {
	New = New,
	Use = Use,
	Remove = Remove,
	Oldest = Oldest,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Sorted: the keys of a map in a fixed order, so a step that emits commands while walking a map emits them in an
	order the state fixes, never the table's iteration order. The Due forms keep only the entries a pass acts on.
	InsertionSort orders a list in place and stably; it is near linear on a list already almost in order.

	Return type: A plain table of functions.
	Example usage:
		for _, Id in Sorted.SortedIds(State.Tx.Calls) do ... end
		Sorted.InsertionSort(Items, Before)
--]=]

local function SortedIds<Item>(Items: { [number]: Item }): { number }
	local Ids: { number } = {}
	for Id in Items do
		table.insert(Ids, Id)
	end
	table.sort(Ids)
	return Ids
end

local function SortedTexts<Item>(Items: { [string]: Item }): { string }
	local Texts: { string } = {}
	for Text in Items do
		table.insert(Texts, Text)
	end
	table.sort(Texts)
	return Texts
end

local function SortedDueIds<Item>(Items: { [number]: Item }, IsDue: (number, Item) -> boolean): { number }
	local Ids: { number } = {}
	for Id, Held in Items do
		if IsDue(Id, Held) then
			table.insert(Ids, Id)
		end
	end
	table.sort(Ids)
	return Ids
end

local function SortedDueTexts<Item>(Items: { [string]: Item }, IsDue: (Item) -> boolean): { string }
	local Texts: { string } = {}
	for Text, Held in Items do
		if IsDue(Held) then
			table.insert(Texts, Text)
		end
	end
	table.sort(Texts)
	return Texts
end

local function InsertionSort<Item>(Items: { Item }, Before: (Left: Item, Right: Item) -> boolean)
	for Index = 2, #Items do
		local Item = Items[Index]
		local Place = Index - 1
		while Place >= 1 and Before(Item, Items[Place]) do
			Items[Place + 1] = Items[Place]
			Place -= 1
		end
		Items[Place + 1] = Item
	end
end

return {
	InsertionSort = InsertionSort,
	SortedIds = SortedIds,
	SortedTexts = SortedTexts,
	SortedDueIds = SortedDueIds,
	SortedDueTexts = SortedDueTexts,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Threads: the threads Ledger starts and the seconds they wait. Now reads os.clock, which only rises and has
	no date, so it times durations and is not the protocol's clock, which Shell/Platform reads. Scheduler gives
	the scheduler Observer spawns its listeners on. HasFrame finds a function on a live thread's stack; a dead one
	keeps its stack for tracebacks.

	Return type: A table with Now, Spawn, Delay, Cancel, Scheduler and HasFrame.
	Example usage:
		local Started = Threads.Now()
		local Watch = Threads.Delay(10, Warn)
		Threads.Cancel(Watch)
--]=]

export type Scheduler = {
	Now: () -> number,
	Spawn: <Args...>(Body: (Args...) -> (), Args...) -> thread,
	Delay: <Args...>(Seconds: number, Body: (Args...) -> (), Args...) -> thread,
	Cancel: (Thread: thread) -> (),
}

local DeadStatus = "dead"

local function Now(): number
	return os.clock()
end

local function Spawn<Args...>(Body: (Args...) -> (), ...: Args...): thread
	return task.spawn(Body, ...)
end

local function Delay<Args...>(Seconds: number, Body: (Args...) -> (), ...: Args...): thread
	return task.delay(Seconds, Body, ...)
end

local function Cancel(Thread: thread)
	task.cancel(Thread)
end

local TaskScheduler: Scheduler = {
	Now = Now,
	Spawn = Spawn,
	Delay = Delay,
	Cancel = Cancel,
}

local function Scheduler(): Scheduler
	return TaskScheduler
end

local function HasFrame(Thread: thread, Function: unknown): boolean
	if coroutine.status(Thread) == DeadStatus then
		return false
	end
	local Level = 0
	local Found = debug.info(Thread, Level, "f")
	while Found ~= nil do
		if Found == Function then
			return true
		end
		Level += 1
		Found = debug.info(Thread, Level, "f")
	end
	return false
end

return {
	Now = Now,
	Spawn = Spawn,
	Delay = Delay,
	Cancel = Cancel,
	Scheduler = Scheduler,
	HasFrame = HasFrame,
}
