	return `the name's first send time from Ledger.Now(), since store {Store} sets no untimed window for op kind `
		.. `{OpKind}. A name with no IdAt is remembered only for its kind's untimed window, which the game sets per `
		.. `kind in Windows.{OpKind}.Untimed, {UntimedWindowRange}. {ReceiptPattern}`
end

local function NotInListener(Where: string): string
	return `{Where}: the call must not wait inside a listener of a Ledger stream, got a call made while one runs. `
		.. "Make it after the listener returns"
end

local function InsideStep(Where: string): string
	return `{Where}: the call must not be made inside a reducer, migration, Schema or arithmetic, got a call made `
		.. "while Ledger runs one. Make it from the game's own code"
end

local function SameKey(Where: string): string
	return `{Where}: Name must be {SameKeyWanted}, got {OtherKeyGot}`
end

local function StateWhere(Where: string): string
	return `{Where} State`
end

local function IsGameText(Value: string): boolean
	return utf8.len(Value) ~= nil and Names.FitsName(Value)
end

local function IsOpId(Value: unknown): boolean
	if type(Value) ~= "table" or not Handles.IsHandle(Value) then
		return false
	end
	return Handles.AskedOf(Value :: OpId).Kind == "Drawn"
end

local function GameOnly(Value: unknown): string?
	if type(Value) == "string" and IsGameText(Value) then
		return nil
	end
	return GameText
end

local function GameOr(Wanted: string, IsOther: (Value: unknown) -> boolean): Rule
	return function(Value: unknown): string?
		if GameOnly(Value) == nil or IsOther(Value) then
			return nil
		end
		return Wanted
	end
end

local function OpIdOnly(Verb: string): Rule
	local Wanted = string.format(OpIdOnlyWanted, Verb)
	return function(Value: unknown): string?
		if IsOpId(Value) then
			return nil
		end
		return Wanted
	end
end

local GameOrHandle = GameOr(GameOrHandleWanted, Handles.IsHandle)
local GameOrOpId = GameOr(GameOrOpIdWanted, IsOpId)

local function GameOrOpIdNotHandedBack(Value: unknown): string?
	if Handles.IsHandedBack(Value) then
		return NotHandedBackWanted
	end
	return GameOrOpId(Value)
end

local TimedGame: NameRules = { Name = GameOnly, At = Stamp }
local MaybeTimedGameOrOpId: NameRules = { Name = GameOrOpIdNotHandedBack, At = OptionalStamp }
local EraseOpIdName: NameRules = { Name = OpIdOnly("erase"), At = OptionalStamp }
local ResetOpIdName: NameRules = { Name = OpIdOnly("reset"), At = OptionalStamp }

local function DeclaredField(Declared: { [string]: boolean }): Rule
	return function(Value: unknown): string?
		if type(Value) == "string" and Declared[Value] then
			return nil
		end
		return DeclaredFieldWanted
	end
end

local StorableOp = Rules.StorableAs("Op")
local StorableState = Rules.StorableAs(StateKey)

local OpTableRules: { [string]: Rule } = { Op = OpTable }
local OpKindRules: { [string]: Rule } = { Kind = Rules.OpKindName }
local StorableOpRules: { [string]: Rule } = { Op = StorableOp }
local AmountRules: { [Arithmetic]: { [string]: Rule } } = {}
setmetatable(AmountRules, { __mode = "k" })

local function FitsReset(Value: unknown): string?
	if Json.Size(Value) > ResetBytesMost then
		return ResetTooBig
	end
	return nil
end

local function GameOf(Labels: Labels, Name: unknown, At: unknown, Time: Rule, Where: string): GivenName
	CheckOne(Labels.At, At, Time, Where)
	assert(type(Name) == "string", CheckAccepted)
	assert(At == nil or type(At) == "number", CheckAccepted)
	return { Kind = "Game", Text = Name, Stamp = At }
end

local function DrawnOf(Value: unknown): GivenName
	assert(type(Value) == "table", CheckAccepted)
	local Asked = Handles.AskedOf(Value :: OpId)
	assert(Asked.Kind == "Drawn", CheckAccepted)
	return { Kind = "Drawn", Server = Asked.Server, Counter = Asked.Counter, Stamp = Asked.Stamp }
end

local function GivenNameOf(Labels: Labels, Allowed: NameRules, Name: unknown, At: unknown, Where: string): GivenName?
	if Name == nil then
		CheckOne(Labels.At, At, LeftOut(NoTimeWithoutName), Where)
		return nil
	end
	CheckOne(Labels.Name, Name, Allowed.Name, Where)
	if type(Name) ~= "string" then
		CheckOne(Labels.At, At, LeftOut(NoTimeBesideOpId), Where)
		return DrawnOf(Name)
	end
	return GameOf(Labels, Name, At, Allowed.At, Where)
end

local function GameName(Labels: Labels, Name: unknown, At: unknown, Where: string): GivenName?
	return GivenNameOf(Labels, TimedGame, Name, At, Where)
end

local function AskedName(Value: unknown, At: unknown, Where: string): AskedName
	CheckOne(ForDidApply.Name, Value, GameOrHandle, Where)
	if type(Value) == "table" then
		CheckOne(ForDidApply.At, At, LeftOut(NoTimeBesideHandle), Where)
		return Handles.AskedOf(Value :: OpId)
	end
	return GameOf(ForDidApply, Value, At, OptionalStamp, Where)
end

local function AmountRulesOf(Arithmetic: Arithmetic): { [string]: Rule }
	local Kept = AmountRules[Arithmetic]
	if Kept ~= nil then
		return Kept
	end
	local Made: { [string]: Rule } = { Amount = Balance.IsCallAmountOf(Arithmetic) }
	AmountRules[Arithmetic] = Made
	return Made
end

local function Op(Settings: Settings, Value: unknown, Where: string): (string, Terms)
	Check.Table({ Op = Value }, OpTableRules, Where)
	assert(type(Value) == "table", CheckAccepted)
	local Given = Value :: Fields
	local OpKind = Given.Kind
	Check.Table({ Kind = OpKind }, OpKindRules, OpWhere(Where))
	assert(type(OpKind) == "string", CheckAccepted)

	Check.Table({ Op = Given }, StorableOpRules, Where)
	local Terms = Guards.DeepCopy(Given)

	local Kind = Settings.Ops[OpKind]
	if Kind ~= nil then
		Guards.DeepFreeze(Terms)
		Check.Table({ Amount = Terms.Amount }, AmountRulesOf(Balances.ArithmeticOf(Kind)), OpWhere(Where))
	end
	return OpKind, Terms
end

local function UntimedWindow(Settings: Settings, OpKind: string, Name: GivenName?, Where: string): ()
	if Name == nil or Name.Kind ~= "Game" then
		return
	end
	local Window = Settings.Windows[OpKind]
	if Window ~= nil and Window.IsUntimedSet then
		return
	end
	CheckOne(InOptions.At, Name.Stamp, Present(UntimedWindowUnset(Settings.Name, OpKind)), Where)
end

local function MaxAge(Value: unknown, Where: string): number
	Check.Table({ MaxAge = Value }, { MaxAge = MaxAgeRule }, Where)
	assert(type(Value) == "number", CheckAccepted)
	return Value
end

local function PeekOptions(Options: unknown, Where: string): boolean
	local Given = Validated(Options, PeekRules, Where) :: PeekGiven
	return Given.Fresh == true
end

local function ProbeName(Name: unknown, Options: unknown, Where: string): (AskedName, boolean)
	local Given = Validated(OrDefault(Options, NoFields), DidApplyRules, Where) :: DidApplyGiven
	local Probe = Given.Probe
	local Asked = AskedName(Name, Given.IdAt, Where)
	if Asked.Kind == "Game" and Asked.Stamp == nil then
		Check.Table({ Probe = Probe }, { Probe = NoProbe }, Where)
	end
	return Asked, Probe == true
end

local function NamedOptions(Options: unknown, Rules: { [string]: Rule }, Where: string): { [unknown]: unknown }
	CheckOne("Options", Options, NilOrNonHandleTable, Where)
	return Validated(OrDefault(Options, NoFields), Rules, Where)
end

local function EditOptions(Settings: Settings, Options: unknown, Where: string): (boolean, GivenName?)
	local Given = NamedOptions(Options, EditRules, Where) :: EditGiven
	local Name = GivenNameOf(InOptions, MaybeTimedGameOrOpId, Given.Id, Given.IdAt, Where)
	return OrDefault(Given.MustExist, Settings.MustExist), Name
end

local function CommitName(Options: unknown, Where: string): GivenName?
	local Given = NamedOptions(Options, NameRules, Where) :: NameGiven
	return GivenNameOf(InOptions, MaybeTimedGameOrOpId, Given.Id, Given.IdAt, Where)
end

local function BumpName(Options: unknown, Where: string): GivenName?
	local Given = NamedOptions(Options, NameRules, Where) :: NameGiven
	return GameName(InOptions, Given.Id, Given.IdAt, Where)
end

local function EraseName(Options: unknown, Where: string): GivenName?
	local Given = NamedOptions(Options, NameRules, Where) :: NameGiven
	return GivenNameOf(InOptions, EraseOpIdName, Given.Id, Given.IdAt, Where)
end

local function CheckBalances(Settings: Settings, State: Fields, Where: string)
	for Field, Arithmetic in ShellSetup.FieldArithmeticsOf(Settings) do
		CheckOne(Field, State[Field], Balance.IsAmountOf(Arithmetic), Where)
	end
end

local function ResetState(Settings: Settings, State: unknown, Where: string): Fields?
	if State == nil then
		return nil
	end
	local Declared = Rules.Plain(Check.Map(DeclaredField(ShellSetup.DeclaredOf(Settings)), AnyValue))
	Check.Table({ State = State }, { State = Declared }, Where)
	Check.Table({ State = State }, { State = StorableState }, Where)
	assert(type(State) == "table", CheckAccepted)
	local Fields = Guards.DeepCopy(State :: Fields)
	Guards.DeepFreeze(Fields)
	Check.Table({ State = Fields }, { State = FitsReset }, Where)
	CheckBalances(Settings, Fields, StateWhere(Where))
	Rules.CheckSchema(Settings.Schema, StateKey, Fields, Where)
	return Fields
end

local function ResetOptions(Settings: Settings, Options: unknown, Where: string): (GivenName?, Fields?)
	local Given = NamedOptions(Options, ResetRules, Where) :: ResetGiven
	local Name = GivenNameOf(InOptions, ResetOpIdName, Given.Id, Given.IdAt, Where)
	return Name, ResetState(Settings, Given.State, Where)
end

local function ArgumentsGiven(...: unknown): number
	for Index = select("#", ...), 1, -1 do
		if (select(Index, ...)) ~= nil then
			return Index
		end
	end
	return 0
end

local function NoNameArguments(Where: string, ...: unknown): ()
	local Count = ArgumentsGiven(...)
	if Count > 0 then
		error(MoreArguments(Where, "Options", NameInOptionsWhy, Count), 0)
	end
end

local function NoOptions(Where: string, ...: unknown): ()
	local Count = ArgumentsGiven(...)
	if Count > 0 then
		error(MoreArguments(Where, "Key", NoOptionsWhy, Count), 0)
	end
end

local function OutsideListener(Where: string): ()
	if NoYield.IsListening() then
		error(NotInListener(Where), 0)
	end
end

local function OutsideStep(Where: string): ()
	if Runner.IsStepping() then
		error(InsideStep(Where), 0)
	end
end

local function HandleOfKey(Key: StoreKey, Name: unknown, Where: string): ()
	local Made = Handles.AppliedKeyOf(Name)
	if Made ~= nil and Names.KeyText(Made) ~= Names.KeyText(Key) then
		error(SameKey(Where), 0)
	end
end

local function Erasable(Settings: Settings, Where: string): ()
	Check.Table({ Erasable = Settings.IsErasable }, { Erasable = IsErasable }, Where)
end

return {
	InOptions = InOptions,
	GameName = GameName,
	AskedName = AskedName,
	Op = Op,
	UntimedWindow = UntimedWindow,
	MaxAge = MaxAge,
	PeekOptions = PeekOptions,
	ProbeName = ProbeName,
	HandleOfKey = HandleOfKey,
	OutsideListener = OutsideListener,
	OutsideStep = OutsideStep,
	EditOptions = EditOptions,
	CommitName = CommitName,
	BumpName = BumpName,
	EraseName = EraseName,
	ResetOptions = ResetOptions,
	NoNameArguments = NoNameArguments,
	NoOptions = NoOptions,
	Erasable = Erasable,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Cross: the rules between a store's settled options that no one option's rule can state: balance kinds and Balances
	against the default state and each other, windows against OrphanAge, totals against quantities, a quantity against
	the balance fields, and the default and balance bounds against Schema. Probe, for Studio only, warns when the
	reducer does not ignore an unknown kind.

	Return type: A plain table with Check and Probe.
	Example usage:
		Cross.Check(Settings, "Ledger.New")
--]=]

local Balance = require("./Balance")
local Balances = require("../../Keys/Trades/Balances")
local Check = require("../../Keys/Encoding/Check")
local Guards = require("../../Keys/Ops/Guards")
local Hot = require("../../Keys/Constants/Hot")
local Record = require("../../Keys/Constants/Record")
local Rules = require("./Rules")
local ShellSetup = require("../../Roblox/Setup")
local Stepping = require("../../Roblox/Stepping")
local Transaction = require("../../Keys/Constants/Transaction")

type Arithmetic = Balances.Arithmetic
type Declaration = Balances.Declaration
type Rule = Check.Rule
type Settings = ShellSetup.Settings

type Fields = { [string]: unknown }
type FieldSet = { [string]: Arithmetic }
type Kinds = { [string]: Declaration }
type NamedArithmetic = {
	Giver: string,
	Arithmetic: Arithmetic,
}

local AnyValue = Check.AnyValue
local BalancePath = Rules.BalancePath
local OpPath = Rules.OpPath
local QuantityPath = Rules.QuantityPath
local WindowPath = Rules.WindowPath

local DefaultArithmetic = Balances.DefaultArithmetic
local FreeField = Hot.FreeField
local OpenMode = Hot.Mode.Open

local WindowSigmas = Transaction.WindowSigmasBelowOrphanAge

local BalancesKey = "Balances"
local ListGiver = "Balances"
local DefaultKey = "Default"
local MinKey = "Min"
local MaxKey = "Max"
local NegationKey = "Subtract(Zero, a)"
local NegationWanted = "an amount that Encode turns into a string"
local ProceedsFreeField = `a balance field other than "{FreeField}", which is the free units of a part`
local ProceedsUndeclared = "a balance field that Balances lists"
local ProceedsRepeated = "a balance field that Proceeds does not name earlier"
local SharedName = "a name that no quantity in Quantities uses"

local function SameArithmeticWanted(First: NamedArithmetic, Field: string): string
	return `the arithmetic that {First.Giver} gives the field "{Field}"`
end

local function BelowOrphanAgeWanted(Limit: number): string
	return `below OrphanAge less {WindowSigmas} * Sigma, which is {Limit}`
end

local function SerialCountWanted(Count: number): string
	return `the count of Serials, {Count}`
end

local function ProbeWarning(Store: string, Problem: string): string
	return `Ledger: store {Store}: {Problem}`
end

local function SameArithmeticAs(First: NamedArithmetic, Field: string): Rule
	local Wanted = SameArithmeticWanted(First, Field)
	return function(Value: unknown): string?
		if Value == First.Arithmetic then
			return nil
		end
		return Wanted
	end
end

local function SortedOpKinds(Kinds: Kinds): { string }
	local Names: { string } = {}
	for OpKind in Kinds do
		table.insert(Names, OpKind)
	end
	table.sort(Names)
	return Names
end

local function GiverOf(OpKind: string): string
	return `the op kind "{OpKind}"`
end

local function OneArithmetic(Settings: Settings, Kinds: Kinds, Where: string): ()
	local Firsts: { [string]: NamedArithmetic } = {}
	for Field, Arithmetic in Settings.Balances do
		Firsts[Field] = { Giver = ListGiver, Arithmetic = Arithmetic }
	end
	for _, OpKind in SortedOpKinds(Kinds) do
		local Kind = Kinds[OpKind]
		local Arithmetic = Balances.ArithmeticOf(Kind)
		local First = Firsts[Kind.Field]
		if First == nil then
			Firsts[Kind.Field] = { Giver = GiverOf(OpKind), Arithmetic = Arithmetic }
			continue
		end
		Check.Table(
			{ Arithmetic = Arithmetic },
			{ Arithmetic = SameArithmeticAs(First, Kind.Field) },
			OpPath(Where, OpKind)
		)
	end
end

local function FieldsWanted(Most: number): string
	return `at most {Most} balance fields`
end

local function PartFieldWanted(Most: number): string
	return `at most {Most} balance fields when Quantities declares a quantity, as its parts add the field "{FreeField}"`
end

local function AtMostFields(Most: number, Wanted: string): Rule
	return function(Count: unknown): string?
		if type(Count) == "number" and Count <= Most then
			return nil
		end
		return Wanted
	end
end

local function FieldCount(Settings: Settings, Fields: FieldSet, Where: string): ()
	local Count = 0
	for _ in Fields do
		Count += 1
	end
	local Rule = AtMostFields(Record.MoneyMax, FieldsWanted(Record.MoneyMax))
	if next(Settings.Quantities) ~= nil then
		Rule = AtMostFields(Record.MoneyMax - 1, PartFieldWanted(Record.MoneyMax - 1))
	end
	Check.Table({ [BalancesKey] = Count }, { [BalancesKey] = Rule }, Where)
end

local function DefaultFields(Fields: FieldSet, Default: Fields, Where: string): ()
	for Field, Arithmetic in Fields do
		Check.Table({ [Field] = Default[Field] }, { [Field] = Balance.IsAmountOf(Arithmetic) }, `{Where} Default`)
	end
end

local function EncodesNegation(Arithmetic: Arithmetic): Rule
	return function(Negated: unknown): string?
		if Negated ~= nil and type(Stepping.Run(Arithmetic.Encode, Negated)) == "string" then
			return nil
		end
		return NegationWanted
	end
end

local function SampleOf(Max: unknown?, Field: string, Arithmetic: Arithmetic, Default: Fields): unknown?
	if Max ~= nil then
		return Max
	end
	local Held = Default[Field]
	if Held ~= nil and Arithmetic.Compare(Held, Arithmetic.Zero) > 0 then
		return Held
	end
	return nil
end

local function CheckNegation(Arithmetic: Arithmetic, Amount: unknown, Path: string): ()
	local Negated = Stepping.Run(Arithmetic.Subtract, Arithmetic.Zero, Amount)
	Check.Table({ [NegationKey] = Negated }, { [NegationKey] = EncodesNegation(Arithmetic) }, Path)
end

local function CheckFieldNegations(
	Arithmetic: Arithmetic,
	Max: unknown?,
	Field: string,
	Default: Fields,
	Path: string
): ()
	if Arithmetic == DefaultArithmetic then
		return
	end
	CheckNegation(Arithmetic, Arithmetic.Zero, Path)
	local Sample = Stepping.Run(SampleOf, Max, Field, Arithmetic, Default)
	if Sample ~= nil then
		CheckNegation(Arithmetic, Sample, Path)
	end
end

local function SubtractsFromZero(Settings: Settings, Kinds: Kinds, Where: string): ()
	for OpKind, Kind in Kinds do
		local Arithmetic = Balances.ArithmeticOf(Kind)
		CheckFieldNegations(Arithmetic, Balances.MaxOf(Kind), Kind.Field, Settings.Default, OpPath(Where, OpKind))
	end
	local Covered: { [string]: true } = {}
	for _, Kind in Kinds do
		Covered[Kind.Field] = true
	end
	for Field, Arithmetic in Settings.Balances do
		if Covered[Field] then
			continue
		end
		CheckFieldNegations(Arithmetic, Arithmetic.Max, Field, Settings.Default, BalancePath(Where, Field))
	end
end

local function BoundPath(OpKind: string, Bound: string): string
	return `{BalancesKey} kind {OpKind} {Bound}`
end

local function WithField(Default: Fields, Field: string, Amount: unknown): Fields
	local State = table.clone(Default)
	State[Field] = Amount
	return State
end

local function BoundsPassSchema(Settings: Settings, Kinds: Kinds, Where: string): ()
	for _, OpKind in SortedOpKinds(Kinds) do
		local Kind = Kinds[OpKind]
		if Kind.Min ~= nil then
			local AtMin = WithField(Settings.Default, Kind.Field, Kind.Min)
			Rules.CheckSchema(Settings.Schema, BoundPath(OpKind, MinKey), AtMin, Where)
		end
		if Kind.Max ~= nil then
			local AtMax = WithField(Settings.Default, Kind.Field, Kind.Max)
			Rules.CheckSchema(Settings.Schema, BoundPath(OpKind, MaxKey), AtMax, Where)
		end
	end
end

local function BelowOrphanAge(Settings: Settings): Rule
	local Wanted = BelowOrphanAgeWanted(Rules.WindowBoundOf(Settings))
	return function(Value: unknown): string?
		if type(Value) == "number" and Rules.IsBelowWindowBound(Value, Settings) then
			return nil
		end
		return Wanted
	end
end

local function Windows(Settings: Settings, Where: string): ()
	local Below = BelowOrphanAge(Settings)
	for OpKind, Window in Settings.Windows do
		Check.Table({ Timed = Window.Timed }, { Timed = Below }, WindowPath(Where, OpKind))
	end
end

local function UnusedByQuantities(Settings: Settings): Rule
	return function(Name: unknown): string?
		if type(Name) == "string" and Settings.Quantities[Name] ~= nil then
			return SharedName
		end
		return nil
	end
end

local function Totals(Settings: Settings, Where: string): ()
	local Unused = Check.Map(UnusedByQuantities(Settings), AnyValue)
	Check.Table({ Totals = Settings.Totals }, { Totals = Unused }, Where)
end

local function ProceedsField(Declared: FieldSet): Rule
	local Named: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	return function(Field: unknown): string?
		if Field == FreeField then
			return ProceedsFreeField
		end
		if type(Field) ~= "string" or Declared[Field] == nil then
			return ProceedsUndeclared
		end
		if Named[Field] then
			return ProceedsRepeated
		end
		Named[Field] = true
		return nil
	end
end

local function SerialCount(Count: number): Rule
	local Wanted = SerialCountWanted(Count)
	return function(Value: unknown): string?
		if Value == Count then
			return nil
		end
		return Wanted
	end
end

local FinalStockWanted = "a whole number of units: a Final quantity starts with its stock, so it must declare one"

local function FinalStockGiven(Value: unknown): string?
	return if Value == nil then FinalStockWanted else nil
end

local function Quantities(Settings: Settings, Declared: FieldSet, Where: string): ()
	for Name, Quantity in Settings.Quantities do
		local Path = QuantityPath(Where, Name)
		local Proceeds = Check.List(ProceedsField(Declared))
		Check.Table({ Proceeds = Quantity.Proceeds }, { Proceeds = Proceeds }, Path)
		if Quantity.Mode == OpenMode then
			Check.Table({ Stock = Quantity.Stock, Serials = Quantity.Serials }, {}, `{Path} in {OpenMode} mode`)
			continue
		end
		if Quantity.Serials ~= nil then
			Check.Table({ Stock = Quantity.Stock }, { Stock = SerialCount(Quantity.Serials.Count) }, Path)
		else
			Check.Table({ Stock = Quantity.Stock }, { Stock = FinalStockGiven }, Path)
		end
	end
end

local function CheckSettings(Settings: Settings, Where: string): ()
	local Kinds = ShellSetup.BalanceOpsOf(Settings)
	local Fields = ShellSetup.FieldArithmeticsOf(Settings)
	OneArithmetic(Settings, Kinds, Where)
	FieldCount(Settings, Fields, Where)
	DefaultFields(Fields, Settings.Default, Where)
	SubtractsFromZero(Settings, Kinds, Where)
	Windows(Settings, Where)
	Totals(Settings, Where)
	Quantities(Settings, Fields, Where)
	Rules.CheckSchema(Settings.Schema, DefaultKey, Settings.Default, Where)
	BoundsPassSchema(Settings, Kinds, Where)
end

local function Probe(Settings: Settings): ()
	local Reducer = Settings.Reducer
	if Reducer == nil then
		return
	end
	local Problem = Stepping.Run(function(): string?
		return Guards.ProbeUnknownKind(Reducer, Settings.Default, ShellSetup.FrozenInputs)
	end)
	if Problem ~= nil then
		warn(ProbeWarning(Settings.Name, Problem))
	end
end

return {
	Check = CheckSettings,
	Probe = Probe,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	KeyLegs: the key leg a quantity's move builds for a key the game names as a plain { Store, Key } (hot keys H8, A11):
	the balance kind its store declares in that direction on the field, or the one Kind names among several, and its
	amount. A leg is checked against its key's own setup, a part's included.

	Return type: A plain table with BalanceLeg and CheckedOf.
	Example usage:
		local Credit = KeyLegs.BalanceLeg(To, "To", "Coins", nil, "Credit", 5, "Quantity:Withdraw")
--]=]

local Balance = require("./Balance")
local Balances = require("../../Keys/Trades/Balances")
local Cache = require("../../Keys/DataStore/Cache")
local Check = require("../../Keys/Encoding/Check")
local Keys = require("./Keys")
local KindSetup = require("../../Keys/Ops/KindSetup")
local Leg = require("./Leg")
local Rules = require("./Rules")
local Runner = require("../../Roblox/Runner")
local ShellSetup = require("../../Roblox/Setup")
local Stores = require("./Stores")
local TxShapes = require("../../Shared/TradeShapes")

type CheckedLeg = Leg.CheckedLeg
type Direction = Balances.Direction
type Rule = Check.Rule
type Settings = ShellSetup.Settings
type TxLeg = TxShapes.TxLeg

type KeyGiven = { Store: unknown, Key: unknown }

local CheckAccepted = "KeyLegs: a Check rule accepted a value of another type. The rule must reject it"

local KeyRules: { [string]: Rule } = {
	Store = Leg.MadeStore,
	Key = Check.AnyValue,
}

local function KindOnWanted(Store: string, Direction: Direction): string
	return `a balance field for which the store "{Store}" names a {Direction} kind in Balances`
end

local function KindsOn(Settings: Settings, Field: string, Direction: Direction): { string }
	local Found: { string } = {}
	for OpKind, Kind in ShellSetup.BalanceOpsOf(Settings) do
		if Kind.Field == Field and Kind.Direction == Direction then
			table.insert(Found, OpKind)
		end
	end
	return Found
end

local function KindOn(Settings: Settings, Direction: Direction): Rule
	local Wanted = KindOnWanted(Settings.Name, Direction)
	return function(Value: unknown): string?
		if type(Value) == "string" and #KindsOn(Settings, Value, Direction) > 0 then
			return nil
		end
		return Wanted
	end
end

local function KindChoice(Choices: { string }): Rule
	local Named = Check.OneOf(table.unpack(Choices))
	if #Choices == 1 then
		return Check.Optional(Named)
	end
	return Named
end

local function CheckedOf(Leg: TxLeg, Settings: Settings): CheckedLeg
	local Setup = KindSetup.SetupFor(Runner.OpenedSetup(Settings.Name), Cache.KindOfKey(Leg.Key))
	return { Leg = Leg, Settings = Settings, Setup = Setup }
end

local function BalanceLeg(
	Value: unknown,
	Option: string,
	Field: unknown,
	Kind: unknown,
	Direction: Direction,
	Amount: unknown,
	Where: string
): CheckedLeg
	Check.Table({ [Option] = Value }, { [Option] = Rules.NoMetatable }, Where)
	local KeyWhere = `{Where} {Option}`
	local Given = Rules.Validated(Value, KeyRules, KeyWhere) :: KeyGiven
	local Settings = Stores.SettingsOf(Given.Store)
	assert(Settings ~= nil, CheckAccepted)
	local Key = Keys.Key(Settings, Given.Key, KeyWhere)
	Check.Table({ Field = Field }, { Field = KindOn(Settings, Direction) }, Where)
	assert(type(Field) == "string", CheckAccepted)
	local Choices = KindsOn(Settings, Field, Direction)
	table.sort(Choices)
	Check.Table({ Kind = Kind }, { Kind = KindChoice(Choices) }, Where)
	local OpKind = Choices[1]
	if Kind ~= nil then
		assert(type(Kind) == "string", CheckAccepted)
		OpKind = Kind
	end
	local Arithmetic = Balances.ArithmeticOf(ShellSetup.BalanceOpsOf(Settings)[OpKind])
	Check.Table({ Count = Amount }, { Count = Balance.IsCallAmountOf(Arithmetic) }, Where)
	local Leg: TxLeg = {
		Key = Key,
		OpKind = OpKind,
		Terms = { Kind = OpKind, Amount = Amount },
		MustExist = nil,
		Slot = nil,
	}
	return CheckedOf(Leg, Settings)
end

return {
	BalanceLeg = BalanceLeg,
	CheckedOf = CheckedOf,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Keys: the store's key mode applied to a call's key or player (A11). A player store's key is a Player or a whole
	UserId, stored as decimal text; an entity store's is 1 to KeyBytesMost bytes of UTF-8 outside Ledger's total and
	quantity prefixes, as a listing's Prefix is, which a player store refuses. GameKeyOf reads a key back as the game
	gave it, ListedKeyOf a listed name, or nil.

	Return type: A plain table with Key, Prefix, GameKeyOf, ListedKeyOf, PlayerStoreOnly and Player.
	Example usage:
		local Key = Keys.Key(Settings, Player, "Store:Edit")
--]=]

local Check = require("../../Keys/Encoding/Check")
local Names = require("../../Keys/Encoding/Names")
local Record = require("../../Keys/Constants/Record")
local Rules = require("./Rules")
local ShellSetup = require("../../Roblox/Setup")

type KeysMode = ShellSetup.KeysMode
type Settings = ShellSetup.Settings
type StoreKey = Names.StoreKey

local KeysModes = ShellSetup.KeysMode
local ReservedPrefixes = { Record.ShardKeyPrefix, Record.PartKeyPrefix }

local UserIdMost = Record.VarintLimit - 1
local WholeText = "%d"

local CheckAccepted = "Keys: a Check rule accepted a value of another type. The rule must reject it"
local NotAUserId = "Keys: a player store's key is not a UserId's text. Keys.Key writes only whole numbers"
local PlayerStoreWanted = `"{KeysModes.Player}", since sessions are for player stores only`
local PlayerWanted = "a Player"
local UserIdWanted = `a Player, or a UserId: a whole number from -{UserIdMost} to {UserIdMost}`
local EntityKeyWanted = `a string of 1 to {Record.KeyBytesMost} bytes of valid UTF-8 that does not start with `
	.. `"{Record.ShardKeyPrefix}" or "{Record.PartKeyPrefix}", which Ledger keeps for totals and quantities`
local NoPrefixWanted = `nil on a "{KeysModes.Player}" store, whose keys are UserIds`

local UserIdRule = Check.Whole(-UserIdMost, UserIdMost)
local EntityKeyText = Check.Text(1, Record.KeyBytesMost)
local IsPlayerStore = Rules.Equals(KeysModes.Player, PlayerStoreWanted)
local NoPrefix = Rules.LeftOut(NoPrefixWanted)

local function IsPlayer(Value: unknown): boolean
	return typeof(Value) == "Instance" and Value:IsA("Player")
end

local function PlayerRule(Value: unknown): string?
	if IsPlayer(Value) then
		return nil
	end
	return PlayerWanted
end

local function PlayerKey(Value: unknown): string?
	if IsPlayer(Value) or UserIdRule(Value) == nil then
		return nil
	end
	return UserIdWanted
end

local function HasReservedPrefix(Text: string): boolean
	for _, Prefix in ReservedPrefixes do
		if string.sub(Text, 1, #Prefix) == Prefix then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function EntityKey(Value: unknown): string?
	if EntityKeyText(Value) ~= nil or type(Value) ~= "string" or HasReservedPrefix(Value) then
		return EntityKeyWanted
	end
	return nil
end

local function StoreKeyOf(Settings: Settings, Text: string): StoreKey
	return { Store = Settings.Name, Scope = ShellSetup.StoreScope, Key = Text }
end

local function UserIdText(Value: unknown): string
	if typeof(Value) == "Instance" and Value:IsA("Player") then
		return string.format(WholeText, Value.UserId)
	end
	assert(type(Value) == "number", CheckAccepted)
	return string.format(WholeText, Value)
end

local function Key(Settings: Settings, Value: unknown, Where: string): StoreKey
	if Settings.Keys == KeysModes.Player then
		Check.Table({ Key = Value }, { Key = PlayerKey }, Where)
		return StoreKeyOf(Settings, UserIdText(Value))
	end
	Check.Table({ Key = Value }, { Key = EntityKey }, Where)
	assert(type(Value) == "string", CheckAccepted)
	return StoreKeyOf(Settings, Value)
end

local function Prefix(Settings: Settings, Value: unknown, Where: string): string?
	if Settings.Keys == KeysModes.Player then
		Check.Table({ Prefix = Value }, { Prefix = NoPrefix }, Where)
		return nil
	end
	Check.Table({ Prefix = Value }, { Prefix = Check.Optional(EntityKey) }, Where)
	assert(Value == nil or type(Value) == "string", CheckAccepted)
	return Value
end

local function GameKeyOf(Mode: KeysMode, Key: StoreKey): string | number
	if Mode ~= KeysModes.Player then
		return Key.Key
	end
	local UserId = tonumber(Key.Key)
	if UserId == nil then
		error(NotAUserId, 0)
	end
	return UserId
end

local function UserIdOfText(Text: string): number?
	local UserId = tonumber(Text)
	if UserId == nil or UserIdRule(UserId) ~= nil or string.format(WholeText, UserId) ~= Text then
		return nil
	end
	return UserId
end

local function ListedKeyOf(Mode: KeysMode, Name: string): (string | number)?
	if Mode == KeysModes.Player then
		return UserIdOfText(Name)
	end
	if EntityKey(Name) ~= nil then
		return nil
	end
	return Name
end

local function PlayerStoreOnly(Settings: Settings, Where: string): ()
	Check.Table({ Keys = Settings.Keys }, { Keys = IsPlayerStore }, Where)
end

local function Player(Settings: Settings, Value: unknown, Where: string): Player
	PlayerStoreOnly(Settings, Where)
	Check.Table({ Player = Value }, { Player = PlayerRule }, Where)
	assert(typeof(Value) == "Instance" and Value:IsA("Player"), CheckAccepted)
	return Value
end

return {
	Key = Key,
	Prefix = Prefix,
	GameKeyOf = GameKeyOf,
	ListedKeyOf = ListedKeyOf,
	PlayerStoreOnly = PlayerStoreOnly,
	Player = Player,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Leg: one leg the game names (transaction sheet 7 step 1, A11): a plain table, its store one Ledger.New made on
	this server, its key and its op, which the Tx or call names. A Tx leg takes no slot; a quantity's leg takes one
	only when a serial part decides, never on a balance kind (hot keys 2.7).

	Return type: A plain table with MadeStore, TxLegOf and TakeLeg, and the CheckedLeg type.
	Example usage:
		local Checked = Leg.TxLegOf(Given, "Ledger.Tx Legs[1]")
--]=]

local Args = require("./Args")
local Check = require("../../Keys/Encoding/Check")
local HotShapes = require("../../Shared/QuantityShapes")
local Keys = require("./Keys")
local Post = require("../../Keys/Format/Post")
local Record = require("../../Keys/Constants/Record")
local Requests = require("../../Features/Trades/Call/Requests")
local Rules = require("./Rules")
local Runner = require("../../Roblox/Runner")
local Shapes = require("../../Shared/Shapes")
local ShellSetup = require("../../Roblox/Setup")
local SlotPath = require("../../Keys/Format/Items/SlotPath")
local Stores = require("./Stores")
local TxShapes = require("../../Shared/TradeShapes")

type PathStep = Post.PathStep
type QuantityDeclaration = HotShapes.QuantityDeclaration
type Rule = Check.Rule
type Settings = ShellSetup.Settings
type Setup = Shapes.Setup
type TxLeg = TxShapes.TxLeg

type LegGiven = { Store: unknown, Key: unknown, Op: unknown, MustExist: boolean?, Slot: unknown }

export type CheckedLeg = {
	read Leg: TxLeg,
	read Settings: Settings,
	read Setup: Setup,
}

local AnyValue = Check.AnyValue
local LeftOut = Rules.LeftOut
local NoMetatable = Rules.NoMetatable
local Validated = Rules.Validated

local CheckAccepted = "Leg: a Check rule accepted a value of another type. The rule must reject it"
local StoreWanted = "a store object that Ledger.New opened on this server"
local LegOption = "Leg"
local NoSlot = "nil, since only a serial part decides a slot, and a Tx never has a part leg"
local NoSlotUnlessSerial = "nil, since only a serial part decides a slot, and this quantity has no serials"
local NoSlotOnDelta = "nil, since a balance kind's leg takes no slot"
local SlotWanted = "an array with no metatable of one or more steps, each a string of at least 1 byte of valid UTF-8 "
	.. `or a whole number from {Post.FirstIndex} to {Record.VarintLimit - 1}`

local function MadeStore(Value: unknown): string?
	if Stores.SettingsOf(Value) == nil then
		return StoreWanted
	end
	return nil
end

local function SlotPathRule(Value: unknown): string?
	if type(Value) == "table" and getmetatable(Value) == nil and SlotPath.IsSlotPath(Value) then
		return nil
	end
	return SlotWanted
end

local function LegRulesWith(Slot: Rule): { [string]: Rule }
	return {
		Store = MadeStore,
		Key = AnyValue,
		Op = AnyValue,
		MustExist = Check.Optional(Check.Boolean),
		Slot = Slot,
	}
end

local TxLegRules = LegRulesWith(LeftOut(NoSlot))
local TakeLegRules = LegRulesWith(LeftOut(NoSlotUnlessSerial))
local SerialLegRules = LegRulesWith(Check.Optional(SlotPathRule))

local function SlotOf(Value: unknown): { PathStep }?
	if Value == nil then
		return nil
	end
	assert(type(Value) == "table" and getmetatable(Value) == nil, CheckAccepted)
	local Checked = Value :: { unknown }
	local Steps: { PathStep } = {}
	for Index = 1, #Checked do
		local Step = Checked[Index]
		assert(type(Step) == "string" or type(Step) == "number", CheckAccepted)
		table.insert(Steps, Step)
	end
	return Steps
end

local function LegOf(Given: LegGiven, Slot: { PathStep }?, Where: string): CheckedLeg
	local Settings = Stores.SettingsOf(Given.Store)
	assert(Settings ~= nil, CheckAccepted)
	local Key = Keys.Key(Settings, Given.Key, Where)
	local OpKind, OpTerms = Args.Op(Settings, Given.Op, Where)
	return {
		Leg = { Key = Key, OpKind = OpKind, Terms = OpTerms, MustExist = Given.MustExist, Slot = Slot },
		Settings = Settings,
		Setup = Runner.OpenedSetup(Settings.Name),
	}
end

local function TxLegOf(Value: unknown, Where: string): CheckedLeg
	Check.Table({ [LegOption] = Value }, { [LegOption] = NoMetatable }, Where)
	local Given = Validated(Value, TxLegRules, Where) :: LegGiven
	return LegOf(Given, nil, Where)
end

local function TakeLeg(Value: unknown, Declaration: QuantityDeclaration, Where: string): CheckedLeg
	Check.Table({ [LegOption] = Value }, { [LegOption] = NoMetatable }, Where)
	local Shape = if Declaration.Serials == nil then TakeLegRules else SerialLegRules
	local Given = Validated(Value, Shape, Where) :: LegGiven
	local Checked = LegOf(Given, SlotOf(Given.Slot), Where)
	if Requests.ClassifyLeg(Checked.Leg, Checked.Setup).Kind == "Delta" then
		Check.Table({ Slot = Given.Slot }, { Slot = LeftOut(NoSlotOnDelta) }, Where)
	end
	return Checked
end

return {
	MadeStore = MadeStore,
	TxLegOf = TxLegOf,
	TakeLeg = TakeLeg,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Legs: a Tx's legs and name, judged before sending (transaction sheet 7 step 1, A11); the decider is the core's
	choice. The list is read once, as a raw copy; each leg is Leg's. Sizes are measured once amounts are checked, Encode
	marked as Stepping. Moves, takes and confirms reuse these checks, a part at its widest key and name.

	Return type: A plain table with Check, DeciderOf, CheckMove, PartLegsMost, TakeLegs, ConfirmLegs and NoLegs, and
	the CheckedTx and CheckedLegs types.
	Example usage:
		local Checked = Legs.Check(Given, Options, "Ledger.Tx")
--]=]

local Args = require("./Args")
local Check = require("../../Keys/Encoding/Check")
local Entries = require("../../Keys/Format/Entries")
local HotShapes = require("../../Shared/QuantityShapes")
local Leg = require("./Leg")
local Measure = require("../../Features/Trades/Call/Measure")
local Names = require("../../Keys/Encoding/Names")
local Record = require("../../Keys/Constants/Record")
local Requests = require("../../Features/Trades/Call/Requests")
local Rules = require("./Rules")
local ShellSetup = require("../../Roblox/Setup")
local Stepping = require("../../Roblox/Stepping")
local Terms = require("../../Features/Trades/Call/Terms")
local Transaction = require("../../Keys/Constants/Transaction")
local TxShapes = require("../../Shared/TradeShapes")

type CheckedLeg = Leg.CheckedLeg
type GivenName = Names.GivenName
type KeysMode = ShellSetup.KeysMode
type LegForm = TxShapes.LegForm
type OpName = Names.OpName
type QuantityDeclaration = HotShapes.QuantityDeclaration
type Rule = Check.Rule
type Settings = ShellSetup.Settings
type TxLeg = TxShapes.TxLeg

type TxGiven = { Id: unknown, IdAt: unknown }

type Placed = {
	read Where: string,
	read Option: string,
}

type Places = {
	read Kind: Placed,
	read Pinned: Placed,
	read Marks: { Placed },
	read Ops: { Placed },
}

export type CheckedLegs = {
	read Legs: { TxLeg },
	read KeysByStore: { [string]: KeysMode },
}

export type CheckedTx = {
	read Legs: { TxLeg },
	read Name: GivenName?,
	read KeysByStore: { [string]: KeysMode },
}

local AnyValue = Check.AnyValue
local NoFields = Rules.NoFields
local OpWhere = Rules.OpWhere
local OrDefault = Rules.OrDefault
local Validated = Rules.Validated

local WindowSigmas = Transaction.WindowSigmasBelowOrphanAge

local PartLegAt = 1
local PartLegCount = 1
local TakePartOption = "Count"
local ConfirmPartOption = "Hold"

local CheckAccepted = "Legs: a Check rule accepted a value of another type. The rule must reject it"
local NoLegList: { TxLeg } = {}
local NoKeysByStore: { [string]: KeysMode } = {}
local NoLegs: CheckedLegs = { Legs = table.freeze(NoLegList), KeysByStore = table.freeze(NoKeysByStore) }
table.freeze(NoLegs)

local PartLegsAtLeastWanted = "at least 1 leg, or nil for no legs"
local NoEarlierKey = "a key that no earlier leg names"
local MarkBytesWanted = `at most {Record.MarkMax} bytes`
local OpBytesWanted = `at most {Transaction.OpMax} bytes as canonical JSON`

local function LegsAtLeastWanted(Least: number): string
	return `at least {Least} legs`
end

local function LegsAtMostWanted(Most: number): string
	return `at most {Most} legs, the lowest LegLimit of the legs' stores`
end

local function PartLegsAtMostWanted(Most: number): string
	local Counted = if Most == 1 then "1 leg" else `{Most} legs`
	return `at most {Counted}, one less than the lowest LegLimit of the quantity's store and the legs' stores`
end

local function WindowWanted(Limit: number, Store: string): string
	return `a kind whose window is below OrphanAge less {WindowSigmas} * Sigma of every leg's store, since this `
		.. `leg decides, and that is {Limit} in the store "{Store}"`
end

local function AtMost(Most: number, Wanted: string): Rule
	return function(Value: unknown): string?
		if type(Value) == "number" and Value <= Most then
			return nil
		end
		return Wanted
	end
end

local function AtLeast(Least: number, Wanted: string): Rule
	return function(Value: unknown): string?
		if type(Value) == "number" and Value >= Least then
			return nil
		end
		return Wanted
	end
end

local TxRules: { [string]: Rule } = {
	Id = AnyValue,
	IdAt = AnyValue,
}

local MarkFits = AtMost(Record.MarkMax, MarkBytesWanted)
local OpFits = AtMost(Transaction.OpMax, OpBytesWanted)
local EnoughLegs = AtLeast(Transaction.LegLeast, LegsAtLeastWanted(Transaction.LegLeast))
local EnoughPartLegs = AtLeast(1, PartLegsAtLeastWanted)
local LegsList = Rules.Plain(Check.List(AnyValue))

local function LegWhere(Where: string, Index: number): string
	return `{Where} Legs[{Index}]`
end

local function PinnedWhere(Where: string): string
	return `{Where} Legs`
end

local function LegList(Given: unknown, Enough: Rule, Where: string): { unknown }
	Check.Table({ Legs = Given }, { Legs = LegsList }, Where)
	assert(type(Given) == "table", CheckAccepted)
	local List = table.clone(Given :: { unknown })
	Check.Table({ Legs = #List }, { Legs = Enough }, Where)
	return List
end

local function LowestLegLimit(Checked: { CheckedLeg }): number?
	local Lowest: number? = nil
	for _, Each in Checked do
		local Limit = Each.Settings.LegLimit
		if Limit ~= nil and (Lowest == nil or Limit < Lowest) then
			Lowest = Limit
		end
	end
	return Lowest
end

local function WithinLegLimit(Checked: { CheckedLeg }, Where: string): ()
	local Lowest = LowestLegLimit(Checked)
	if Lowest == nil then
		return
	end
	Check.Table({ Legs = #Checked }, { Legs = AtMost(Lowest, LegsAtMostWanted(Lowest)) }, Where)
end

local function WithinPartLegLimit(WithPart: { CheckedLeg }, Where: string): ()
	local Lowest = LowestLegLimit(WithPart)
	if Lowest == nil then
		return
	end
	local Most = Lowest - PartLegCount
	Check.Table({ Legs = #WithPart - PartLegCount }, { Legs = AtMost(Most, PartLegsAtMostWanted(Most)) }, Where)
end

local function NotNamedIn(Named: { [string]: true }): Rule
	return function(Value: unknown): string?
		if type(Value) == "string" and Named[Value] then
			return NoEarlierKey
		end
		return nil
	end
end

local function DistinctKeys(Checked: { CheckedLeg }, Where: string): ()
	local NamedByStore: { [string]: { [string]: true } } = {}
	for Index, Each in Checked do
		local Key = Each.Leg.Key
		local Named = NamedByStore[Key.Store] or {}
		NamedByStore[Key.Store] = Named
		Check.Table({ Key = Key.Key }, { Key = NotNamedIn(Named) }, LegWhere(Where, Index))
		Named[Key.Key] = true
	end
end

local function NameOf(Options: unknown, Where: string): GivenName?
	local Given = Validated(OrDefault(Options, NoFields), TxRules, Where) :: TxGiven
	return Args.GameName(Args.InOptions, Given.Id, Given.IdAt, Where)
end

local function DeciderIndexOf(Checked: { CheckedLeg }): number
	local Forms: { LegForm } = {}
	for _, Each in Checked do
		table.insert(Forms, Requests.ClassifyLeg(Each.Leg, Each.Setup))
	end
	return Terms.ChooseDecider(Forms, nil)
end

local function WindowBelow(Windows: { [string]: number }, Settings: Settings): Rule
	local Wanted = WindowWanted(Rules.WindowBoundOf(Settings), Settings.Name)
	return function(Value: unknown): string?
		if type(Value) == "string" and Rules.IsBelowWindowBound(Entries.WindowOf(Windows, Value), Settings) then
			return nil
		end
		return Wanted
	end
end

local function CheckAt(At: Placed, Value: unknown, Item: Rule): ()
	Check.Table({ [At.Option] = Value }, { [At.Option] = Item }, At.Where)
end

local function TxPlaces(Count: number, DeciderIndex: number, Where: string): Places
	local Marks: { Placed } = {}
	local Ops: { Placed } = {}
	for Index = 1, Count do
		table.insert(Marks, { Where = LegWhere(Where, Index), Option = "Mark" })
		table.insert(Ops, { Where = LegWhere(Where, Index), Option = "Op" })
	end
	return {
		Kind = { Where = OpWhere(LegWhere(Where, DeciderIndex)), Option = "Kind" },
		Pinned = { Where = PinnedWhere(Where), Option = "PinnedRecord" },
		Marks = Marks,
		Ops = Ops,
	}
end

local function MovePlaces(Options: { string }, DeciderIndex: number, Where: string): Places
	local Each: { Placed } = {}
	for _, Option in Options do
		table.insert(Each, { Where = Where, Option = Option })
	end
	return { Kind = Each[DeciderIndex], Pinned = Each[DeciderIndex], Marks = Each, Ops = Each }
end

local function PartStepPlaces(LegCount: number, PartOption: string, Where: string): Places
	local Part: Placed = { Where = Where, Option = PartOption }
	local Marks: { Placed } = { Part }
	local Ops: { Placed } = { { Where = Where, Option = "Price" } }
	for Index = 1, LegCount do
		table.insert(Marks, { Where = LegWhere(Where, Index), Option = "Mark" })
		table.insert(Ops, { Where = LegWhere(Where, Index), Option = "Op" })
	end
	return { Kind = Part, Pinned = { Where = PinnedWhere(Where), Option = "PinnedRecord" }, Marks = Marks, Ops = Ops }
end

local function Window(Checked: { CheckedLeg }, DeciderIndex: number, At: Placed): ()
	local Deciding = Checked[DeciderIndex]
	local Windows = Deciding.Setup.Limits.TimedWindows
	for _, Each in Checked do
		CheckAt(At, Deciding.Leg.OpKind, WindowBelow(Windows, Each.Settings))
	end
end

local function MeasuredNameOf(Name: GivenName?): OpName
	if Name == nil then
		return Measure.WidestDrawnName
	end
	return Measure.MeasuredName(Name)
end

local function Sizes(Checked: { CheckedLeg }, Legs: { TxLeg }, DeciderIndex: number, Measured: OpName, At: Places): ()
	local Pinned = Measure.PinnedRecordBytes(Legs, DeciderIndex, Checked[DeciderIndex].Setup, Measured)
	CheckAt(At.Pinned, Pinned, MarkFits)

	local DeciderKey = Legs[DeciderIndex].Key
	for Index, Each in Checked do
		if Index == DeciderIndex then
			continue
		end
		local Bytes = Stepping.Run(Measure.MarkBytes, Each.Leg, Each.Setup, DeciderKey, Measured)
		CheckAt(At.Marks[Index], Bytes, MarkFits)
	end

	for Index, Each in Checked do
		CheckAt(At.Ops[Index], Measure.OpBytes(Each.Leg.Terms), OpFits)
	end
end

local function LegsOf(Checked: { CheckedLeg }): { TxLeg }
	local Legs: { TxLeg } = {}
	for _, Each in Checked do
		table.insert(Legs, Each.Leg)
	end
	return Legs
end

local function KeysByStoreOf(Checked: { CheckedLeg }): { [string]: KeysMode }
	local KeysByStore: { [string]: KeysMode } = {}
	for _, Each in Checked do
		KeysByStore[Each.Settings.Name] = Each.Settings.Keys
	end
	return KeysByStore
end

local function CheckMove(
	Checked: { CheckedLeg },
	DeciderIndex: number,
	Name: GivenName?,
	Options: { string },
	Where: string
): ()
	local At = MovePlaces(Options, DeciderIndex, Where)
	Window(Checked, DeciderIndex, At.Kind)
	Sizes(Checked, LegsOf(Checked), DeciderIndex, MeasuredNameOf(Name), At)
end

local function PinnedBytesWith(Part: CheckedLeg, Receiver: CheckedLeg, Count: number, Name: OpName): number
	local Legs: { TxLeg } = table.create(Count, Part.Leg)
	table.insert(Legs, Receiver.Leg)
	return Measure.PinnedRecordBytes(Legs, Count + 1, Receiver.Setup, Name)
end

local function PartLegsMost(Part: CheckedLeg, Receiver: CheckedLeg, Parts: number, Name: GivenName?): number
	local Measured = MeasuredNameOf(Name)
	local Most = Parts
	local Lowest = LowestLegLimit({ Part, Receiver })
	if Lowest ~= nil then
		Most = math.min(Most, Lowest - 1)
	end
	local Fitting = 1
	for Count = 2, Most do
		if PinnedBytesWith(Part, Receiver, Count, Measured) > Record.MarkMax then
			break
		end
		Fitting = Count
	end
	return Fitting
end

local function PartStepLegs(
	Part: CheckedLeg,
	Given: unknown,
	Declaration: QuantityDeclaration,
	Measured: OpName,
	PartOption: string,
	Where: string
): CheckedLegs
	local Checked: { CheckedLeg } = {}
	for Index, Value in LegList(Given, EnoughPartLegs, Where) do
		table.insert(Checked, Leg.TakeLeg(Value, Declaration, LegWhere(Where, Index)))
	end
	local WithPart: { CheckedLeg } = table.clone(Checked)
	table.insert(WithPart, PartLegAt, Part)
	WithinPartLegLimit(WithPart, Where)
	DistinctKeys(Checked, Where)

	local At = PartStepPlaces(#Checked, PartOption, Where)
	Window(WithPart, PartLegAt, At.Kind)
	Sizes(WithPart, LegsOf(WithPart), PartLegAt, Measured, At)
	return { Legs = LegsOf(Checked), KeysByStore = KeysByStoreOf(Checked) }
end

local function TakeLegs(
	Part: CheckedLeg,
	Given: unknown,
	Declaration: QuantityDeclaration,
	Name: GivenName?,
	Where: string
): CheckedLegs
	local Measured = Names.WithPart(MeasuredNameOf(Name), Declaration.Parts - 1)
	return PartStepLegs(Part, Given, Declaration, Measured, TakePartOption, Where)
end

local function ConfirmLegs(
	Part: CheckedLeg,
	Given: unknown,
	Declaration: QuantityDeclaration,
	Where: string
): CheckedLegs
	return PartStepLegs(Part, Given, Declaration, Measure.WidestDrawnName, ConfirmPartOption, Where)
end

local function CheckTx(Given: unknown, Options: unknown, Where: string): CheckedTx
	local Checked: { CheckedLeg } = {}
	for Index, Value in LegList(Given, EnoughLegs, Where) do
		table.insert(Checked, Leg.TxLegOf(Value, LegWhere(Where, Index)))
	end
	WithinLegLimit(Checked, Where)
	DistinctKeys(Checked, Where)
	local Name = NameOf(Options, Where)
	local DeciderIndex = DeciderIndexOf(Checked)
	local At = TxPlaces(#Checked, DeciderIndex, Where)
	Window(Checked, DeciderIndex, At.Kind)

	local Legs = LegsOf(Checked)
	Sizes(Checked, Legs, DeciderIndex, MeasuredNameOf(Name), At)
	return { Legs = Legs, Name = Name, KeysByStore = KeysByStoreOf(Checked) }
end

return {
	Check = CheckTx,
	DeciderOf = DeciderIndexOf,
	CheckMove = CheckMove,
	PartLegsMost = PartLegsMost,
	TakeLegs = TakeLegs,
	ConfirmLegs = ConfirmLegs,
	NoLegs = NoLegs,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Moves: a quantity's moves' arguments, Confirm, Release, Deposit, Withdraw and a gather (hot keys H8, A11). A hold
	handle must be one this quantity's Hold gave. Only an open quantity takes a Deposit or gathers; a final one moves
	only units between parts, and a serial one none (the owner). A Confirm's legs beside its hold's part are Legs'.

	Return type: A plain table with Gathering, HoldHandle, ConfirmOptions, Deposit and Withdraw, and the Deposit
	and Gathering types.
	Example usage:
		local Moved = Moves.Withdraw(Settings, Declaration, 5, 0, 1, "u", nil, "Quantity:Withdraw")
--]=]

local Balance = require("./Balance")
local Balances = require("../../Keys/Trades/Balances")
local Check = require("../../Keys/Encoding/Check")
local Handles = require("../Handles")
local Hot = require("../../Keys/Constants/Hot")
local HotShapes = require("../../Shared/QuantityShapes")
local KeyLegs = require("./KeyLegs")
local Leg = require("./Leg")
local Legs = require("./Legs")
local PartBuild = require("../../Keys/Quantity/Build")
local Quantity = require("./Quantity")
local Rules = require("./Rules")
local ShellSetup = require("../../Roblox/Setup")
local TxShapes = require("../../Shared/TradeShapes")

type CheckedLeg = Leg.CheckedLeg
type CheckedLegs = Legs.CheckedLegs
type ConfirmTerms = HotShapes.ConfirmTerms
type CreditTerms = HotShapes.CreditTerms
type DepositTo = HotShapes.DepositTo
type HoldHandle = HotShapes.HoldHandle
type KeysMode = ShellSetup.KeysMode
type QuantityDeclaration = HotShapes.QuantityDeclaration
type Rule = Check.Rule
type Settings = ShellSetup.Settings
type TakeName = HotShapes.TakeName
type TxLeg = TxShapes.TxLeg
type WithdrawTo = HotShapes.WithdrawTo

type Prices = { [string]: unknown }

type DepositSource = { read Kind: "Minted" } | { read Kind: "Key", read Leg: TxLeg }

export type Deposit = {
	read To: DepositTo,
	read From: DepositSource,
	read KeysByStore: { [string]: KeysMode },
}

type Withdrawal = {
	read Part: number,
	read Field: string,
	read Amount: unknown,
	read To: WithdrawTo,
	read KeysByStore: { [string]: KeysMode },
}

export type Gathering = {
	read Receiver: TxLeg,
	read PartLegsMost: number,
	read Name: TakeName?,
	read KeysByStore: { [string]: KeysMode },
}

type GatherGiven = {
	Kind: unknown,
	Id: unknown,
	IdAt: unknown,
}

type WithdrawGiven = { Kind: unknown }

type ConfirmGiven = { Price: unknown, Legs: unknown }

type DepositGiven = {
	From: unknown,
	Field: unknown,
	Kind: unknown,
	Part: number?,
}

local AnyValue = Check.AnyValue
local OrDefault = Rules.OrDefault
local Validated = Rules.Validated

local Directions = Balances.Direction
local Modes = Hot.Mode
local FreeField = Hot.FreeField

local CreditLegAt = 2

local FromOption = "From"
local ToOption = "To"
local CountOption = "Count"

local CheckAccepted = "Moves: a Check rule accepted a value of another type. The rule must reject it"
local ProceedsNotDeclared = "Moves: a quantity's proceeds field is a balance field its store declares. "
	.. "Ledger.New checks it first"
local DepositWanted = `"{Modes.Open}", since a final quantity's stock is exactly its declared Stock`
local GatherWanted = `"{Modes.Open}", since only an open quantity gathers`
local StockMoveWanted = `"{FreeField}", since a final quantity's parts move only units between them`
local StockStaysWanted = "a proceeds field, since a final quantity's units leave only by being sold or held"
local SerialNoMoveWanted = "a key, since a serial quantity's units never move between parts"
local HoldWanted = "a hold handle this quantity's Hold gave"
local OtherQuantityWanted = "a hold handle this quantity's Hold gave, not another quantity's"
local NoFieldWithoutFrom = "nil when no From is given"
local NoKindToPart = "nil when To is a part, since a part's credit has one kind"

local GatherRules: { [string]: Rule } = {
	Kind = AnyValue,
	Id = AnyValue,
	IdAt = AnyValue,
}

local WithdrawRules: { [string]: Rule } = {
	Kind = AnyValue,
}

local ConfirmRules: { [string]: Rule } = {
	Price = AnyValue,
	Legs = AnyValue,
}

local DepositRules: { [string]: Rule } = {
	From = AnyValue,
	Field = AnyValue,
	Kind = AnyValue,
	Part = AnyValue,
}

local DepositLegs = { "From", "Part" }
local WithdrawLegs = { "Part", "To" }
local GatherLegs = { "Count", "To" }

local function PartWanted(Parts: number): string
	return `a part of the quantity, a whole number from 0 to {Parts - 1}`
end

local function DestinationWanted(Parts: number): string
	return `another part of the quantity, a whole number from 0 to {Parts - 1}, or a key as a table of Store and Key`
end

local function PartIndex(Declaration: QuantityDeclaration): Rule
	local Wanted = PartWanted(Declaration.Parts)
	local Index = Check.Whole(0, Declaration.Parts - 1)
	return function(Value: unknown): string?
		if Index(Value) == nil then
			return nil
		end
		return Wanted
	end
end

local function Destination(Declaration: QuantityDeclaration, From: number): Rule
	local Wanted = DestinationWanted(Declaration.Parts)
	local Index = Check.Whole(0, Declaration.Parts - 1)
	return function(Value: unknown): string?
		if type(Value) == "table" then
			return nil
		end
		if Index(Value) == nil and Value ~= From then
			return nil
		end
		return Wanted
	end
end

local function HeldBy(Declaration: QuantityDeclaration): Rule
	return function(Value: unknown): string?
		local Made = Handles.HoldQuantityOf(Value)
		if Made == Declaration then
			return nil
		end
		if Made ~= nil then
			return OtherQuantityWanted
		end
		return HoldWanted
	end
end

local function NoSerialMove(Declaration: QuantityDeclaration): Rule
	return function(_Value: unknown): string?
		if Declaration.Serials == nil then
			return nil
		end
		return SerialNoMoveWanted
	end
end

local function NotUnits(Value: unknown): string?
	if Value == FreeField then
		return StockStaysWanted
	end
	return nil
end

local function OpenOnly(Declaration: QuantityDeclaration, Wanted: string, Where: string): ()
	Check.Table({ Mode = Declaration.Mode }, { Mode = Rules.Equals(Modes.Open, Wanted) }, Where)
end

local function CreditTermsOf(Settings: Settings, Declaration: QuantityDeclaration, Units: number): CreditTerms
	return { Fingerprint = Quantity.PartFingerprintOf(Settings, Declaration), Count = Units }
end

local function FieldAmount(Settings: Settings, Field: string, Amount: unknown, Where: string): ()
	if Field == FreeField then
		Quantity.Count(Amount, Where)
		return
	end
	local Arithmetic = ShellSetup.FieldArithmeticsOf(Settings)[Field]
	assert(Arithmetic ~= nil, ProceedsNotDeclared)
	Check.Table({ Count = Amount }, { Count = Balance.IsCallAmountOf(Arithmetic) }, Where)
end

local function KeysByStoreOf(Leg: CheckedLeg): { [string]: KeysMode }
	return { [Leg.Settings.Name] = Leg.Settings.Keys }
end

local function DepositToOf(Part: number?): DepositTo
	if Part == nil then
		return { Kind = "Home" }
	end
	return { Kind = "Part", Index = Part }
end

local function ToPart(
	Declaration: QuantityDeclaration,
	Field: string,
	To: number,
	Given: WithdrawGiven,
	Where: string
): WithdrawTo
	Check.Table({ Kind = Given.Kind }, { Kind = Rules.LeftOut(NoKindToPart) }, Where)
	Check.Table({ To = To }, { To = NoSerialMove(Declaration) }, Where)
	if Declaration.Mode == Modes.Final then
		Check.Table({ Field = Field }, { Field = Rules.Equals(FreeField, StockMoveWanted) }, Where)
	end
	return { Kind = "Part", Index = To }
end

local function ToKey(
	Settings: Settings,
	Debit: TxLeg,
	Field: string,
	To: unknown,
	Given: WithdrawGiven,
	Amount: unknown,
	Where: string
): CheckedLeg
	local Credit = KeyLegs.BalanceLeg(To, ToOption, Field, Given.Kind, Directions.Credit, Amount, Where)
	local Checked: { CheckedLeg } = { KeyLegs.CheckedOf(Debit, Settings), Credit }
	Legs.CheckMove(Checked, Legs.DeciderOf(Checked), nil, WithdrawLegs, Where)
	return Credit
end

local function Gathering(
	Settings: Settings,
	Declaration: QuantityDeclaration,
	Units: number,
	To: unknown,
	Field: unknown,
	Options: unknown,
	Where: string
): Gathering
	OpenOnly(Declaration, GatherWanted, Where)
	local Given = Validated(OrDefault(Options, Rules.NoFields), GatherRules, Where) :: GatherGiven
	local Name = Quantity.TakeName(Given.Id, Given.IdAt, Where)
	local Receiver = KeyLegs.BalanceLeg(To, ToOption, Field, Given.Kind, Directions.Credit, Units, Where)
	local Widest =
		PartBuild.DebitLeg(Quantity.PartPlaceOf(Settings, Declaration), Declaration.Parts - 1, FreeField, Units)
	local Part = KeyLegs.CheckedOf(Widest, Settings)
	local Checked: { CheckedLeg } = { Part, Receiver }
	Legs.CheckMove(Checked, Legs.DeciderOf(Checked), Name, GatherLegs, Where)
	local Most = Legs.PartLegsMost(Part, Receiver, Declaration.Parts, Name)
	return { Receiver = Receiver.Leg, PartLegsMost = Most, Name = Name, KeysByStore = KeysByStoreOf(Receiver) }
end

local function HoldHandle(Declaration: QuantityDeclaration, Value: unknown, Where: string): HoldHandle
	Check.Table({ Hold = Value }, { Hold = HeldBy(Declaration) }, Where)
	assert(type(Value) == "table", CheckAccepted)
	return Value :: HoldHandle
end

local function ConfirmLeg(
	Settings: Settings,
	Declaration: QuantityDeclaration,
	Hold: HoldHandle,
	Paid: Prices
): CheckedLeg
	local Fingerprint = Quantity.PartFingerprintOf(Settings, Declaration)
	local Terms: ConfirmTerms = { Fingerprint = Fingerprint, Id = Hold.Id, Count = Hold.Count, Price = Paid }
	local Place = Quantity.PartPlaceOf(Settings, Declaration)
	return KeyLegs.CheckedOf(PartBuild.PartLeg(Place, Hold.Part, Hot.PartOpKind.Confirm, Terms), Settings)
end

local function ConfirmOptions(
	Settings: Settings,
	Declaration: QuantityDeclaration,
	Hold: HoldHandle,
	Options: unknown,
	Where: string
): (Prices, CheckedLegs)
	local Given = Validated(OrDefault(Options, Rules.NoFields), ConfirmRules, Where) :: ConfirmGiven
	local Paid = Quantity.Price(Settings, Declaration, Given.Price, Where)
	if Given.Legs == nil then
		return Paid, Legs.NoLegs
	end
	local Part = ConfirmLeg(Settings, Declaration, Hold, Paid)
	return Paid, Legs.ConfirmLegs(Part, Given.Legs, Declaration, Where)
end

local function Deposit(
	Settings: Settings,
	Declaration: QuantityDeclaration,
	Units: number,
	Options: unknown,
	Where: string
): Deposit
	OpenOnly(Declaration, DepositWanted, Where)
	local Given = Validated(OrDefault(Options, Rules.NoFields), DepositRules, Where) :: DepositGiven
	local Part = Given.Part
	Check.Table({ Part = Part }, { Part = Check.Optional(PartIndex(Declaration)) }, Where)
	local To = DepositToOf(Part)
	if Given.From == nil then
		local NoFrom = Rules.LeftOut(NoFieldWithoutFrom)
		Check.Table({ Field = Given.Field, Kind = Given.Kind }, { Field = NoFrom, Kind = NoFrom }, Where)
		return { To = To, From = { Kind = "Minted" }, KeysByStore = {} }
	end
	local From = KeyLegs.BalanceLeg(Given.From, FromOption, Given.Field, Given.Kind, Directions.Debit, Units, Where)
	local Index = if To.Kind == "Part" then To.Index else Declaration.Parts - 1
	local Terms = CreditTermsOf(Settings, Declaration, Units)
	local Credit = PartBuild.CreditLeg(Quantity.PartPlaceOf(Settings, Declaration), Index, Terms)
	Legs.CheckMove({ From, KeyLegs.CheckedOf(Credit, Settings) }, CreditLegAt, nil, DepositLegs, Where)
	return { To = To, From = { Kind = "Key", Leg = From.Leg }, KeysByStore = KeysByStoreOf(From) }
end

local function Withdraw(
	Settings: Settings,
	Declaration: QuantityDeclaration,
	Count: unknown,
	Part: unknown,
	To: unknown,
	Field: unknown,
	Options: unknown,
	Where: string
): Withdrawal
	local Given = Validated(OrDefault(Options, Rules.NoFields), WithdrawRules, Where) :: WithdrawGiven
	Check.Table({ Part = Part }, { Part = PartIndex(Declaration) }, Where)
	assert(type(Part) == "number", CheckAccepted)
	Check.Table({ Field = Field }, { Field = Check.OneOf(FreeField, table.unpack(Declaration.Proceeds)) }, Where)
	assert(type(Field) == "string", CheckAccepted)
	Check.Table({ To = To }, { To = Destination(Declaration, Part) }, Where)
	local Amount = Rules.FrozenAmount(Count, CountOption, Where)
	if type(To) == "number" then
		local Moved = ToPart(Declaration, Field, To, Given, Where)
		Quantity.Count(Amount, Where)
		FieldAmount(Settings, Field, Amount, Where)
		return { Part = Part, Field = Field, Amount = Amount, To = Moved, KeysByStore = {} }
	end
	if Declaration.Mode == Modes.Final then
		Check.Table({ Field = Field }, { Field = NotUnits }, Where)
	end
	FieldAmount(Settings, Field, Amount, Where)
	local Debit = PartBuild.DebitLeg(Quantity.PartPlaceOf(Settings, Declaration), Part, Field, Amount)
	local Credit = ToKey(Settings, Debit, Field, To, Given, Amount, Where)
	return {
		Part = Part,
		Field = Field,
		Amount = Amount,
		To = { Kind = "Key", Credit = Credit.Leg },
		KeysByStore = KeysByStoreOf(Credit),
	}
end

return {
	Gathering = Gathering,
	HoldHandle = HoldHandle,
	ConfirmOptions = ConfirmOptions,
	Deposit = Deposit,
	Withdraw = Withdraw,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Rules: the rules Api/Validate's modules share and Check lacks, among them the plain-table rule, Schema at a call
	and a window's bound below OrphanAge (transaction sheet 2). A game's table with a metatable is refused unread;
	Copied and Validated give a raw copy and FrozenAmount a deep frozen one, which the caller reads instead.

	Return type: A plain table with NoMetatable, Plain, Copied, Validated, FrozenAmount, OrDefault, NoFields, Equals,
	LeftOut, OpKindName, StorableWanted, StorableAs, CheckSchema, OpPath, OpWhere, BalancePath, WindowPath,
	QuantityPath, WindowBoundOf and IsBelowWindowBound.
	Example usage:
		local Given = Rules.Validated(Entry, TotalRules, Where) :: TotalGiven
		local Shards = Rules.OrDefault(Given.Shards, 16)
--]=]

local Check = require("../../Keys/Encoding/Check")
local Guards = require("../../Keys/Ops/Guards")
local OwnOpKinds = require("../../Keys/Constants/OwnOpKinds")
local Record = require("../../Keys/Constants/Record")
local ShellSetup = require("../../Roblox/Setup")
local Stepping = require("../../Roblox/Stepping")
local Transaction = require("../../Keys/Constants/Transaction")

type Rule = Check.Rule
type ResultSchema = ShellSetup.ResultSchema<unknown>
type Settings = ShellSetup.Settings

type Named = { [string]: unknown }
type Terms = { [unknown]: unknown }

local CheckAcceptedNonText = "Rules: a Check text rule accepted a value that is not a string. The rule must reject it"
local CheckAcceptedNonTable = "Rules: Check.Table accepted a value that is not a table. Check.Table must reject it"
local OwnOpKindWanted = `a name other than one Ledger keeps for its own ops ({table.concat(OwnOpKinds.Names, ", ")}, `
	.. `or one starting {table.concat(OwnOpKinds.Prefixes, " or ")})`
local SchemaYielded = "a yield, and Schema must complete without yielding"
local TableWanted = "a table"
local PlainWanted = "a table with no metatable"
local OptionsLabel = "options"

local NoFields: Named = {}
table.freeze(NoFields)

local function OpPath(Where: string, OpKind: string): string
	return `{Where} Balances kind {OpKind}`
end

local function OpWhere(Where: string): string
	return `{Where} Op`
end

local function BalancePath(Where: string, Field: string): string
	return `{Where} Balances.{Field}`
end

local function WindowPath(Where: string, OpKind: string): string
	return `{Where} Windows.{OpKind}`
end

local function QuantityPath(Where: string, Name: string): string
	return `{Where} Quantities.{Name}`
end

local function SchemaThrew(Problem: unknown): string
	return `a throw: {Problem}`
end

local function MustPassSchema(Where: string, Option: string, Problem: string): string
	return `{Where}: {Option} must pass Schema, got {Problem}`
end

local function StorableWanted(Problem: string): string
	return `a table of storable values, but {Problem}`
end

local function StorableAs(Option: string): Rule
	return function(Value: unknown): string?
		local Problem = Guards.CheckStorable(Value, Option)
		if Problem == nil then
			return nil
		end
		return StorableWanted(Problem)
	end
end

local function Equals(Wanted: unknown, Text: string): Rule
	return function(Value: unknown): string?
		if Value == Wanted then
			return nil
		end
		return Text
	end
end

local function LeftOut(Wanted: string): Rule
	return function(Value: unknown): string?
		if Value == nil then
			return nil
		end
		return Wanted
	end
end

local function WindowBoundOf(Settings: Settings): number
	return Settings.OrphanAge - Transaction.WindowSigmasBelowOrphanAge * Record.Sigma
end

local function IsBelowWindowBound(Window: number, Settings: Settings): boolean
	return Window < WindowBoundOf(Settings)
end

local NonEmptyText = Check.TextAtLeast(1)

local function OpKindName(Value: unknown): string?
	local Problem = NonEmptyText(Value)
	if Problem ~= nil then
		return Problem
	end
	assert(type(Value) == "string", CheckAcceptedNonText)
	if table.find(OwnOpKinds.Names, Value) ~= nil then
		return OwnOpKindWanted
	end
	for _, Prefix in OwnOpKinds.Prefixes do
		if string.sub(Value, 1, #Prefix) == Prefix then
			return OwnOpKindWanted
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function OrDefault<Item>(Value: Item?, Default: Item): Item
	if Value == nil then
		return Default
	end
	return Value
end

local function Plain(Item: Rule): Rule
	return function(Value: unknown): string?
		if type(Value) == "table" and getmetatable(Value) ~= nil then
			return PlainWanted
		end
		return Item(Value)
	end
end

local function AnyTable(Value: unknown): string?
	if type(Value) == "table" then
		return nil
	end
	return TableWanted
end

local NoMetatable = Plain(Check.AnyValue)
local PlainOptions = Plain(AnyTable)

local function Copied(Value: unknown, Where: string): Terms
	Check.Table({ [OptionsLabel] = Value }, { [OptionsLabel] = PlainOptions }, Where)
	assert(type(Value) == "table", CheckAcceptedNonTable)
	return table.clone(Value :: Terms)
end

local function Validated(Value: unknown, Rules: { [string]: Rule }, Where: string): Terms
	local Given = Copied(Value, Where)
	Check.Table(Given, Rules, Where)
	return Given
end

local function FrozenAmount(Amount: unknown, Option: string, Where: string): unknown
	if type(Amount) ~= "table" then
		return Amount
	end
	Check.Table({ [Option] = Amount }, { [Option] = StorableAs(Option) }, Where)
	local Copy = Guards.DeepCopy(Amount :: Terms)
	Guards.DeepFreeze(Copy)
	return Copy
end

local function SchemaProblemAtCall(Schema: ResultSchema, State: unknown): string?
	local Ran = Guards.RunWithoutYield(ShellSetup.SchemaProblem, SchemaYielded, Schema, State)
	if Ran.Kind == "Threw" then
		return SchemaThrew(Ran.Problem)
	end
	if Ran.Kind == "Yielded" then
		return SchemaYielded
	end
	return Ran.Value
end

local function CheckSchema(Schema: ResultSchema?, Option: string, State: unknown, Where: string): ()
	if Schema == nil then
		return
	end
	local Problem = Stepping.Run(SchemaProblemAtCall, Schema, State)
	if Problem ~= nil then
		error(MustPassSchema(Where, Option, Problem), 0)
	end
end

return {
	NoMetatable = NoMetatable,
	Plain = Plain,
	Copied = Copied,
	Validated = Validated,
	FrozenAmount = FrozenAmount,
	OrDefault = OrDefault,
	NoFields = NoFields,
	Equals = Equals,
	LeftOut = LeftOut,
	OpKindName = OpKindName,
	StorableWanted = StorableWanted,
	StorableAs = StorableAs,
	CheckSchema = CheckSchema,
	OpPath = OpPath,
	OpWhere = OpWhere,
	BalancePath = BalancePath,
	WindowPath = WindowPath,
	QuantityPath = QuantityPath,
	WindowBoundOf = WindowBoundOf,
	IsBelowWindowBound = IsBelowWindowBound,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Setup: Ledger.New's options as Check rules, settled into Shell/Setup's Settings; balance kinds are Balance's.
	Each other table is read raw before kinds run the game's arithmetic; the default state is frozen.
	Balances names each balance field's credit and debit kinds, by name (the field's bounds) or as { Kind, Min?, Max? }
	(its own); every other kind is the reducer's and is never listed. A field keeps its arithmetic with no kind on it:
	never remove one. OnLoadFailed never replaces the kick.

	Return type: A plain table with Settle.
	Example usage:
		local Settings = Setup.Settle(Options, "Ledger.New")
--]=]

local Balance = require("./Balance")
local Balances = require("../../Keys/Trades/Balances")
local Check = require("../../Keys/Encoding/Check")
local Extras = require("../../Keys/Constants/Extras")
local ExtrasShapes = require("../../Shared/ReadShapes")
local Guards = require("../../Keys/Ops/Guards")
local Hot = require("../../Keys/Constants/Hot")
local HotShapes = require("../../Shared/QuantityShapes")
local Json = require("../../Keys/Encoding/Json")
local PublicTypes = require("../../Types")
local Record = require("../../Keys/Constants/Record")
local Rules = require("./Rules")
local Settable = require("../../Keys/Constants/Settable")
local ShellSetup = require("../../Roblox/Setup")

type Declaration = Balances.Declaration
type KindWindows = ShellSetup.KindWindows
type LoadFailedHandler = ShellSetup.LoadFailedHandler
type Rule = Check.Rule
type Serials = HotShapes.Serials
type SettledMigration = ShellSetup.SettledMigration
type Settings = ShellSetup.Settings

type Named = { [string]: unknown }
type Tree = { [unknown]: unknown }
type Ops = ShellSetup.Ops
type Direction = Balances.Direction

type Settling = {
	Listed: Balance.Listed,
	Ops: Ops,
	Seen: { [string]: true },
	Copies: Balance.Copies,
}

type KindGiven = {
	Kind: string,

	Max: unknown,
}

type KindItem = string | KindGiven

type FieldGiven = {
	Credit: (string | { KindItem })?,
	Debit: (string | { KindItem })?,

	Max: unknown,
	Arithmetic: unknown,
