type OptionsGiven = {
	Name: string,
	Keys: ShellSetup.KeysMode,
	Default: unknown,
	Reducer: Guards.Reducer<unknown, unknown, unknown>?,
	Schema: ShellSetup.ResultSchema<unknown>?,
	Balances: Named?,
	Migrations: { unknown }?,
	MustExist: boolean,
	Erasable: boolean,
	LegLimit: number?,
	OnLoadFailed: LoadFailedHandler?,
	Kick: boolean?,
	KickMessage: string?,
	SaveInterval: number?,
	IdleReadInterval: number?,
	HoldMax: number?,
	OrphanAge: number?,
	Windows: Named?,
	CutWindow: number?,
	Totals: Named?,
	Quantities: Named?,
	Mock: unknown?,
}

type MigrationGiven = PublicTypes.Migration
type WindowGiven = index<PublicTypes.Windows, string>
type TotalGiven = PublicTypes.TotalDeclaration
type QuantityGiven = PublicTypes.QuantityDeclaration

local AnyValue = Check.AnyValue
local BalancePath = Rules.BalancePath
local Copied = Rules.Copied
local NoFields = Rules.NoFields
local OpKindName = Rules.OpKindName
local OpPath = Rules.OpPath
local OrDefault = Rules.OrDefault
local Plain = Rules.Plain
local QuantityPath = Rules.QuantityPath
local Validated = Rules.Validated
local WindowPath = Rules.WindowPath

local NonEmptyText = Check.TextAtLeast(1)

local KeysModes = ShellSetup.KeysMode
local KeyKinds = Record.KeyKind

local WholeMost = Record.VarintLimit - 1

local DefaultWhere = "Default"
local ReservedStoreName = `a store name other than "{Record.CounterStore}", which Ledger keeps for its server counter`
local DefaultTooBig = `a state of at most {Record.StateCap} bytes as canonical JSON`
local KindsWanted = "an op kind name, or a list of names and { Kind, Min?, Max? } tables"
local KindOnceWanted = "a kind named once in Balances, under one field and one of Credit or Debit"
local MockWanted = "a service that Mock.New made"
local ErasableWanted = "true or false, which says whether Store:Erase may end this store's keys "
	.. "(true gives them the incarnation id an erase needs, false makes Erase throw)"

local function MigrationPath(Where: string, Index: number): string
	return `{Where} Migrations[{Index}]`
end

local function TotalPath(Where: string, Name: string): string
	return `{Where} Totals.{Name}`
end

local function SerialsPath(Where: string): string
	return `{Where} Serials`
end

local NoItems: { unknown } = {}
table.freeze(NoItems)
local NoNames: { string } = {}
table.freeze(NoNames)

local StoreNameBytes = Check.Text(1, Record.StoreNameBytesMost)
local StringKeys = Plain(Check.Map(NonEmptyText, AnyValue))
local KeyName = Check.Text(1, Record.KeyNameBytesMost)

local function StoreName(Value: unknown): string?
	if Value == Record.CounterStore then
		return ReservedStoreName
	end
	return StoreNameBytes(Value)
end

local function DefaultState(Value: unknown): string?
	local Problem = StringKeys(Value)
	if Problem ~= nil then
		return Problem
	end
	local Unstorable = Guards.CheckStorable(Value, DefaultWhere)
	if Unstorable ~= nil then
		return Rules.StorableWanted(Unstorable)
	end
	if Json.Size(Value) > Record.StateCap then
		return DefaultTooBig
	end
	return nil
end

local function KindItemShape(Value: unknown): string?
	if type(Value) == "table" then
		return nil
	end
	return OpKindName(Value)
end

local KindList = Plain(Check.List(KindItemShape))

local function KindNames(Value: unknown): string?
	if type(Value) == "string" then
		return OpKindName(Value)
	end
	if type(Value) == "table" then
		return KindList(Value)
	end
	return KindsWanted
end

local function MockService(Value: unknown): string?
	if type(Value) == "table" then
		return nil
	end
	return MockWanted
end

local function ErasableDeclared(Value: unknown): string?
	if type(Value) == "boolean" then
		return nil
	end
	return ErasableWanted
end

local PlayerRules: { [string]: Rule } = {
	Name = StoreName,
	Keys = Check.OneOf(KeysModes.Player, KeysModes.String),
	Default = DefaultState,
	Reducer = Check.Optional(Check.Function),
	Schema = Check.Optional(Check.Function),
	Balances = Check.Optional(Plain(Check.Map(NonEmptyText, AnyValue))),
	Migrations = Check.Optional(Plain(Check.ListAtMost(AnyValue, Record.MigrationsMax))),
	MustExist = Check.Boolean,
	Erasable = ErasableDeclared,
	LegLimit = Check.Optional(Settable.LegLimit.Rule),
	OnLoadFailed = Check.Optional(Check.Function),
	Kick = Check.Optional(Settable.Kick.Rule),
	KickMessage = Check.Optional(Settable.KickMessage.Rule),
	SaveInterval = Check.Optional(Settable.SaveInterval.Rule),
	IdleReadInterval = Check.Optional(Settable.IdleReadInterval.Rule),
	HoldMax = Check.Optional(Settable.HoldMax.Rule),
	OrphanAge = Check.Optional(Settable.OrphanAge.Rule),
	Windows = Check.Optional(Plain(Check.Map(NonEmptyText, AnyValue))),
	CutWindow = Check.Optional(Settable.CutWindow.Rule),
	Totals = Check.Optional(Plain(Check.Map(KeyName, AnyValue))),
	Quantities = Check.Optional(Plain(Check.Map(KeyName, AnyValue))),
	Mock = Check.Optional(MockService),
}

local EntityRules = table.clone(PlayerRules)
EntityRules.OnLoadFailed = nil
EntityRules.Kick = nil
EntityRules.KickMessage = nil

local KindRules: { [string]: Rule } = {
	Kind = OpKindName,
	Min = AnyValue,
	Max = AnyValue,
}

local FieldRules: { [string]: Rule } = {
	Credit = Check.Optional(KindNames),
	Debit = Check.Optional(KindNames),
	Min = AnyValue,
	Max = AnyValue,
	Arithmetic = AnyValue,
}

local AdditiveMigrationRules: { [string]: Rule } = {
	Run = Check.Function,
	IsBreaking = Check.Optional(Check.Boolean),
	Fields = Plain(Check.List(NonEmptyText)),
}

local BreakingMigrationRules: { [string]: Rule } = {
	Run = Check.Function,
	IsBreaking = Check.Boolean,
}

local WindowRules: { [string]: Rule } = {
	Timed = Check.Optional(Settable.TimedWindow.Rule),
	Untimed = Check.Optional(Settable.UntimedWindow.Rule),
}

local TotalRules: { [string]: Rule } = {
	Shards = Check.Optional(Check.Whole(1, Extras.ShardsMost)),
}

local QuantityRules: { [string]: Rule } = {
	Parts = Check.Whole(Hot.PartsLeast, Hot.PartsMost),
	Mode = Check.OneOf(Hot.Mode.Final, Hot.Mode.Open),
	Stock = Check.Optional(Check.Whole(0, WholeMost)),
	Serials = AnyValue,
	Proceeds = Check.Optional(Plain(Check.ListAtMost(NonEmptyText, Hot.ProceedsMax))),
	Closed = Check.Optional(Check.Boolean),
}

local SerialsRules: { [string]: Rule } = {
	First = Check.Whole(0, WholeMost - 1),
	Count = Check.Whole(1, WholeMost),
}

local function FrozenCopy<Item>(List: { Item }): { Item }
	local Copy = table.clone(List)
	table.freeze(Copy)
	return Copy
end

local function KindListOf(Value: (string | { KindItem })?): { KindItem }
	if Value == nil then
		return NoItems :: { KindItem }
	end
	if type(Value) == "string" then
		return { Value }
	end
	return Value
end

local function KindOf(Item: KindItem, Given: FieldGiven, Where: string): KindGiven
	if type(Item) == "string" then
		return { Kind = Item, Min = Given.Min, Max = Given.Max }
	end
	local Own = Validated(Item, KindRules, Where) :: KindGiven
	return {
		Kind = Own.Kind,
		Min = if Own.Min == nil then Given.Min else Own.Min,
		Max = if Own.Max == nil then Given.Max else Own.Max,
	}
end

local Repeated = Rules.Equals(false, KindOnceWanted)

local function NamedOnce(Seen: { [string]: true }, OpKind: string, Where: string): ()
	if Seen[OpKind] then
		Check.Table({ Kind = OpKind }, { Kind = Repeated }, Where)
	end
	Seen[OpKind] = true
end

local function SettleKinds(Given: FieldGiven, Field: string, Direction: Direction, Settled: Settling, Where: string): ()
	local Names = if Direction == Balances.Direction.Credit then Given.Credit else Given.Debit
	for Index, Item in KindListOf(Names) do
		local Own = KindOf(Item, Given, `{BalancePath(Where, Field)}.{Direction}[{Index}]`)
		local Path = OpPath(Where, Own.Kind)
		NamedOnce(Settled.Seen, Own.Kind, Path)
		local Kind = {
			Field = Field,
			Direction = Direction,
			Min = Own.Min,
			Max = Own.Max,
			Arithmetic = Given.Arithmetic,
		}
		Settled.Ops[Own.Kind] = Balance.Settle(Kind, Settled.Copies, Settled.Listed, Path)
	end
end

local function BalancesOf(Given: Named?, Copies: Balance.Copies, Where: string): (Balance.Listed, Ops)
	local Fields: { [string]: FieldGiven } = {}
	local Listed: Balance.Listed = {}
	for Field, Entry in OrDefault(Given, NoFields) do
		local Path = BalancePath(Where, Field)
		local Declared = Validated(Entry, FieldRules, Path) :: FieldGiven
		Fields[Field] = Declared
		Listed[Field] = Balance.ListedArithmetic(OrDefault(Declared.Arithmetic, true), Copies, Path)
	end
	table.freeze(Listed)

	local Settled: Settling = { Listed = Listed, Ops = {}, Seen = {}, Copies = Copies }
	for Field, Entry in Fields do
		SettleKinds(Entry, Field, Balances.Direction.Credit, Settled, Where)
		SettleKinds(Entry, Field, Balances.Direction.Debit, Settled, Where)
	end
	return Listed, table.freeze(Settled.Ops)
end

local function MigrationRulesOf(Given: Named): { [string]: Rule }
	if Given.IsBreaking == true then
		return BreakingMigrationRules
	end
	return AdditiveMigrationRules
end

local function MigrationsOf(Given: { unknown }?, Where: string): { SettledMigration }
	local Settled: { SettledMigration } = {}
	for Index, Item in OrDefault(Given, NoItems) do
		local Path = MigrationPath(Where, Index)
		local Copy = Copied(Item, Path) :: Named
		Check.Table(Copy, MigrationRulesOf(Copy), Path)
		local Migration = Copy :: MigrationGiven
		table.insert(
			Settled,
			table.freeze({
				Run = Migration.Run,
				IsBreaking = Migration.IsBreaking == true,
				Fields = FrozenCopy(OrDefault(Migration.Fields, NoNames)),
			})
		)
	end
	return table.freeze(Settled)
end

local function WindowsOf(Given: Named?, Where: string): { [string]: KindWindows }
	local Declared = OrDefault(Given, NoFields)
	Check.Table({ Windows = Declared }, { Windows = Check.Map(OpKindName, AnyValue) }, Where)

	local Settled: { [string]: KindWindows } = {}
	for OpKind, Entry in Declared do
		local Path = WindowPath(Where, OpKind)
		local Window = Validated(Entry, WindowRules, Path) :: WindowGiven
		local Timed = OrDefault(Window.Timed, Settable.TimedWindow.Default)
		Settled[OpKind] = table.freeze({
			Timed = Timed,
			Untimed = OrDefault(Window.Untimed, Timed),
			IsUntimedSet = Window.Untimed ~= nil,
		})
	end
	return table.freeze(Settled)
end

local function TotalsOf(Given: Named?, Where: string): { [string]: ExtrasShapes.TotalDeclaration }
	local Settled: { [string]: ExtrasShapes.TotalDeclaration } = {}
	for Name, Entry in OrDefault(Given, NoFields) do
		local Total = Validated(Entry, TotalRules, TotalPath(Where, Name)) :: TotalGiven
		local Shards = OrDefault(Total.Shards, Extras.ShardsDefault)
		Settled[Name] = table.freeze({ Name = Name, KeyCount = Shards, Keys = KeyKinds.Shard })
	end
	return table.freeze(Settled)
end

local function SerialsOf(Value: unknown, Where: string): Serials?
	if Value == nil then
		return nil
	end
	local Path = SerialsPath(Where)
	local Given = Validated(Value, SerialsRules, Path) :: Serials
	local CountMost = WholeMost - Given.First
	Check.Table({ Count = Given.Count }, { Count = Check.Whole(1, CountMost) }, Path)
	return { First = Given.First, Count = Given.Count }
end

local function QuantitiesOf(
	Given: Named?,
	Where: string
): ({ [string]: HotShapes.QuantityDeclaration }, { [string]: boolean })
	local Settled: { [string]: HotShapes.QuantityDeclaration } = {}
	local Closed: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for Name, Entry in OrDefault(Given, NoFields) do
		local Path = QuantityPath(Where, Name)
		local Quantity = Validated(Entry, QuantityRules, Path) :: QuantityGiven
		Settled[Name] = table.freeze({
			Name = Name,
			Parts = Quantity.Parts,
			Mode = Quantity.Mode,
			Stock = Quantity.Stock,
			Serials = SerialsOf(Quantity.Serials, Path),
			Proceeds = FrozenCopy(OrDefault(Quantity.Proceeds, NoNames)),
		})
		Closed[Name] = Quantity.Closed == true
	end
	return table.freeze(Settled), table.freeze(Closed)
end

local function RulesFor(Given: Named): { [string]: Rule }
	if Given.Keys == KeysModes.String then
		return EntityRules
	end
	return PlayerRules
end

local function Settle(Options: unknown, Where: string): Settings
	local Copy = Copied(Options, Where) :: Named
	Check.Table(Copy, RulesFor(Copy), Where)
	local Given = Copy :: OptionsGiven

	local Default = Guards.DeepCopy(Given.Default :: Tree) :: Named
	local Migrations = MigrationsOf(Given.Migrations, Where)
	local Windows = WindowsOf(Given.Windows, Where)
	local Totals = TotalsOf(Given.Totals, Where)
	local Quantities, ClosedQuantities = QuantitiesOf(Given.Quantities, Where)
	local Copies: Balance.Copies = {}
	local Listed, Ops = BalancesOf(Given.Balances, Copies, Where)
	Guards.DeepFreeze(Default)

	return table.freeze({
		Name = Given.Name,
		Keys = Given.Keys,
		Default = Default,
		Reducer = Given.Reducer,
		Schema = Given.Schema,
		Ops = Ops,
		Balances = Listed,
		Migrations = Migrations,
		MustExist = Given.MustExist,
		IsErasable = Given.Erasable,
		LegLimit = Given.LegLimit,
		OnLoadFailed = Given.OnLoadFailed,
		Kick = OrDefault(Given.Kick, Settable.Kick.Default),
		KickMessage = OrDefault(Given.KickMessage, Settable.KickMessage.Default),
		SaveInterval = OrDefault(Given.SaveInterval, Settable.SaveInterval.Default),
		IdleReadInterval = OrDefault(Given.IdleReadInterval, Settable.IdleReadInterval.Default),
		HoldMax = OrDefault(Given.HoldMax, Settable.HoldMax.Default),
		OrphanAge = OrDefault(Given.OrphanAge, Settable.OrphanAge.Default),
		Windows = Windows,
		CutWindow = OrDefault(Given.CutWindow, Settable.CutWindow.Default),
		Totals = Totals,
		Quantities = Quantities,
		ClosedQuantities = ClosedQuantities,
		Mock = Given.Mock,
	})
end

return {
	Settle = Settle,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Stores: the live store objects Ledger.New made on this server, each with its Settings, so a call that names a store
	(a Tx leg) takes only a real one. Destroy marks its object destroying, which Load and Destroy refuse, then
	unregisters it, which every method refuses. The set is weak, and a look-alike table is not in it.

	Return type: A plain table with Register, SettingsOf, IsLive, CheckLive, IsDestroyingOrDestroyed,
	CheckNotDestroying, MarkDestroying and Unregister.
	Example usage:
		Stores.Register(Object, Settings)
		local Settings = Stores.SettingsOf(Leg.Store)
--]=]

local ShellSetup = require("../../Roblox/Setup")

type Settings = ShellSetup.Settings

type Entry = {
	read Settings: Settings,
	IsDestroying: boolean,
}

local NotRegistered = "Stores: a store object was marked destroying while not registered. Check it first"

local Registered: { [unknown]: Entry } = {}
setmetatable(Registered, { __mode = "k" })

local function Destroyed(Name: string): string
	return `Ledger: {Name} was destroyed. Its store object takes no more calls.`
end

local function Register(Object: unknown, Settings: Settings): ()
	Registered[Object] = { Settings = Settings, IsDestroying = false }
end

local function SettingsOf(Value: unknown): Settings?
	local Entry = Registered[Value]
	if Entry == nil then
		return nil
	end
	return Entry.Settings
end

local function IsLive(Object: unknown): boolean
	return Registered[Object] ~= nil
end

local function CheckLive(Object: unknown, Name: string): ()
	if not IsLive(Object) then
		error(Destroyed(Name), 0)
	end
end

local function IsDestroyingOrDestroyed(Object: unknown): boolean
	local Entry = Registered[Object]
	return Entry == nil or Entry.IsDestroying
end

local function CheckNotDestroying(Object: unknown, Name: string): ()
	if IsDestroyingOrDestroyed(Object) then
		error(Destroyed(Name), 0)
	end
end

local function MarkDestroying(Object: unknown): ()
	local Entry = Registered[Object]
	assert(Entry ~= nil, NotRegistered)
	Entry.IsDestroying = true
end

local function Unregister(Object: unknown): ()
	Registered[Object] = nil
end

return {
	Register = Register,
	SettingsOf = SettingsOf,
	IsLive = IsLive,
	CheckLive = CheckLive,
	IsDestroyingOrDestroyed = IsDestroyingOrDestroyed,
	CheckNotDestroying = CheckNotDestroying,
	MarkDestroying = MarkDestroying,
	Unregister = Unregister,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	State: a server's extras state, in Composed.State.Extras (extras sheet E4, E5): a TotalView per total (Replicas:
	the count of its summary this server last read), a SummaryHolder per summary refresh (UsedAt: its last local
	Total call; Replicas: the count it writes; IsLeased: replica 0 took its last write; Announced: the count replica 0
	took; Until: when that write's lease runs out), a TotalWork per Total call, the
	CopyHolders and Followers (Copies/State), the open Peeks, whether Stale is watched, and CopyReads, the ended copy
	reads. A Purpose finds a request's owner. CopyTimes and SummaryTimes hold the holders' due times (DueTimes): a
	refresh at NextAt, and an expiry check at UsedAt plus the age that ends it, which HolderOf files first.

	Return type: A plain table of functions, and the TotalView, SummaryHolder, OutRead, TotalWork, ReadRound,
	TotalKeyRead, SummaryGet, SummaryUpdate, SummaryCold, TotalCold, Purpose, HolderTimes and ExtrasState
	types.
	Example usage:
		local State = ExtrasState.NewState()
		local View = ExtrasState.ViewOf(State, "Shop", "global", { Name = "coins", KeyCount = 16, Keys = "Shard" })
--]=]

local CopyState = require("./Copies/State")
local DueTimes = require("../../Shared/DueTimes")
local Extras = require("../../Keys/Constants/Extras")
local ExtrasShapes = require("../../Shared/ReadShapes")
local GetOrMake = require("../../Util/GetOrMake").GetOrMake
local Names = require("../../Keys/Encoding/Names")
local Numbers = require("../../Keys/DataStore/Numbers")
local Shapes = require("../../Shared/Shapes")

type Breaker = ExtrasShapes.Breaker
type AdviceGet = CopyState.AdviceGet
type CopyHolder = CopyState.CopyHolder
type CopyRead = CopyState.CopyRead
type Decode = CopyState.Decode
type Follower = CopyState.Follower
type HeaderGet = CopyState.HeaderGet
type HeaderUpdate = CopyState.HeaderUpdate
type ItemRemove = CopyState.ItemRemove
type PartGet = CopyState.PartGet
type PartSet = CopyState.PartSet
type PeekWork = CopyState.PeekWork
type ColdRead = CopyState.ColdRead
type TickCold = CopyState.TickCold
type Pair = ExtrasShapes.Pair
type TotalCall = ExtrasShapes.TotalCall
type TotalDeclaration = ExtrasShapes.TotalDeclaration
type TotalRef = ExtrasShapes.TotalRef
type ServerState = Shapes.ServerState
type StoreKey = Names.StoreKey
type DueTimes<Item> = DueTimes.DueTimes<Item>

export type OutRead = {
	read RequestId: number,
	read SentAt: number,
}

export type TotalView = {
	Pairs: { [number]: Pair },
	SeenAt: number?,
	ReadAt: { [number]: number },
	ReadOut: { [number]: OutRead },
	Interval: number,
	Breaker: Breaker,
	Holder: SummaryHolder?,
	Replicas: number,
}

type ViewsOfName = { [number]: TotalView }

type ViewsOfScope = { [string]: ViewsOfName }

type ViewsOfStore = { [string]: ViewsOfScope }

export type SummaryHolder = {
	read Store: string,
	read Scope: string,
	read Total: TotalDeclaration,
	Out: number,
	NextAt: number?,
	UsedAt: number,
	Replicas: number,
	IsLeased: boolean,
	Announced: number,
	Until: number,
}

export type TotalWork = {
	read Call: TotalCall,
	read Deadline: number,
	Waits: { [number]: boolean },
	IsTakerOwed: boolean,
	Tidies: { StoreKey },
}

export type ReadRound = {
	Pending: number,
	IsThrottled: boolean,
	IsGood: boolean,
}

export type TotalKeyRead = {
	read Kind: "TotalKeyRead",
	read Ref: TotalRef,
	read Index: number,
	read Fraction: number,
	read Round: ReadRound,
}

export type SummaryGet = { read Kind: "SummaryGet", read Ref: TotalRef, read Replica: number }

export type SummaryUpdate = { read Kind: "SummaryUpdate", read Holder: SummaryHolder, read Replica: number }

export type SummaryCold = { read Kind: "SummaryCold", read Holder: SummaryHolder }

export type TotalCold = { read Kind: "TotalCold", read Ref: TotalRef }

export type Purpose =
	{ read Kind: "RefreshRead", read Holder: SummaryHolder, read Index: number }
	| SummaryUpdate
	| TotalKeyRead
	| SummaryGet
	| SummaryCold
	| TotalCold
	| PartSet
	| HeaderUpdate
	| AdviceGet
	| ItemRemove
	| HeaderGet
	| PartGet
	| Decode
	| ColdRead
	| TickCold

export type HolderTimes<Item> = {
	Refreshes: DueTimes<Item>,
	Expiries: DueTimes<Item>,
}

export type ExtrasState = {
	Views: { [string]: ViewsOfStore },
	Holders: { SummaryHolder },
	Calls: { [number]: TotalWork },
	Purposes: { [number]: Purpose },
	CopyHolders: { [string]: CopyHolder },
	Followers: { [string]: Follower },
	Peeks: { [number]: PeekWork },
	IsStaleWatched: boolean,
	CopyReads: { CopyRead },
	CopyTimes: HolderTimes<string>,
	SummaryTimes: HolderTimes<SummaryHolder>,
}

local function NewView(): TotalView
	return {
		Pairs = {},
		SeenAt = nil,
		ReadAt = {},
		ReadOut = {},
		Interval = Extras.IntervalFirst,
		Breaker = { Misses = 0, OpenUntil = nil },
		Holder = nil,
		Replicas = 1,
	}
end

local function NewState(): ExtrasState
	return {
		Views = {},
		Holders = {},
		Calls = {},
		Purposes = {},
		CopyHolders = {},
		Followers = {},
		Peeks = {},
		IsStaleWatched = false,
		CopyReads = {},
		CopyTimes = { Refreshes = {}, Expiries = {} },
		SummaryTimes = { Refreshes = {}, Expiries = {} },
	}
end

local function ViewOf(State: ExtrasState, Store: string, Scope: string, Total: TotalDeclaration): TotalView
	local OfStore = GetOrMake(State.Views, Store, function(): ViewsOfStore
		return {}
	end)
	local OfScope = GetOrMake(OfStore, Scope, function(): ViewsOfScope
		return {}
	end)
	local OfName = GetOrMake(OfScope, Total.Name, function(): ViewsOfName
		return {}
	end)
	return GetOrMake(OfName, Total.KeyCount, NewView)
end

local function HolderOf(
	State: ExtrasState,
	Store: string,
	Scope: string,
	Total: TotalDeclaration,
	Clock: number
): SummaryHolder
	local View = ViewOf(State, Store, Scope, Total)
	local Held = View.Holder
	if Held ~= nil then
		return Held
	end
	local Holder: SummaryHolder = {
		Store = Store,
		Scope = Scope,
		Total = Total,
		Out = 0,
		NextAt = nil,
		UsedAt = Clock,
		Replicas = 1,
		IsLeased = false,
		Announced = 1,
		Until = 0,
	}
	View.Holder = Holder
	table.insert(State.Holders, Holder)
	DueTimes.Add(State.SummaryTimes.Expiries, Holder, Clock + Extras.SummaryExpiry)
	return Holder
end

local function IsHeld(State: ExtrasState, Holder: SummaryHolder): boolean
	return ViewOf(State, Holder.Store, Holder.Scope, Holder.Total).Holder == Holder
end

local function NoteHolderUsed(View: TotalView, Clock: number)
	local Holder = View.Holder
	if Holder ~= nil then
		Holder.UsedAt = Clock
	end
end

local function DropHolder(State: ExtrasState, Holder: SummaryHolder)
	local View = ViewOf(State, Holder.Store, Holder.Scope, Holder.Total)
	if View.Holder == Holder then
		View.Holder = nil
	end
	local At = table.find(State.Holders, Holder)
	if At ~= nil then
		table.remove(State.Holders, At)
	end
end

local function NewRequest(Server: ServerState, State: ExtrasState, Purpose: Purpose): number
	local RequestId = Numbers.NewRequestId(Server)
	State.Purposes[RequestId] = Purpose
	return RequestId
end

local function NewCall(State: ExtrasState, Call: TotalCall, Deadline: number): TotalWork
	local Work: TotalWork = { Call = Call, Deadline = Deadline, Waits = {}, IsTakerOwed = false, Tidies = {} }
	State.Calls[Call.CallId] = Work
	return Work
end

local function EndCall(State: ExtrasState, Work: TotalWork)
	State.Calls[Work.Call.CallId] = nil
end

local function TakeWaits(State: ExtrasState, RequestId: number): { TotalWork }
	local Ids: { number } = {}
	for CallId, Work in State.Calls do
		if Work.Waits[RequestId] then
			Work.Waits[RequestId] = nil
			table.insert(Ids, CallId)
		end
	end
	table.sort(Ids)
	local Taken: { TotalWork } = {}
	for _, CallId in Ids do
		table.insert(Taken, State.Calls[CallId])
	end
	return Taken
end

local function OpenCount(State: ExtrasState): number
	local Count = 0
	for _ in State.Calls do
		Count += 1
	end
	Count += CopyState.CopyOpenCount(State.CopyHolders)
	for _ in State.Peeks do
		Count += 1
	end
	for _, Purpose in State.Purposes do
		if Purpose.Kind == "AdviceGet" or Purpose.Kind == "ItemRemove" then
			Count += 1
		end
	end
	return Count
end

return {
	NewState = NewState,
	ViewOf = ViewOf,
	HolderOf = HolderOf,
	NoteHolderUsed = NoteHolderUsed,
	IsHeld = IsHeld,

--[=[
	Tidy: when a shard or part is tidied (extras sheet E6). A read showing an item PruneAge old makes a tidy due,
	at most once per key per PruneAge. Owe has the key's writer send a request with no op, making the writer if
	new, and stops at the close. It lands only if the age step drops something.

	Return type: A plain table with IsDue and Owe.
	Example usage:
		if Tidy.IsDue(Kept, Entry, Clock) then Tidy.Owe(State, Key, Clock, Fraction) end
--]=]

local Cache = require("../../Keys/DataStore/Cache")
local Composed = require("../../Shared/Composed")
local Durable = require("../../Keys/DataStore/Durable")
local Extras = require("../../Keys/Constants/Extras")
local Names = require("../../Keys/Encoding/Names")
local Numbers = require("../../Keys/DataStore/Numbers")
local Record = require("../../Keys/Constants/Record")
local Rooms = require("../../Keys/Format/Rooms")
local Shapes = require("../../Shared/Shapes")
local Value = require("../../Keys/Format/Value")
local Writers = require("../../Keys/DataStore/Writer")

type StoreKey = Names.StoreKey
type CacheEntry = Shapes.CacheEntry
type Kept = Value.Kept
type State = Composed.State

local ShardKind = Record.KeyKind.Shard

local PruneAge = Extras.PruneAge

local function IsTidiedRecently(Entry: CacheEntry, Clock: number): boolean
	local TidiedAt = Entry.TidiedAt
	return TidiedAt ~= nil and Clock < TidiedAt + PruneAge
end

local function IsDue(Kept: Kept, Entry: CacheEntry, Clock: number): boolean
	if IsTidiedRecently(Entry, Clock) then
		return false
	end
	for _, Item in Kept.Book.Timed do
		if Clock - Rooms.ItemStamp(Item) >= PruneAge then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function Owe(State: State, Key: StoreKey, Clock: number, Fraction: number)
	if State.Sessions.Shutdown ~= nil then
		return
	end
	local Server = State.Server
	local Entry = Numbers.EntryFor(Server, Key)
	if IsTidiedRecently(Entry, Clock) or not Writers.CanStartWriter(Server, Key) then
		return
	end
	local Setup = Cache.StoreOf(Server, Key).Setup
	local Writer = Durable.EnsurePacedWriter(Server, Key, Setup, Cache.KindOfKey(Key) == ShardKind, Fraction, Clock)
	Writer.TidyOwed = true
	Entry.TidiedAt = Clock
	Composed.NoteSendable(State, Key)
end

return {
	IsDue = IsDue,
	Owe = Owe,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Cache: the one owner of the server's key cache, HCache (record sheet 6), and of finding a key's store and kind.

	Its size is the server's, from its first Limits recorded (ServerLimits). A new entry in a full cache pushes out
	the least recently used one, in the order CacheOrder keeps (Recency), once it is in (Recency says why), and hands
	back its resumed writer, or nil. StoreOf and StoreNamed throw where FindStore gives nil. IsReachable: opened here,
	and its MayReference holds the key; an unopened store never refuses one (CannotHold). An entry's Candidate, a
	game key's vetted state last loaded or heard to land, is written only here; UpdateCommand puts it in every write.

	Return type: A plain table of functions.
	Example usage:
		local Entry, LostResumed = Cache.CacheEntry(State, Key)
--]=]

local Events = require("../../Shared/Events")
local Names = require("../Encoding/Names")
local Recency = require("../../Util/Recency")
local Record = require("../Constants/Record")
local Shapes = require("../../Shared/Shapes")
local Vetted = require("../Encoding/Vetted")

type StoreKey = Names.StoreKey
type UpdateCommand = Events.UpdateCommand
type Request = Shapes.Request
type CacheEntry = Shapes.CacheEntry
type KeyKind = Shapes.KeyKind
type Limits = Shapes.Limits
type ResumedWriter = Shapes.ResumedWriter
type ServerState = Shapes.ServerState
type StoreState = Shapes.StoreState

local KeyKinds = Record.KeyKind

local NoStoreForKey = "Cache: the key or call belongs to a store the server does not hold. The core routed it wrongly."
local NoStoreOpen = "Cache: this call is never made. A key is cached only once a store has opened."

local function KindOfKey(Key: StoreKey): KeyKind
	if string.sub(Key.Key, 1, #Record.ShardKeyPrefix) == Record.ShardKeyPrefix then
		return KeyKinds.Shard
	end
	if string.sub(Key.Key, 1, #Record.PartKeyPrefix) == Record.PartKeyPrefix then
		return KeyKinds.Part
	end
	return KeyKinds.Game
end

local function FindStore(State: ServerState, Key: StoreKey): StoreState?
	return State.Stores[Key.Store]
end

local function CannotHold(State: ServerState, Key: StoreKey): boolean
	local Store = FindStore(State, Key)
	if Store == nil then
		return false
	end
	local MayReference = Store.Setup.Build.MayReference
	if MayReference == nil then
		return false
	end
	return not MayReference({ Kind = "Short", Key = Key.Key })
end

local function IsReachable(State: ServerState, Key: StoreKey): boolean
	return FindStore(State, Key) ~= nil and not CannotHold(State, Key)
end

local function StoreNamed(State: ServerState, Name: string): StoreState
	local Store = State.Stores[Name]
	if Store == nil then
		error(NoStoreForKey)
	end
	return Store
end

local function StoreOf(State: ServerState, Key: StoreKey): StoreState
	return StoreNamed(State, Key.Store)
end

local function ServerLimits(State: ServerState): Limits
	local Recorded = State.Limits
	if Recorded == nil then
		error(NoStoreOpen)
	end
	return Recorded
end

local function FindEntry(State: ServerState, Key: StoreKey): CacheEntry?
	return State.Caches[Names.KeyText(Key)]
end

local function EvictLeastRecentlyUsed(State: ServerState): ResumedWriter?
	local Order = State.CacheOrder
	local Least = Recency.Oldest(Order)
	if Least == nil then
		return nil
	end
	Recency.Remove(Order, Least)
	local Evicted = State.Caches[Least]
	State.Caches[Least] = nil
	if Evicted == nil then
		return nil
	end
	return Evicted.Resumed
end

local function CacheEntry(State: ServerState, Key: StoreKey): (CacheEntry, ResumedWriter?)
	local Text = Names.KeyText(Key)
	local Order = State.CacheOrder
	local Found = State.Caches[Text]
	if Found ~= nil then
		Recency.Use(Order, Text)
		return Found, nil
	end
	local Created: CacheEntry = {}
	State.Caches[Text] = Created
	Recency.Use(Order, Text)
	if Order.Count <= ServerLimits(State).HorizonCacheKeys then
		return Created, nil
	end
	return Created, EvictLeastRecentlyUsed(State)
end

local function CandidateOf(State: ServerState, Key: StoreKey): { [unknown]: unknown }?
	local Entry = FindEntry(State, Key)
	if Entry == nil then
		return nil
	end
	return Entry.Candidate
end

local function UpdateCommand(State: ServerState, RequestId: number, Target: StoreKey, Request: Request): UpdateCommand
	return {
		Kind = "Update",
		RequestId = RequestId,
		Target = Target,
		Request = Request,
		Candidate = CandidateOf(State, Target),
	}
end

local function KeepCandidate(State: ServerState, Key: StoreKey, Candidate: { [unknown]: unknown }): ()
	local Entry = FindEntry(State, Key)
	if Entry == nil then
		return
	end
	if KindOfKey(Key) == KeyKinds.Game and Vetted.IsVetted(Candidate) then
		Entry.Candidate = Candidate
	else
		Entry.Candidate = nil
	end
end

local function ForgetCandidate(State: ServerState, Text: string): ()
	local Entry = State.Caches[Text]
	if Entry ~= nil then
		Entry.Candidate = nil
	end
end

return {
	KindOfKey = KindOfKey,
	FindStore = FindStore,
	CannotHold = CannotHold,
	IsReachable = IsReachable,
	StoreNamed = StoreNamed,
	StoreOf = StoreOf,
	ServerLimits = ServerLimits,
	FindEntry = FindEntry,
	CacheEntry = CacheEntry,
	UpdateCommand = UpdateCommand,
	KeepCandidate = KeepCandidate,
	ForgetCandidate = ForgetCandidate,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Reads: the record's reads (record sheet 14): Peek, Inspect, Peek with Fresh, Losses, Load, the read DidApply
	starts, and a copy holder's or follower's, which hand their result on.

	A state is shown as Tx/Beside's Showing says; unclean marks give Deciders, for Tx/Unclean. A read waits for
	work in HelpId and answers Unresolved at OpBound. A value below the shown count is read again after the first
	retry gap: an answer that is not an error resets the gap (record 3.2).

	Return type: A plain table of functions, the TookAnswer, UnresolvedAnswer, BehindAnswer and FreshRequest, and the
	ReadKind, Want, ReadOut, Next, ReadContext, Opened, OpenedEmpty, Handed, LoadCall and ReadCall types.
	Example usage:
		local Out = Reads.Start(State, { CallId = 1, Key = Key }, "Peek", Clock, Commands)
--]=]

local Answers = require("./Answers")
local Beside = require("../../Features/Trades/Beside")
local Book = require("../Format/Book")
local Cache = require("./Cache")
local Events = require("../../Shared/Events")
local JudgingShapes = require("../../Shared/OpShapes")
local Lookup = require("../Format/Lookup")
local Losses = require("../Format/Items/Losses")
local Names = require("../Encoding/Names")
local Numbers = require("./Numbers")
local Reasons = require("../Constants/Reasons")
local Replies = require("../../Shared/Replies")
local Sending = require("./Sending")
local Shapes = require("../../Shared/Shapes")
local Showables = require("./Showables")
local Shown = require("./Shown")
local TxShapes = require("../../Shared/TradeShapes")
local Unreadable = require("./Unreadable")
local Value = require("../Format/Value")
local View = require("./View")
local Work = require("../Format/Items/Work")

type Answer = Events.Answer
type Command = Events.Command
type Outcome = Events.Outcome
type ReadOutcome = Events.ReadOutcome
type Book = Book.Book
type LossRecords = Losses.LossRecords
type Name = Names.Name
type StoreKey = Names.StoreKey
type EndWorkReport = JudgingShapes.EndWorkReport
type Value = Value.Value
type Kept = Value.Kept
type Report = JudgingShapes.Report
type Request = Shapes.Request
type Setup = Shapes.Setup
type ServerState = Shapes.ServerState
type StandingMark = Work.StandingMark
type AbortedUse = TxShapes.AbortedUse
type Cause = Unreadable.Cause
type Served = Showables.Served
type Fields = { [unknown]: unknown }

export type ReadKind = "Peek" | "Inspect" | "PeekFresh" | "Losses"

export type Want =
	{ read Kind: "Peek" }
	| { read Kind: "Inspect" }
	| { read Kind: "PeekFresh" }
	| { read Kind: "Losses" }
	| { read Kind: "DidApply", read Name: Name, read Stamp: number?, read Probe: Request? }
	| { read Kind: "Load", read MustExist: boolean }
	| { read Kind: "Copy" }
	| { read Kind: "Follow" }

export type ReadOut = {
	read CallId: number,
	read Key: StoreKey,
	read Want: Want,
	read Started: number,
	RequestId: number,
	ErrorsInARow: number,
	RetryAt: number?,
	HelpId: number?,
}

export type Opened = {
	read Kind: "Opened",
	read Out: ReadOut,
	read Kept: Kept,
	read Viewed: { [unknown]: unknown },
}

export type OpenedEmpty = { read Kind: "OpenedEmpty", read Out: ReadOut }

export type Handed = { read Kind: "Handed", read Out: ReadOut, read Answer: Answer }

export type Next =
	{ read Kind: "Done" }
	| { read Kind: "Reading", read Out: ReadOut }
	| { read Kind: "EndWork", read Out: ReadOut, read Report: EndWorkReport }
	| {
		read Kind: "Deciders",
		read Out: ReadOut,
		read Kept: Kept,
		read Viewed: Fields,
		read Marks: { StandingMark },
	}
	| Opened
	| OpenedEmpty
	| Handed

export type ReadContext = {
	read Clock: number,
	read Served: Served,
	read IsSilent: boolean,
	read Aborted: { AbortedUse },
}

export type LoadCall = { read CallId: number, read Key: StoreKey, read MustExist: boolean }

export type ReadCall = { read CallId: number, read Key: StoreKey }

local Wants: { [ReadKind]: Want } = {
	Peek = table.freeze({ Kind = "Peek" :: "Peek" }),
	Inspect = table.freeze({ Kind = "Inspect" :: "Inspect" }),
	PeekFresh = table.freeze({ Kind = "PeekFresh" :: "PeekFresh" }),
	Losses = table.freeze({ Kind = "Losses" :: "Losses" }),
}
local DoneNext: Next = table.freeze({ Kind = "Done" :: "Done" })

local FreshRequest: Request = table.freeze({ Kind = "Fresh" :: "Fresh" })
local TookAnswer: Answer = table.freeze({ Kind = "Succeeded" :: "Succeeded", Value = true })

local UnresolvedAnswer = table.freeze(Replies.FailedAnswer(Reasons.Unresolved))
local ExpiredAnswer = table.freeze(Replies.FailedAnswer(Reasons.Expired))
local MissingAnswer = table.freeze(Replies.FailedAnswer(Reasons.Missing))
local BehindAnswer = table.freeze(Replies.FailedAnswer(Reasons.Behind))

local function UnreadableAnswer(State: ServerState, Out: ReadOut, Cause: Cause, Commands: { Command }): Answer
	Unreadable.Warn(State, Out.Key, Cause, Commands)
	return Replies.FailedAnswer(Unreadable.ReasonOf(Cause))
end

local function IsHanded(Want: Want): boolean
	return Want.Kind == "Copy" or Want.Kind == "Follow"
end

local function EndRead(Commands: { Command }, Out: ReadOut, Given: Answer): Next
	if IsHanded(Out.Want) then
		return { Kind = "Handed", Out = Out, Answer = Given }
	end
	Replies.Reply(Commands, Out.CallId, Given)
	return DoneNext
end

local function MissingNext(Out: ReadOut, Commands: { Command }): Next
	if Out.Want.Kind == "Load" then
		return { Kind = "OpenedEmpty", Out = Out }
	end
	return EndRead(Commands, Out, MissingAnswer)
end

local function RequestFor(State: ServerState, Setup: Setup, Out: ReadOut): Request?
	local Want = Out.Want
	if Want.Kind == "PeekFresh" then
		return FreshRequest
	end
	if Want.Kind == "DidApply" then
		return Want.Probe
	end
	if Want.Kind == "Losses" then
		return nil
	end
	if Shown.IsAbsentWithBit(State, Out.Key) then
		return FreshRequest
	end
	return nil
end

local function Issue(State: ServerState, Setup: Setup, Out: ReadOut, RequestId: number, Commands: { Command }): Next
	Out.RequestId = RequestId
	Out.RetryAt = nil
	local Request = RequestFor(State, Setup, Out)
	if Request == nil then
		local Get: Command = { Kind = "Get", RequestId = RequestId, Target = Out.Key }
		table.insert(Commands, Get)
	else
		local Update: Command = Cache.UpdateCommand(State, RequestId, Out.Key, Request)
		table.insert(Commands, Update)
	end
	return { Kind = "Reading", Out = Out }
end

local function StartWant(State: ServerState, Call: ReadCall, Want: Want, Clock: number, Commands: { Command }): ReadOut
	local RequestId = Numbers.NewRequestId(State)
	local Out: ReadOut = {
		CallId = Call.CallId,
		Key = Call.Key,
		Want = Want,
		Started = Clock,
		RequestId = RequestId,
		ErrorsInARow = 0,
	}
	Issue(State, Cache.StoreOf(State, Call.Key).Setup, Out, RequestId, Commands)
	return Out
end

local function Start(State: ServerState, Call: ReadCall, Kind: ReadKind, Clock: number, Commands: { Command }): ReadOut
	return StartWant(State, Call, Wants[Kind], Clock, Commands)
end

local function StartLoad(State: ServerState, Call: LoadCall, Clock: number, Commands: { Command }): ReadOut
	local Want: Want = { Kind = "Load", MustExist = Call.MustExist }
	return StartWant(State, Call, Want, Clock, Commands)
end

local function StoredSaysTook(StoredBook: Book, Name: Name): boolean
	local Held = Lookup.HeldOfAsked(StoredBook, Name)
	if Held ~= nil and Held.Kind == "Fated" and Answers.IsTook(Held.Fate) then
		return true
	end
	return Lookup.UntimedTookOfAsked(StoredBook, Name)
end

local function IsForgottenAnyKind(Horizon: number, CutHorizon: number, Stamp: number?): boolean
	return Stamp ~= nil and Stamp <= math.max(Horizon, CutHorizon)
end

local function DidApplyOfStored(StoredBook: Book, Name: Name, Stamp: number?): Answer
	if StoredSaysTook(StoredBook, Name) then
		return TookAnswer
	end
	local IsForgotten = IsForgottenAnyKind(StoredBook.Horizon, StoredBook.CutHorizon, Stamp)
	if IsForgotten and Lookup.HeldOfAsked(StoredBook, Name) == nil then
		return ExpiredAnswer
	end
	return UnresolvedAnswer
end

local function IsPastBound(Out: ReadOut, Clock: number, Setup: Setup): boolean
	return Clock - Out.Started >= Setup.Limits.OpBound
end

local function ReadAgain(
	State: ServerState,
	Setup: Setup,
	Out: ReadOut,
	Context: ReadContext,
	Commands: { Command }
): Next
	if IsPastBound(Out, Context.Clock, Setup) then
		return EndRead(Commands, Out, UnresolvedAnswer)
	end
	if Context.IsSilent then
		return { Kind = "Reading", Out = Out }
	end
	local RequestId = Numbers.NewRequestId(State)
	return Issue(State, Setup, Out, RequestId, Commands)
end

local function Resume(State: ServerState, Out: ReadOut, Context: ReadContext, Commands: { Command }): Next
	return ReadAgain(State, Cache.StoreOf(State, Out.Key).Setup, Out, Context, Commands)
end

local function TimeOut(State: ServerState, Out: ReadOut, Clock: number, Commands: { Command }): Next
	if IsPastBound(Out, Clock, Cache.StoreOf(State, Out.Key).Setup) then
		return EndRead(Commands, Out, UnresolvedAnswer)
	end
	return { Kind = "Reading", Out = Out }
end

local function ReadAgainIn(Gap: number, Setup: Setup, Out: ReadOut, Context: ReadContext, Commands: { Command }): Next
	if IsPastBound(Out, Context.Clock, Setup) then
		return EndRead(Commands, Out, UnresolvedAnswer)
	end
	local WakeAt = math.min(Context.Clock + Gap, Out.Started + Setup.Limits.OpBound)
	Out.RetryAt = WakeAt
	local Wake: Command = { Kind = "Wake", At = WakeAt }
	table.insert(Commands, Wake)
	return { Kind = "Reading", Out = Out }
end

local function ReadAgainLater(Setup: Setup, Out: ReadOut, Context: ReadContext, Commands: { Command }): Next
	Out.ErrorsInARow += 1
	return ReadAgainIn(Sending.RetryGap(Out.ErrorsInARow, Setup.Limits), Setup, Out, Context, Commands)
end

local function ShowState(
	State: ServerState,
	Out: ReadOut,
	Kept: Kept,
	Viewed: Fields,
	Shows: Fields,
	Context: ReadContext,
	Commands: { Command }
): Next
	local Entry = Numbers.EntryFor(State, Out.Key)
	Entry.IsBehind = nil
	Beside.KeepShowable(Entry, Kept, Viewed, State, Out.Key, Context.Aborted, Context.Served)
	Shown.Show(State, Out.Key, Kept.Book.Writes, Kept.Book.Identity, Context.Clock, Context.Served.Open)
	if Out.Want.Kind == "Load" or IsHanded(Out.Want) then
		return { Kind = "Opened", Out = Out, Kept = Kept, Viewed = Shows }
	end
	if Out.Want.Kind == "Inspect" then
		local Inspected = table.clone(Kept)
		Inspected.State = Shows
		return EndRead(Commands, Out, { Kind = "Succeeded", Value = Inspected })
	end
	return EndRead(Commands, Out, { Kind = "Succeeded", Value = Shows })
end

local function ShowKept(
	State: ServerState,
	Setup: Setup,
	Out: ReadOut,
	Kept: Kept,
	Context: ReadContext,
	Commands: { Command }
): Next
	local Viewed = View.ViewState(Setup, Kept)
	if Viewed.Kind == "Behind" then
		Numbers.HearBehind(State, Out.Key)
		return EndRead(Commands, Out, BehindAnswer)
	end
	if Viewed.Kind == "Unreadable" then
		return EndRead(Commands, Out, UnreadableAnswer(State, Out, Viewed.Cause, Commands))
	end
	local Showing = Beside.Showing(State, Out.Key, Kept, Viewed.State, Context.Aborted)
	if Showing.Kind == "Unclean" then
		return { Kind = "Deciders", Out = Out, Kept = Kept, Viewed = Viewed.State, Marks = Showing.Marks }
	end
	return ShowState(State, Out, Kept, Viewed.State, Showing.State, Context, Commands)
end

local function AnswerStored(
	State: ServerState,
	Setup: Setup,
	Out: ReadOut,
	Kept: Kept,
	Context: ReadContext,
	Commands: { Command }
): Next
	local StoredBook = Kept.Book
	local Want = Out.Want
	if Want.Kind == "Losses" then
		local Records: LossRecords = {
			Events = StoredBook.Losses.Events,
			Returns = StoredBook.Losses.Returns,
			Slots = StoredBook.Slots,
		}
		return EndRead(Commands, Out, { Kind = "Succeeded", Value = Records })
	end
	if Want.Kind == "DidApply" then
		return EndRead(Commands, Out, DidApplyOfStored(StoredBook, Want.Name, Want.Stamp))
	end
	if not Shown.IsShown(State, Out.Key, StoredBook.Writes, StoredBook.Identity) then
		return ReadAgainIn(Setup.Limits.RetryGapFirst, Setup, Out, Context, Commands)
	end
	return ShowKept(State, Setup, Out, Kept, Context, Commands)
end

local function OnReadResult(
	State: ServerState,
	Out: ReadOut,
	Fetched: ReadOutcome,
	Context: ReadContext,
	Commands: { Command }
): Next
	local Setup = Cache.StoreOf(State, Out.Key).Setup
	if Fetched.Kind == "Failed" then
		return ReadAgainLater(Setup, Out, Context, Commands)
	end
	Out.ErrorsInARow = 0
	local Read = Numbers.LearnStored(State, Out.Key, Setup, Fetched, Context.Clock)
	if Read.Kind == "Unreadable" then
		return EndRead(Commands, Out, UnreadableAnswer(State, Out, Read.Cause, Commands))
	end
	if Read.Kind == "Nothing" then
		return MissingNext(Out, Commands)
	end
	return AnswerStored(State, Setup, Out, Read.Kept, Context, Commands)
end

local function AnswerCancel(State: ServerState, Out: ReadOut, Report: Report?, Commands: { Command }): Next
	if Report ~= nil and Report.Kind == "Overdue" then
		return { Kind = "EndWork", Out = Out, Report = Report }
	end
	if Report ~= nil and Report.Kind == "Missing" then
		return MissingNext(Out, Commands)
	end
	if Report ~= nil and Report.Kind == "Unreadable" and Report.Cause ~= "Amounts" then
		return EndRead(Commands, Out, UnreadableAnswer(State, Out, Report.Cause, Commands))
	end
	return EndRead(Commands, Out, UnresolvedAnswer)
end

local function OnUpdateResult(
	State: ServerState,
	Out: ReadOut,
	Result: Outcome,
	Context: ReadContext,
	Commands: { Command }
): Next
	local Setup = Cache.StoreOf(State, Out.Key).Setup
	if Result.Kind == "Err" then
		return ReadAgainLater(Setup, Out, Context, Commands)
	end
	Out.ErrorsInARow = 0
	local Note = Result.Note
	local Entry = Numbers.EntryFor(State, Out.Key)
	Numbers.LearnFromNote(State, Entry, Out.Key, Setup, Note)
	local Want = Out.Want
	if Want.Kind == "DidApply" then
		Unreadable.WarnOfReport(State, Out.Key, Note.ProbeReport, Commands)
		local IsForgotten = IsForgottenAnyKind(Note.Horizon, Note.CutHorizon, Want.Stamp)
		local Move = Answers.DidApplyAnswer(Note.ProbeReport, IsForgotten)
		if Move.Kind == "Answer" then
			return EndRead(Commands, Out, Move.Answer)
		end
		return { Kind = "EndWork", Out = Out, Report = Move.Report }
	end
	if Result.Kind == "Nil" then
		return AnswerCancel(State, Out, Note.ProbeReport, Commands)
	end
	local Landed = Value.DecodeValue(Result.Value, Setup.Build, Setup.Limits.WindowUnit, Setup.Encoding)
	if Landed == nil then
		return EndRead(Commands, Out, UnresolvedAnswer)
	end
	if Landed.Kind == "Sealed" then
		return MissingNext(Out, Commands)
	end
	return ShowKept(State, Setup, Out, Landed, Context, Commands)
end

return {
	TookAnswer = TookAnswer,
	UnresolvedAnswer = UnresolvedAnswer,
	IsHanded = IsHanded,
	BehindAnswer = BehindAnswer,
	EndRead = EndRead,
	FreshRequest = FreshRequest,
	Start = Start,
	StartWant = StartWant,
	StartLoad = StartLoad,
	Resume = Resume,
	TimeOut = TimeOut,
	ReadAgainLater = ReadAgainLater,
	ShowKept = ShowKept,
	ShowState = ShowState,
	OnReadResult = OnReadResult,
	OnUpdateResult = OnUpdateResult,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	Shown: a server's shown table (record sheet 14, Format.md 4): per key the largest write count shown of one
	incarnation, with its id, and one bit per hash of a key that left. A read of another incarnation starts the count
	again. A copy carries its key's id; one from an older build carries none, and on an erasable store any read
	replaces it. A session's key never leaves.

	A full table lets its least recently shown key go, in the order Order keeps, once the new key is in (Recency says
	why). A lap passes over an open session's key and the key being added, counting each as shown then, so it may find
	none.

	Return type: A plain table of functions.
	Example usage:
		Shown.Show(State, Key, WriteCount, Identity, Clock, OpenKeys)
--]=]

local Book = require("../Format/Book")
local Cache = require("./Cache")
local HashInputs = require("../Encoding/HashInputs")
local KindSetup = require("../Ops/KindSetup")
local Names = require("../Encoding/Names")
local Recency = require("../../Util/Recency")
local Shapes = require("../../Shared/Shapes")

type Identity = Book.Identity
type StoreKey = Names.StoreKey
type ServerState = Shapes.ServerState
type ShownIncarnation = Shapes.ShownIncarnation
type ShownTable = Shapes.ShownTable

local OneBit = 1

local NoIncarnation: ShownIncarnation = table.freeze({ Kind = "None" :: "None" })
local UnknownIncarnation: ShownIncarnation = table.freeze({ Kind = "Unknown" :: "Unknown" })

local function BitOf(State: ServerState, Key: StoreKey): number
	local Digest = HashInputs.Hash(State.Encoding, HashInputs.ShownInput(Key.Store, Key.Scope, Key.Key))
	return HashInputs.ChoiceNumber(Digest) % Cache.ServerLimits(State).ShownBitCount
end

local function LargestOf(State: ServerState, Key: StoreKey): number?
	return State.Shown.Counts[Names.KeyText(Key)]
end

local function LastShownAt(State: ServerState, Key: StoreKey): number?
	return State.Shown.LastShown[Names.KeyText(Key)]
end

local function IsBitSet(Shown: ShownTable, Bit: number): boolean
	return buffer.readbits(Shown.Bits, Bit, OneBit) == 1
end

local function IncarnationOf(Identity: Identity?): ShownIncarnation
	if Identity == nil then
		return NoIncarnation
	end
	return { Kind = "Known", Identity = Identity }
end

local function IsSameIncarnation(Shown: ShownTable, Text: string, Identity: Identity?): boolean
	local Held = Shown.Incarnations[Text]
	if Held == nil then
		return true
	end
	if Held.Kind == "Unknown" then
		return false
	end
	if Held.Kind == "None" or Identity == nil then
		return Held.Kind == "None" and Identity == nil
	end
	return Held.Identity.Server == Identity.Server and Held.Identity.Counter == Identity.Counter
end

local function Forget(State: ServerState, Text: string)
	local Shown = State.Shown
	buffer.writebits(Shown.Bits, BitOf(State, Shown.Keys[Text]), OneBit, 1)
	Recency.Remove(Shown.Order, Text)
	Shown.Keys[Text] = nil
	Shown.Counts[Text] = nil
	Shown.Incarnations[Text] = nil
	Shown.LastShown[Text] = nil
end

local function Evict(State: ServerState, OpenKeys: { read [string]: unknown }, Adding: string): boolean
	local Order = State.Shown.Order
	for _ = 1, Order.Count do
		local Least = Recency.Oldest(Order)
		if Least == nil then
			return false
		end
		if OpenKeys[Least] == nil and Least ~= Adding then
			Forget(State, Least)
			return true
		end
		Recency.Use(Order, Least)
	end
	return false
end

local function MakeRoom(State: ServerState, OpenKeys: { read [string]: unknown }, Adding: string)
	local Order = State.Shown.Order
	while Order.Count > Cache.ServerLimits(State).ShownKeysMax do
		if not Evict(State, OpenKeys, Adding) then
			return
		end
	end
end

local function AddKey(State: ServerState, Key: StoreKey, Text: string): boolean
	local Shown = State.Shown
	local IsNew = Shown.Counts[Text] == nil
	if IsNew then
		Shown.Keys[Text] = Key
	end
	Recency.Use(Shown.Order, Text)
	return IsNew
end

local function Show(
	State: ServerState,
	Key: StoreKey,
	WriteCount: number,
	Identity: Identity?,
	Clock: number,
	OpenKeys: { read [string]: unknown }
)
	local Shown = State.Shown
	local Text = Names.KeyText(Key)
	local IsNew = AddKey(State, Key, Text)
	local Largest = Shown.Counts[Text]
	if Largest == nil or WriteCount > Largest or not IsSameIncarnation(Shown, Text, Identity) then
		Shown.Counts[Text] = WriteCount
	end
	Shown.Incarnations[Text] = IncarnationOf(Identity)
	Shown.LastShown[Text] = Clock
	if IsNew then
		MakeRoom(State, OpenKeys, Text)
	end
end

local function ShowCopy(
	State: ServerState,
	Key: StoreKey,
	WriteCount: number,
	Carried: (Identity | false)?,
	Clock: number,
	OpenKeys: { read [string]: unknown }
)
	local Shown = State.Shown
	local Text = Names.KeyText(Key)
	local IsNew = AddKey(State, Key, Text)
	local Largest = Shown.Counts[Text]
	if Largest == nil or WriteCount > Largest then
		Shown.Counts[Text] = WriteCount
		if Carried ~= nil then
			Shown.Incarnations[Text] = IncarnationOf(if Carried == false then nil else Carried)
		elseif KindSetup.IsErasableKey(Cache.StoreOf(State, Key).Setup, Key) then
			Shown.Incarnations[Text] = UnknownIncarnation
		end
	end
	Shown.LastShown[Text] = Clock
	if IsNew then
		MakeRoom(State, OpenKeys, Text)
	end
end

local function IsAbsentWithBit(State: ServerState, Key: StoreKey): boolean
	local Shown = State.Shown
	if Shown.Counts[Names.KeyText(Key)] ~= nil then
		return false
	end
	return IsBitSet(Shown, BitOf(State, Key))
end

local function IsShown(State: ServerState, Key: StoreKey, WriteCount: number, Identity: Identity?): boolean
	local Text = Names.KeyText(Key)
	local Largest = State.Shown.Counts[Text]
	if Largest == nil then
		return not IsAbsentWithBit(State, Key)
	end
	if not IsSameIncarnation(State.Shown, Text, Identity) then
		return true
	end
	return WriteCount >= Largest
end

local function IsNewerThanShown(State: ServerState, Key: StoreKey, WriteCount: number, Identity: Identity?): boolean
	local Text = Names.KeyText(Key)
	local Largest = State.Shown.Counts[Text]
	if Largest == nil then
		return false
	end
	if not IsSameIncarnation(State.Shown, Text, Identity) then
		return true
	end
	return WriteCount > Largest
end

local function IsCopyShown(State: ServerState, Key: StoreKey, WriteCount: number): boolean
	local Largest = LargestOf(State, Key)
	if Largest ~= nil then
		return WriteCount >= Largest
	end
	return not IsAbsentWithBit(State, Key)
end

local function IsCopyAboveShown(State: ServerState, Key: StoreKey, WriteCount: number): boolean
	local Largest = LargestOf(State, Key)
	return Largest == nil or WriteCount > Largest
end

return {
	BitOf = BitOf,
	LargestOf = LargestOf,
	LastShownAt = LastShownAt,
	Show = Show,
	ShowCopy = ShowCopy,
	IsAbsentWithBit = IsAbsentWithBit,
	IsShown = IsShown,
	IsNewerThanShown = IsNewerThanShown,
	IsCopyShown = IsCopyShown,
	IsCopyAboveShown = IsCopyAboveShown,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

--[=[
	View: the state a read or load shows (record sheet 13 to 15): the stored state at the build's level.

	A floor above the build's last breaking migration answers Behind. A failing migration, one past StateCap, or a
	balance rejected after a migration (now or stored) answers Unreadable with its cause (Reading/Unreadable): reads
	never throw. Undeclared fields are kept.

	Return type: A plain table with IsBehind, IsFloorBehind, ViewState, MigrateFrom and MigratedFloor, and the View
	type.
	Example usage:
		local Viewed = View.ViewState(Setup, Kept)
		local Copied = View.MigrateFrom(Setup, State, Level, Floor)
--]=]

local Balances = require("../Trades/Balances")
local Guards = require("../Ops/Guards")
local Shapes = require("../../Shared/Shapes")
local Value = require("../Format/Value")

type Build = Shapes.Build
type Setup = Shapes.Setup
type Kept = Value.Kept

export type View =
	{ read Kind: "State", read State: { [unknown]: unknown } }
	| { read Kind: "Behind" }
	| { read Kind: "Unreadable", read Cause: "Migration" | "Balance" }

local function IsFloorBehind(Setup: Setup, Floor: number): boolean
	return Floor > Setup.Build.BreakingIndex
end

local function IsBehind(Setup: Setup, Kept: Kept): boolean
	return IsFloorBehind(Setup, Kept.Book.Floor)
end

local function MigrateFrom(Setup: Setup, State: Value.Fields, Level: number, Floor: number): View
	local Build = Setup.Build
	if IsFloorBehind(Setup, Floor) then
		return { Kind = "Behind" }
	end
	for Index = Level + 1, Build.MigrationCount do
		local Migrated = Guards.RunMigration(Build.Migrations[Index].Run, State, Setup.Limits)
		if
			Migrated.Kind ~= "State"
			or not Value.StateFits(Setup.Encoding, Build, Migrated.State, Setup.Limits.StateCap)
		then
			return { Kind = "Unreadable", Cause = "Migration" }
		end
		State = Migrated.State
	end
	if Build.MigrationCount > 0 and Balances.HoldsInvalidBalance(State, Build.Balances) then
		return { Kind = "Unreadable", Cause = "Balance" }
	end
	return { Kind = "State", State = State }
end

local function MigratedFloor(Build: Build, Level: number, Floor: number): number
	local Migrated = Floor
	for Index = Level + 1, Build.MigrationCount do
		if Build.Migrations[Index].IsBreaking then
			Migrated = Index
		end
	end
	return Migrated
end

local function ViewState(Setup: Setup, Kept: Kept): View
	return MigrateFrom(Setup, Kept.State, Kept.Book.Level, Kept.Book.Floor)
end

return {
	IsBehind = IsBehind,
	IsFloorBehind = IsFloorBehind,
	ViewState = ViewState,
	MigrateFrom = MigrateFrom,
	MigratedFloor = MigratedFloor,
}
